name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.scalarExtension_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem scalarExtension_apply
    (m : (E p r) [⋀^Fin p]→L[K p r] (G p r)) (x : Fin p → E p r) :
    scalarExtension p r m (fun i => (x i : A p r)) = (m x : L p r)
proof:
:=
  denseAlternatingScalarExtension_apply _ _ _ _ m x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.norm_scalarExtension
statement:
@[simp] theorem norm_scalarExtension
    (m : (E p r) [⋀^Fin p]→L[K p r] (G p r)) :
    ‖scalarExtension p r m‖ = ‖m‖
proof: := norm_denseAlternatingScalarExtension _ _ _ _ m

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.scalarExtension_pointwise
statement:
theorem scalarExtension_pointwise
    (m : (E p r) [⋀^Fin p]→L[K p r] (G p r)) (x : Fin p → A p r) :
    scalarExtension p r m x = (coefficientEquiv p r m : L p r) * delta p r x
proof:
:=
  denseAlternatingScalarExtension_eq_coefficient_det
    (RationalField.denseRange_algebraMap (ZMod p) r) (E p r).subtypeₗᵢ
    (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.denseRange_subtype p r)
    (TruncatedPolynomial.basis (L p r) p) (G p r)
    (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.standard p r) (subtype_standard p r) m x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.specializeCoefficient_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem specializeCoefficient_apply (c : C p r) :
    (specializeCoefficient p r c : Poly0 p r) =
      specialization p r ((polynomialEquivC p r).symm c : Poly p r)
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.specializeCoefficient_one
statement:
theorem specializeCoefficient_one :
    (specializeCoefficient p r ⟨1, one_mem_C p r⟩ : Poly0 p r) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [specializeCoefficient_apply]
  have h : ((polynomialEquivC p r).symm ⟨1, one_mem_C p r⟩ : Poly p r) = 1 := by
    apply evaluation_injective p r
    rw [evaluation_polynomialEquivC_symm, map_one]
  rw [h, map_one]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.one_mem_Cpoly
statement: theorem one_mem_Cpoly : (1 : Poly p r) ∈ Cpoly p r
proof:
:=
  (evaluation_mem_C_iff p r 1).mp (by simpa using one_mem_C p r)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.one_mem_C0poly
statement: theorem one_mem_C0poly : (1 : Poly0 p r) ∈ C0poly p r
proof:
:= by
  simpa using specialization_mem_Cpoly p r (one_mem_Cpoly p r)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.paddedCoefficientSubmodule_eq_C
statement:
theorem paddedCoefficientSubmodule_eq_C :
    determinantCoefficientSubmodule (Padding.inclusionE p r n).toLinearMap
      (Padding.basis p r n) (G p r) = C p r
proof:
:=
  coefficientSubmodule_eq_C_of_span p r _ _ (Padding.span_delta_E p r n)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.paddedCoefficientEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem paddedCoefficientEquiv_apply
    (m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r) :
    (paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n m : L p r) =
      (m (Padding.standardE p r n) : L p r)
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.paddedCoefficientEquiv_pointwise
statement:
theorem paddedCoefficientEquiv_pointwise
    (m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r)
    (x : Fin (p+n) → Padding.E p r n) :
    (m x : L p r) = (paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n m : L p r) *
      Padding.delta p r n (fun i => Padding.inclusionE p r n (x i))
proof:
:=
  alternating_eq_coefficient_mul_det
    (RationalField.denseRange_algebraMap (ZMod p) r) (Padding.inclusionE p r n)
    (Padding.denseRange_inclusionE p r n) (Padding.basis p r n) (G p r)
    (Padding.standardE p r n) (Padding.inclusionE_standardE p r n) m x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.paddedCoefficientEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem paddedCoefficientEquiv_symm_apply (c : C p r)
    (x : Fin (p+n) → Padding.E p r n) :
    ((paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n).symm c x : L p r) = (c : L p r) *
      Padding.delta p r n (fun i => Padding.inclusionE p r n (x i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [paddedCoefficientEquiv_pointwise, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.norm_paddedCoefficientEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem norm_paddedCoefficientEquiv
    (m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r) :
    ‖paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n m‖ = ‖m‖
proof: := (paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n).norm_map m

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.norm_paddedCoefficientEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp] theorem norm_paddedCoefficientEquiv_symm (c : C p r) :
    ‖(paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n).symm c‖ = ‖c‖

  (paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n).symm.norm_map c

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.paddedScalarExtension_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem paddedScalarExtension_apply
    (m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r)
    (x : Fin (p+n) → Padding.E p r n) :
    paddedScalarExtension p r n m (fun i => Padding.inclusionE p r n (x i)) =
      (m x : L p r)
proof: := denseAlternatingScalarExtension_apply _ _ _ _ m x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.norm_paddedScalarExtension
statement:
@[simp] theorem norm_paddedScalarExtension
    (m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r) :
    ‖paddedScalarExtension p r n m‖ = ‖m‖

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.paddedScalarExtension_pointwise
statement:
theorem paddedScalarExtension_pointwise
    (m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r)
    (x : Fin (p+n) → Padding.H p r n) :
    paddedScalarExtension p r n m x =
      (paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n m : L p r) * Padding.delta p r n x
proof:
:=
  denseAlternatingScalarExtension_eq_coefficient_det
    (RationalField.denseRange_algebraMap (ZMod p) r) (Padding.inclusionE p r n)
    (Padding.denseRange_inclusionE p r n) (Padding.basis p r n) (G p r)
    (Padding.standardE p r n) (Padding.inclusionE_standardE p r n) m x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.coefficient_spaces
statement:
theorem coefficient_spaces :
    (∀ c : L p r, c ∈ C p r ↔
      c ∈ G p r ∧ ∀ i : Fin p, z p r (Sum.inl i) * c ∈ G p r) ∧
    (1 : L p r) ∈ C p r ∧
    (∀ c : C p r, ‖c‖ = ‖(c : L p r)‖) ∧
    Submodule.span (K p r) (Set.range (fun x : Fin p → E p r =>
      delta p r (fun i => (x i : A p r)))) = primarySpan p r ∧
    (∀ x : Fin p → A p r, ‖delta p r x‖ ≤ ∏ i, ‖x i‖) ∧
    Isometry (coefficientEquiv p r) ∧
    (∀ m : (E p r) [⋀^Fin p]→L[K p r] (G p r),
      (coefficientEquiv p r m : L p r) =
        (m (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.standard p r) : L p r)) ∧
    (∀ (m : (E p r) [⋀^Fin p]→L[K p r] (G p r)) (x : Fin p → E p r),
      (m x : L p r) = (coefficientEquiv p r m : L p r) *
        delta p r (fun i => (x i : A p r))) ∧
    (∀ (c : C p r) (x : Fin p → E p r),
      ((coefficientEquiv p r).symm c x : L p r) =
        (c : L p r) * delta p r (fun i => (x i : A p r))) ∧
    (∀ m : (E p r) [⋀^Fin p]→L[K p r] (G p r), ‖coefficientEquiv p r m‖ = ‖m‖) ∧
    (∀ c : C p r, ‖(coefficientEquiv p r).symm c‖ = ‖c‖) ∧
    (∀ (m : (E p r) [⋀^Fin p]→L[K p r] (G p r)) (x : Fin p → E p r),
      scalarExtension p r m (fun i => (x i : A p r)) = (m x : L p r)) ∧
    (∀ (m : (E p r) [⋀^Fin p]→L[K p r] (G p r)) (x : Fin p → A p r),
      scalarExtension p r m x = (coefficientEquiv p r m : L p r) * delta p r x) ∧
    (∀ m : (E p r) [⋀^Fin p]→L[K p r] (G p r), ‖scalarExtension p r m‖ = ‖m‖) ∧
    (Gpoly p r).map (evaluation p r).toLinearMap = G p r ∧
    (Cpoly p r).map (evaluation p r).toLinearMap = C p r ∧
    Function.Injective (evaluation p r) ∧
    (∀ c : L p r, c ∈ C p r →
      ∃! P : Poly p r, P ∈ Cpoly p r ∧ evaluation p r P = c) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin p, specialization p r (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i)) = MvPolynomial.X i) ∧
    (∀ w : Tau p, specialization p r (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr w)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ c : K p r, specialization p r (MvPolynomial.C c) = MvPolynomial.C c) ∧
    (∀ P Q : Poly p r,
      specialization p r (P * Q) = specialization p r P * specialization p r Q) ∧
    (Gpoly p r).map (specialization p r).toLinearMap = G0poly p r ∧
    (Cpoly p r).map (specialization p r).toLinearMap ≤ C0poly p r ∧
    (1 : Poly p r) ∈ Cpoly p r ∧ (1 : Poly0 p r) ∈ C0poly p r ∧
    (specializeCoefficient p r ⟨1, one_mem_C p r⟩ : Poly0 p r) = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨fun _ => mem_C p r, one_mem_C p r, norm_C p r, delta_span_E p r,
    norm_delta_le p r, (coefficientEquiv p r).isometry, coefficientEquiv_apply p r,
    coefficientEquiv_pointwise p r, coefficientEquiv_symm_apply p r,
    norm_coefficientEquiv p r, norm_coefficientEquiv_symm p r,
    scalarExtension_apply p r, scalarExtension_pointwise p r, norm_scalarExtension p r,
    map_Gpoly p r, map_Cpoly p r, evaluation_injective p r,
    fun _ => existsUnique_coefficient_polynomial_representative p r,
    specialization_X p r, specialization_Y p r, specialization_C p r,
    specialization_mul p r, map_specialization_Gpoly p r, map_specialization_Cpoly_le p r,
    one_mem_Cpoly p r, one_mem_C0poly p r, specializeCoefficient_one p r⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.finrank_paddedAmbient
statement: theorem finrank_paddedAmbient : Module.finrank (L p r) (Padding.H p r n) = p + n
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (Padding.basis p r n)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.padded_coefficient_spaces
statement:
theorem padded_coefficient_spaces :
    CompleteSpace (Padding.H p r n) ∧
    Module.finrank (L p r) (Padding.H p r n) = p + n ∧
    (∀ x : Padding.E p r n, ‖x‖ = max ‖x.1‖ ‖x.2‖) ∧
    (∀ x : Padding.D p r n, ‖x‖ = max ‖x.1‖ ‖x.2‖) ∧
    (∀ x : Padding.H p r n, ‖x‖ = max ‖x.1‖ ‖x.2‖) ∧
    Isometry (Padding.inclusionE p r n) ∧ DenseRange (Padding.inclusionE p r n) ∧
    Isometry (Padding.inclusionD p r n) ∧ DenseRange (Padding.inclusionD p r n) ∧
    (∀ i, Padding.inclusionE p r n (Padding.standardE p r n i) = Padding.basis p r n i) ∧
    (∀ i, Padding.inclusionD p r n (Padding.standardD p r n i) = Padding.basis p r n i) ∧
    (∀ i, ‖Padding.standardE p r n i‖ = 1) ∧
    (∀ i, ‖Padding.standardD p r n i‖ = 1) ∧
    Padding.delta p r n (Padding.basis p r n) = 1 ∧
    (∀ x : Fin (p+n) → Padding.H p r n, ‖Padding.delta p r n x‖ ≤ ∏ i, ‖x i‖) ∧
    (∀ x : Fin (p+n) → Padding.D p r n,
      (Padding.determinantD p r n x : L p r) =
        Padding.delta p r n (fun i => Padding.inclusionD p r n (x i))) ∧
    (Padding.determinantD p r n (Padding.standardD p r n) : L p r) = 1 ∧
    ‖Padding.determinantD p r n‖ = 1 ∧
    Submodule.span (K p r) (Set.range (fun x : Fin (p+n) → Padding.E p r n =>
      Padding.delta p r n (fun i => Padding.inclusionE p r n (x i)))) = primarySpan p r ∧
    Isometry (paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n) ∧
    (∀ m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r,
      (paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n m : L p r) =
        (m (Padding.standardE p r n) : L p r)) ∧
    (∀ (m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r)
        (x : Fin (p+n) → Padding.E p r n),
      (m x : L p r) = (paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n m : L p r) *
        Padding.delta p r n (fun i => Padding.inclusionE p r n (x i))) ∧
    (∀ (c : C p r) (x : Fin (p+n) → Padding.E p r n),
      ((paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n).symm c x : L p r) = (c : L p r) *
        Padding.delta p r n (fun i => Padding.inclusionE p r n (x i))) ∧
    (∀ m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r,
      ‖paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n m‖ = ‖m‖) ∧
    (∀ c : C p r, ‖(paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n).symm c‖ = ‖c‖) ∧
    (∀ (m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r)
        (x : Fin (p+n) → Padding.E p r n),
      paddedScalarExtension p r n m (fun i => Padding.inclusionE p r n (x i)) =
        (m x : L p r)) ∧
    (∀ (m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r)
        (x : Fin (p+n) → Padding.H p r n),
      paddedScalarExtension p r n m x =
        (paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n m : L p r) * Padding.delta p r n x) ∧
    (∀ m : Padding.E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r,
      ‖paddedScalarExtension p r n m‖ = ‖m‖)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨inferInstance, finrank_paddedAmbient p r n, Padding.norm_E p r n, Padding.norm_D p r n, Padding.norm_H p r n,
    (Padding.inclusionE p r n).isometry, Padding.denseRange_inclusionE p r n,
    (Padding.inclusionD p r n).isometry, Padding.denseRange_inclusionD p r n,
    Padding.inclusionE_standardE p r n, Padding.inclusionD_standardD p r n,
    Padding.norm_standardE p r n, Padding.norm_standardD p r n, Padding.delta_basis p r n,
    Padding.norm_delta_le p r n, Padding.determinantD_apply p r n,
    Padding.determinantD_standard p r n, Padding.norm_determinantD p r n,
    Padding.span_delta_E p r n, (paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n).isometry,
    paddedCoefficientEquiv_apply p r n, paddedCoefficientEquiv_pointwise p r n,
    paddedCoefficientEquiv_symm_apply p r n, norm_paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n,
    norm_paddedCoefficientEquiv_symm p r n, paddedScalarExtension_apply p r n,
    paddedScalarExtension_pointwise p r n, norm_paddedScalarExtension p r n⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.alternating_sum_apply
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, AlternatingMap.add_apply, ih]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.alternating_smulRight_apply
statement:
private theorem alternating_smulRight_apply (g : E [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[K] K)
    (z : F) (x : Fin k → E) : g.smulRight z x = g x • z
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.finiteCoordinateCodomainScalar_apply
statement:
theorem finiteCoordinateCodomainScalar_apply (b : Basis (Fin d) K E')
    (t : Fin k → Fin d) (f : Fin k → E →L[K] E') (x : Fin k → E) :
    finiteCoordinateCodomainScalar b t f x =
      Matrix.det (fun a j => b.coord (t a) (f a (x j)))
proof:
:= by
  change Matrix.det (Matrix.transpose (fun a j => b.coord (t a) (f a (x j)))) = _
  exact Matrix.det_transpose _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.finiteCoordinateCodomainRows_apply
statement:
theorem finiteCoordinateCodomainRows_apply (b : Basis (Fin d) K E')
    (t : Fin k → Fin d) (x : Fin k → E) (f : Fin k → E →L[K] E') :
    finiteCoordinateCodomainRows b t x f =
      Matrix.det (fun a j => b.coord (t a) (f a (x j)))
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.finiteCoordinateCodomainFamily_apply
statement:
theorem finiteCoordinateCodomainFamily_apply (b : Basis (Fin d) K E') (k : ℕ)
    (f : Fin k → E →L[K] E') (m : E' [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) (x : Fin k → E) :
    finiteCoordinateCodomainFamily b k f m x =
      ∑ s : Set.powersetCard (Fin d) k,
        Matrix.det (fun a j => b.coord (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s a)
          (f a (x j))) • m (fun a => b (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s a))
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteCoordinateCodomainFamily, alternating_sum_apply,
    finiteCoordinateCodomainScalar_apply]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.finiteCoordinateCodomainAlgebra_apply
statement:
theorem finiteCoordinateCodomainAlgebra_apply (b : Basis (Fin d) K E') (k : ℕ)
    (f : Fin k → E →L[K] E') (m : E' [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) (x : Fin k → E) :
    finiteCoordinateCodomainAlgebra b k f m x =
      ∑ s : Set.powersetCard (Fin d) k,
        Matrix.det (fun a j => b.coord (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s a)
          (f a (x j))) • m (fun a => b (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s a))
proof:
:=
  finiteCoordinateCodomainFamily_apply b k f m x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.finiteCoordinateCodomainAlgebra_map_eq_zero_of_eq
statement:
theorem finiteCoordinateCodomainAlgebra_map_eq_zero_of_eq
    (b : Basis (Fin d) K E') (k : ℕ) (f : Fin k → E →L[K] E')
    (m : E' [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) (x : Fin k → E) {i j : Fin k}
    (h : x i = x j) (hij : i ≠ j) : finiteCoordinateCodomainAlgebra b k f m x = 0
proof:
:=
  (finiteCoordinateCodomainAlgebra b k f m).map_eq_zero_of_eq x h hij

name: CZero.ofFiniteSupport_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofFiniteSupport_apply (f : I → K) (hf : f.HasFiniteSupport) (i : I) :
    ofFiniteSupport f hf i = f i
proof: := rfl

name: CZero.coordinate_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinate_apply (i j : I) :
    coordinate (K := K) i j = if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rfl

name: CZero.norm_apply_le
statement: theorem norm_apply_le (x : C₀(I, K)) (i : I) : ‖x i‖ ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_coe_le_norm x.toBCF i

name: CZero.norm_le
statement:
theorem norm_le {x : C₀(I, K)} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ C ↔ ∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ C
proof:
:=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le hC

name: CZero.norm_coordinate_le
statement: theorem norm_coordinate_le (i : I) : ‖coordinate (K := K) i‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (norm_le zero_le_one).mpr
  intro j
  simp only [coordinate_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: CZero.evalCLM_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem evalCLM_apply (i : I) (x : C₀(I, K)) : evalCLM i x = x i
proof: := rfl

name: CZero.norm_evalCLM_le
statement: theorem norm_evalCLM_le (i : I) : ‖evalCLM (K := K) i‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ zero_le_one _

name: CZero.truncate_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem truncate_apply (s : Finset I) (x : C₀(I, K)) (i : I) :
    truncate s x i = if i ∈ s then x i else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rfl

name: CZero.truncate_hasFiniteSupport
statement:
theorem truncate_hasFiniteSupport (s : Finset I) (x : C₀(I, K)) :
    (truncate s x : I → K).HasFiniteSupport
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply s.finite_toSet.subset
  intro i hi
  by_contra his
  have his' : i ∉ s := his
  simp [Function.mem_support, his'] at hi

name: CZero.norm_truncate_le
statement: theorem norm_truncate_le (s : Finset I) (x : C₀(I, K)) : ‖truncate s x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (norm_le (norm_nonneg x)).mpr
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i ∈ s
  · simpa [hi] using norm_apply_le x i
  · simp [hi]

name: CZero.truncation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem truncation_apply (s : Finset I) (x : C₀(I, K)) :
    truncation s x = truncate s x
proof: := rfl

name: CZero.norm_truncation_le
statement: theorem norm_truncation_le (s : Finset I) : ‖truncation (K := K) s‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ zero_le_one _

name: CZero.truncation_eq_sum
statement:
theorem truncation_eq_sum (s : Finset I) (x : C₀(I, K)) :
    truncation s x = ∑ i ∈ s, x i • coordinate (K := K) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext j
  change truncate s x j = evalCLM j (∑ i ∈ s, x i • coordinate (K := K) i)
  rw [map_sum]
  simp [map_smul, mul_ite]

name: CZero.tendsto_cofinite
statement: theorem tendsto_cofinite (x : C₀(I, K)) : Tendsto x cofinite (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Filter.cocompact_eq_cofinite] using zero_at_infty x

name: CZero.tendsto_truncation
statement:
theorem tendsto_truncation (x : C₀(I, K)) :
    Tendsto (fun s : Finset I => truncation s x) atTop (𝓝 x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ i in cofinite, ‖x i‖ < ε / 2 := by
    simpa only [dist_zero_right] using
      (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (tendsto_cofinite x) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε))
  have hfin : {i | ¬‖x i‖ < ε / 2}.Finite := eventually_cofinite.mp hsmall
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop hfin.toFinset] with s hs
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ (half_lt_self hε)
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  apply (norm_le (half_pos hε).le).mpr
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i ∈ s
  · simp [hi, (half_pos hε).le]
  · have hxi : ‖x i‖ < ε / 2 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hi (hs (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr h))
    simpa [hi] using hxi.le

name: CZero.dense_finiteSupport
statement:
theorem dense_finiteSupport :
    Dense {x : C₀(I, K) | (x : I → K).HasFiniteSupport}
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  exact mem_closure_of_tendsto (tendsto_truncation x)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun s => truncate_hasFiniteSupport s x)

name: CZero.coordinate_calculus
statement:
theorem coordinate_calculus :
    (∀ i j : I, coordinate (K := K) i j = if j = i then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ i : I, ‖coordinate (K := K) i‖ ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ (i : I) (x : C₀(I, K)), evalCLM i x = x i) ∧
    (∀ i : I, ‖evalCLM (K := K) i‖ ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ (s : Finset I) (x : C₀(I, K)) (i : I),
      truncation s x i = if i ∈ s then x i else 0) ∧
    (∀ s : Finset I, ‖truncation (K := K) s‖ ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ (s : Finset I) (x : C₀(I, K)),
      truncation s x = ∑ i ∈ s, x i • coordinate (K := K) i) ∧
    (∀ (s : Finset I) (x : C₀(I, K)), (truncation s x : I → K).HasFiniteSupport) ∧
    (∀ x : C₀(I, K), Tendsto (fun s : Finset I => truncation s x) atTop (𝓝 x)) ∧
    Dense {x : C₀(I, K) | (x : I → K).HasFiniteSupport}
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨coordinate_apply, norm_coordinate_le, evalCLM_apply, norm_evalCLM_le,
    fun s x i => truncate_apply s x i, norm_truncation_le, truncation_eq_sum,
    truncate_hasFiniteSupport, tendsto_truncation, dense_finiteSupport⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.HasFPowerSeriesAt.diagonal_mem_closedSubspace
statement:
theorem HasFPowerSeriesAt.diagonal_mem_closedSubspace
    (W : Submodule K Z) (hW : IsClosed (W : Set Z))
    {p : FormalMultilinearSeries K E Z} {f : E → Z} {x : E}
    (hf : HasFPowerSeriesAt f p x) (hmem : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y ∈ W)
    (n : ℕ) (y : E) : p n (fun _ => y) ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  let : IsClosed (W : Set Z) := hW
  have hq : HasFPowerSeriesAt (W.mkQL ∘ f) (W.mkQL.compFormalMultilinearSeries p) x := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hf
    exact ⟨r, W.mkQL.comp_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall hr⟩
  have hz : W.mkQL ∘ f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hmem] with z hz
    simpa using (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero W).mpr hz
  have hcoeff := (hq.congr hz).apply_eq_zero n y
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero W).mp hcoeff

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.scalarCoordinate_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem scalarCoordinate_apply (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) :
    scalarCoordinate p r n u = RigidDenseSource.Concrete.endScalarEquiv p r
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst (K p r) (OriginalE p r) (Fin n → K p r)).comp
        (u.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl (K p r) (OriginalE p r) (Fin n → K p r))))
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.auxiliaryCoordinate_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryCoordinate_apply (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n)
    (i j : Fin n) : auxiliaryCoordinate p r n i j u = (u (0, Pi.single j 1)).2 i
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.sourceBlock_apply
statement:
theorem sourceBlock_apply (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) (x : OriginalE p r) :
    (u (x, 0)).1 = scalarCoordinate p r n u • x
proof:
:=
  RigidDenseSource.Concrete.endScalarEquiv_apply p r (sourceBlock p r n u) x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.lowerLeft_eq_zero
statement:
theorem lowerLeft_eq_zero (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) (x : OriginalE p r) :
    (u (x, 0)).2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  let f : OriginalE p r →L[K p r] K p r :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd (K p r) (OriginalE p r) (Fin n → K p r)).comp
        (u.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl (K p r) (OriginalE p r) (Fin n → K p r))))
  exact congrArg (fun g : OriginalE p r →L[K p r] K p r => g x)
    (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.dual_eq_zero p r f)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.completedEndomorphism_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem completedEndomorphism_apply (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n)
    (x : E p r n) :
    completedEndomorphism p r n u (inclusionE p r n x) = inclusionE p r n (u x)
proof:
:=
  denseLinearExtension_apply (inclusionE p r n) (denseRange_inclusionE p r n) _ x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.standardE_castAdd
statement:
@[simp] theorem standardE_castAdd (i : Fin p) :
    standardE p r n (Fin.castAdd n i) = (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.standard p r i, 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [standardE]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.standardE_natAdd
statement:
@[simp] theorem standardE_natAdd (i : Fin n) :
    standardE p r n (Fin.natAdd p i) = (0, Pi.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [standardE]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.completedEndomorphism_matrix
statement:
theorem completedEndomorphism_matrix (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) :
    Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv.symm finSumFinEquiv.symm
      (LinearMap.toMatrix (basis p r n) (basis p r n)
        (completedEndomorphism p r n u).toLinearMap) =
    Matrix.fromBlocks
      (algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) (scalarCoordinate p r n u) •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) (L p r)))
      (upperRightMatrix p r n u) 0
      ((algebraMap (K p r) (L p r)).mapMatrix (auxiliaryMatrix p r n u))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Equiv.symm_symm,
    LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  cases i with
  | inl i =>
      cases j with
      | inl j =>
          change (basis p r n).repr
            (completedEndomorphism p r n u (basis p r n (Fin.castAdd n j)))
              (Fin.castAdd n i) = _
          rw [← inclusionE_standardE, completedEndomorphism_apply, standardE_castAdd,
            repr_castAdd]
          change TruncatedPolynomial.coeff (L p r) p (u
            (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.standard p r j, 0)).1 i = _
          rw [sourceBlock_apply]
          change TruncatedPolynomial.coeff (L p r) p
            ((scalarCoordinate p r n u) •
              (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.standard p r j : A p r)) i = _
          have hj : (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.standard p r j : A p r) = e p r j :=
            subtype_standard p r j
          rw [← algebraMap_smul (L p r), map_smul, hj]
          simp [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, e, TruncatedPolynomial.coeff_basis,
            eq_comm]
      | inr j =>
          change (basis p r n).repr
            (completedEndomorphism p r n u (basis p r n (Fin.natAdd p j)))
              (Fin.castAdd n i) = _
          rw [← inclusionE_standardE, completedEndomorphism_apply, standardE_natAdd,
            repr_castAdd]
          rfl
  | inr i =>
      cases j with
      | inl j =>
          change (basis p r n).repr
            (completedEndomorphism p r n u (basis p r n (Fin.castAdd n j)))
              (Fin.natAdd p i) = _
          rw [← inclusionE_standardE, completedEndomorphism_apply, standardE_castAdd,
            repr_natAdd]
          change algebraMap (K p r) (L p r)
            ((u (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.standard p r j, 0)).2 i) = 0
          rw [lowerLeft_eq_zero]
          exact map_zero _
      | inr j =>
          change (basis p r n).repr
            (completedEndomorphism p r n u (basis p r n (Fin.natAdd p j)))
              (Fin.natAdd p i) = _
          rw [← inclusionE_standardE, completedEndomorphism_apply, standardE_natAdd,
            repr_natAdd]
          rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.det_completedEndomorphism
statement:
theorem det_completedEndomorphism (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) :
    LinearMap.det (completedEndomorphism p r n u).toLinearMap =
      algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) (determinantFactor p r n u)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (basis p r n),
    ← Matrix.det_reindex_self finSumFinEquiv.symm,
    completedEndomorphism_matrix, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁,
    Matrix.det_smul, Matrix.det_one]
  simp only [determinantFactor, map_mul, map_pow, Fintype.card_fin, mul_one]
  rw [RingHom.map_det]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.delta_completedEndomorphism
statement:
theorem delta_completedEndomorphism (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n)
    (x : Fin (p+n) → H p r n) :
    delta p r n (fun i => completedEndomorphism p r n u (x i)) =
      algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) (determinantFactor p r n u) * delta p r n x
proof:
:= by
  change (basis p r n).det ((completedEndomorphism p r n u).toLinearMap ∘ x) = _
  rw [Module.Basis.det_comp, det_completedEndomorphism]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.pullback_eq_smul
statement:
theorem pullback_eq_smul (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n)
    (m : E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r) :
    m.compContinuousLinearMap u = determinantFactor p r n u • m
proof:
:= by
  apply (paddedCoefficientEquiv p r n).injective
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [map_smul, Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower, paddedCoefficientEquiv_apply]
  change (m (fun i => u (standardE p r n i)) : L p r) = _
  rw [paddedCoefficientEquiv_pointwise]
  have hd : delta p r n (fun i => inclusionE p r n (u (standardE p r n i))) =
      algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) (determinantFactor p r n u) := by
    simp_rw [← completedEndomorphism_apply, inclusionE_standardE]
    rw [delta_completedEndomorphism, delta_basis, mul_one]
  rw [hd, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.selfActionE_eq
statement:
theorem selfActionE_eq (h : (E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) ×
    (G p r →L[K p r] G p r)) :
    alternatingMapAction (p+n) h = determinantFactor p r n h.1 •
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousAlternatingMapCLM (K p r) (E p r n)
        (G p r) (G p r) (Fin (p+n)) h.2
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro m
  apply ContinuousAlternatingMap.ext
  intro x
  change h.2 ((m.compContinuousLinearMap h.1) x) = _
  rw [pullback_eq_smul]
  simp

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.analyticAt_determinantFactor
statement:
theorem analyticAt_determinantFactor (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) :
    AnalyticAt (K p r) (determinantFactor p r n) u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply ((scalarCoordinate p r n).analyticAt u).pow p |>.mul
  simp only [auxiliaryMatrix, Matrix.det_apply']
  apply Finset.analyticAt_fun_sum
  intro σ _
  exact analyticAt_const.mul
    (Finset.analyticAt_fun_prod _ (fun i _ =>
      (auxiliaryCoordinate p r n (σ i) i).analyticAt u))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.selfActionE_function_eq
statement:
theorem selfActionE_function_eq :
    (alternatingMapAction (K := K p r) (E := E p r n) (E' := E p r n)
      (F := G p r) (F' := G p r) (p+n)) =
    (fun h : (E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) × (G p r →L[K p r] G p r) =>
      determinantFactor p r n h.1 • selfPostcomposition p r n h.2)
proof:
:=
  funext (selfActionE_eq p r n)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.analyticAt_selfActionE
statement:
theorem analyticAt_selfActionE (h : (E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) ×
    (G p r →L[K p r] G p r)) :
    AnalyticAt (K p r)
      (alternatingMapAction (K := K p r) (E := E p r n) (E' := E p r n)
        (F := G p r) (F' := G p r) (p+n)) h
proof:
:= by
  let : IsBoundedSMul (K p r)
      ((E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r) →L[K p r]
        (E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r)) :=
    NormedSpace.toIsBoundedSMul (𝕜 := K p r)
      (E := (E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r) →L[K p r]
        (E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r))
  have hs : AnalyticAt (K p r)
      (fun z : (E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) × (G p r →L[K p r] G p r) =>
        determinantFactor p r n z.1) h :=
    (analyticAt_determinantFactor p r n h.1).comp analyticAt_fst
  have hp : AnalyticAt (K p r) (selfPostcomposition p r n) h.2 :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.analyticAt (𝕜 := K p r)
      (E := G p r →L[K p r] G p r)
      (F := (E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r) →L[K p r]
        (E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r))
      (selfPostcomposition p r n) h.2
  have hv : AnalyticAt (K p r)
      (fun z : (E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) × (G p r →L[K p r] G p r) =>
        selfPostcomposition p r n z.2) h := hp.comp analyticAt_snd
  rw [selfActionE_function_eq]
  exact hs.smul hv

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.padded_analytic_self_action
statement:
theorem padded_analytic_self_action :
    (∀ (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) (x : E p r n),
      completedEndomorphism p r n u (inclusionE p r n x) = inclusionE p r n (u x)) ∧
    (∀ (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) (x : OriginalE p r),
      (u (x, 0)).1 = scalarCoordinate p r n u • x ∧ (u (x, 0)).2 = 0) ∧
    (∀ u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n,
      scalarCoordinate p r n u = RigidDenseSource.Concrete.endScalarEquiv p r
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst (K p r) (OriginalE p r) (Fin n → K p r)).comp
          (u.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl (K p r) (OriginalE p r) (Fin n → K p r))))) ∧
    (∀ (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) (i j : Fin n),
      auxiliaryCoordinate p r n i j u = (u (0, Pi.single j 1)).2 i) ∧
    (∀ u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n,
      Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv.symm finSumFinEquiv.symm
        (LinearMap.toMatrix (basis p r n) (basis p r n)
          (completedEndomorphism p r n u).toLinearMap) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks
        (algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) (scalarCoordinate p r n u) •
          (1 : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) (L p r)))
        (upperRightMatrix p r n u) 0
        ((algebraMap (K p r) (L p r)).mapMatrix (auxiliaryMatrix p r n u))) ∧
    (∀ u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n,
      LinearMap.det (completedEndomorphism p r n u).toLinearMap =
        algebraMap (K p r) (L p r)
          (scalarCoordinate p r n u ^ p * (auxiliaryMatrix p r n u).det)) ∧
    (∀ (u : E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n)
        (m : E p r n [⋀^Fin (p+n)]→L[K p r] G p r),
      m.compContinuousLinearMap u = determinantFactor p r n u • m) ∧
    (∀ h : (E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) × (G p r →L[K p r] G p r),
      alternatingMapAction (p+n) h = determinantFactor p r n h.1 •
        ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousAlternatingMapCLM (K p r) (E p r n)
          (G p r) (G p r) (Fin (p+n)) h.2) ∧
    (∀ h : (E p r n →L[K p r] E p r n) × (G p r →L[K p r] G p r),
      AnalyticAt (K p r)
        (alternatingMapAction (K := K p r) (E := E p r n) (E' := E p r n)
          (F := G p r) (F' := G p r) (p+n)) h)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨completedEndomorphism_apply p r n,
    fun u x => ⟨sourceBlock_apply p r n u x, lowerLeft_eq_zero p r n u x⟩,
    scalarCoordinate_apply p r n, auxiliaryCoordinate_apply p r n,
    completedEndomorphism_matrix p r n, det_completedEndomorphism p r n,
    pullback_eq_smul p r n, selfActionE_eq p r n, analyticAt_selfActionE p r n⟩

name: ContinuousLinearMap.norm_add_le_max_of_ultrametric
statement:
theorem norm_add_le_max_of_ultrametric (f g : E →L[K] F) :
    ‖f + g‖ ≤ max ‖f‖ ‖g‖
proof:
:= by
  refine (f + g).opNorm_le_bound (le_max_of_le_left (norm_nonneg f)) fun x => ?_
  calc
    ‖(f + g) x‖ = ‖f x + g x‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ max ‖f x‖ ‖g x‖ := IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _
    _ ≤ max ‖f‖ ‖g‖ * ‖x‖ := by
      rw [max_mul_of_nonneg _ _ (norm_nonneg x)]
      exact max_le_max (f.le_opNorm x) (g.le_opNorm x)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.alternatingMapAction_target_properties
statement:
theorem alternatingMapAction_target_properties (k : ℕ) :
    let W := (E [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) →L[K] (E' [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F')
    let Z := (E [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) →L[K]
      ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin k => E') F'
    CompleteSpace (E' [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F') ∧ IsUltrametricDist (E' [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F') ∧
      CompleteSpace W ∧ IsUltrametricDist W ∧ CompleteSpace Z ∧ IsUltrametricDist Z
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticAt_alternatingMapAction_comp_of_c0_equiv

    (hγ : AnalyticAt K γ x) : AnalyticAt K (alternatingMapAction k ∘ γ) x
proof:
:= by
  apply c0_analyticAt_linearIsometry_of_equiv e
    (Z := (E [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) →L[K]
      ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin k => E') F')
    (alternatingMapActionInclusion (K := K) (E := E) (E' := E') (F := F) (F' := F') k)
  exact (analyticAt_ambient_alternatingMapAction k (γ x)).comp hγ

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticAt_alternatingMapAction_comp_of_c0

:=

name: AlternatingAnalytic.isAdmissibleOn_of_c0_equiv

name: AlternatingAnalytic.isAdmissibleOn_of_c0

name: AlternatingAnalytic.c0_analytic_family_admissibility
statement:
theorem c0_analytic_family_admissibility (k : ℕ) :
    let W := (E [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) →L[K] (E' [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F')
    let Z := (E [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) →L[K]
      ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin k => E') F'
    CompleteSpace (E' [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F') ∧ IsUltrametricDist (E' [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F') ∧
    CompleteSpace W ∧ IsUltrametricDist W ∧ CompleteSpace Z ∧ IsUltrametricDist Z ∧
    (∀ (γ : C₀(I, K) → (E' →L[K] E) × (F →L[K] F')) (x : C₀(I, K)),
      AnalyticAt K γ x → AnalyticAt K (alternatingMapAction k ∘ γ) x) ∧
    (∀ (γ : C₀(I, K) → (E' →L[K] E) × (F →L[K] F')) (U : Set C₀(I, K)),
      AnalyticOnNhd K γ U → IsAdmissibleOn k γ U) ∧
    (∀ (γ : C₀(I, K) → (E' →L[K] E) × (F →L[K] F')) (U : Set C₀(I, K)),
      IsOpen U → AnalyticOn K γ U →
        AnalyticOn K (alternatingMapAction k ∘ γ) U ∧ IsAdmissibleOn k γ U) ∧
    (∀ _ : P ≃L[K] C₀(I, K),
      (∀ (γ : P → (E' →L[K] E) × (F →L[K] F')) (x : P),
        AnalyticAt K γ x → AnalyticAt K (alternatingMapAction k ∘ γ) x) ∧
      (∀ (γ : P → (E' →L[K] E) × (F →L[K] F')) (U : Set P),
        AnalyticOnNhd K γ U → IsAdmissibleOn k γ U) ∧
      (∀ (γ : P → (E' →L[K] E) × (F →L[K] F')) (U : Set P),
        IsOpen U → AnalyticOn K γ U →
          AnalyticOn K (alternatingMapAction k ∘ γ) U ∧ IsAdmissibleOn k γ U))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hA', hW, hW', hZ, hZ'⟩ := alternatingMapAction_target_properties
    (K := K) (E := E) (E' := E') (F := F) (F' := F') k
  refine ⟨hA, hA', hW, hW', hZ, hZ', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun _ _ hγ => analyticAt_alternatingMapAction_comp_of_c0 k hγ
  · exact fun _ _ hγ => isAdmissibleOn_of_c0 k hγ
  · intro γ U hU hγ
    have h := isAdmissibleOn_of_c0_of_isOpen k hU hγ
    exact ⟨h.2.analyticOn, h⟩
  · intro e
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact fun _ _ hγ => analyticAt_alternatingMapAction_comp_of_c0_equiv e k hγ
    · exact fun _ _ hγ => isAdmissibleOn_of_c0_equiv e k hγ
    · intro γ U hU hγ
      have h := isAdmissibleOn_of_c0_equiv_of_isOpen e k hU hγ
      exact ⟨h.2.analyticOn, h⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.baseChangeSeminorm_tmul_one
statement:
theorem baseChangeSeminorm_tmul_one (v : V) :
    baseChangeSeminorm K V L (v ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : L)) = ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · simpa only [norm_one, mul_one] using baseChangeSeminorm_tmul_le K V L v (1 : L)
  · obtain ⟨π, hπ, hfix⟩ := exists_scalar_projection K L
    have hone : π (1 : L) = 1 := by simpa using hfix 1
    have h := norm_scalarContraction_le π (v ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : L))
    simp only [scalarContraction_tmul, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, hone, one_smul] at h
    exact h.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hπ (apply_nonneg _ _)).trans_eq (one_mul _))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_completedScalarContraction_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_completedScalarContraction_apply_le (ψ : L →L[K] K)
    (x : CompletedBaseChange K V L) :
    ‖completedScalarContraction K V L ψ x‖ ≤ ‖ψ‖ * ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  induction x using UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on with
  | hp =>
    exact isClosed_le (completedScalarContraction K V L ψ).continuous.norm
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm)
  | ih u =>
    change ‖completedScalarContraction K V L ψ (baseChangeToCompletionK K V L u)‖ ≤
      ‖ψ‖ * ‖baseChangeToCompletionK K V L u‖
    rw [completedScalarContraction_apply_tensor, (baseChangeToCompletionK K V L).norm_map]
    exact norm_scalarContraction_le ψ u

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_completedScalarContraction_le
statement:
theorem norm_completedScalarContraction_le (ψ : L →L[K] K) :
    ‖completedScalarContraction K V L ψ‖ ≤ ‖ψ‖
proof:
:=
  ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg ψ)
    (norm_completedScalarContraction_apply_le K V L ψ)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exists_completedBaseChange_retraction
statement:
theorem exists_completedBaseChange_retraction :
    ∃ P : CompletedBaseChange K V L →L[K] V,
      ‖P‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ v : V, P (completedBaseChangeEmbedding K V L v) = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hfix⟩ := exists_scalar_projection K L
  refine ⟨completedScalarContraction K V L π,
    (norm_completedScalarContraction_le K V L π).trans hπ, ?_⟩
  intro v
  have hone : π (1 : L) = 1 := by simpa using hfix 1
  simp [hone]

    multilinearExtension p r m x ∈ G p r
proof:
:= by
  let d : Fin p → D p r := fun i => ⟨x i, hx i⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.w_mem_D
statement: theorem w_mem_D (t : Tau p) : w p r t ∈ D p r
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | inl b => exact e_mem_D p r b
  | inr bc => exact (D p r).add_mem (e_mem_D p r bc.val.1) (e_mem_D p r bc.val.2)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.tau_smul_w_mem_D

proof:
:=
  gen_mem_D p r (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr t)))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.multilinearExtension_repeated_w_certificates
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · apply multilinearExtension_mem_G
    intro k
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst k
      simpa using w_mem_D p r t
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst k
      simpa [hij] using w_mem_D p r t
    simpa [hkj, hki] using e_mem_D p r (f k)
  · have hmem := multilinearExtension_mem_G p r m
      (update (update (fun k => e p r (f k)) i (tau p r t • w p r t))
        j (tau p r t • w p r t)) (by
          intro k
          by_cases hkj : k = j
          · subst k
            simpa using tau_smul_w_mem_D p r t
          by_cases hki : k = i
          · subst k
            simpa [hij] using tau_smul_w_mem_D p r t
          simpa [hkj, hki] using e_mem_D p r (f k))
    rw [multilinear_repeated_update_smul _ i j hij] at hmem
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, pow_two, mul_assoc] using hmem

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.multilinearExtension_repeated_w_eq_zero
statement:
theorem multilinearExtension_repeated_w_eq_zero
    (m : ContinuousMultilinearMap (K p r) (fun _ : Fin p => D p r) (G p r))
    (f : Fin p → Fin p) (i j : Fin p) (hij : i ≠ j) (t : Tau p) :
    multilinearExtension p r m
      (update (update (fun k => e p r (f k)) i (w p r t)) j (w p r t)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hc, htc⟩ := multilinearExtension_repeated_w_certificates p r m f i j hij t
  exact eq_zero_of_tau_sq_mul_mem p r t hc htc

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.multilinearExtension_repeated_basis_eq_zero
statement:
theorem multilinearExtension_repeated_basis_eq_zero
    (m : ContinuousMultilinearMap (K p r) (fun _ : Fin p => D p r) (G p r))
    (f : Fin p → Fin p) (i j : Fin p) (hij : i ≠ j) (b : Fin p) :
    multilinearExtension p r m
      (update (update (fun k => e p r (f k)) i (e p r b)) j (e p r b)) = 0
proof:
:=
  multilinearExtension_repeated_w_eq_zero p r m f i j hij (Sum.inl b)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.multilinearExtension_repeated_basis_add_eq_zero

theorem multilinearExtension_repeated_basis_add_eq_zero
    (m : ContinuousMultilinearMap (K p r) (fun _ : Fin p => D p r) (G p r))
    (f : Fin p → Fin p) (i j : Fin p) (hij : i ≠ j) (b c : Fin p) (hbc : b < c) :
    multilinearExtension p r m
      (update (update (fun k => e p r (f k)) i (e p r b + e p r c))
        j (e p r b + e p r c)) = 0
proof:
:=
  multilinearExtension_repeated_w_eq_zero p r m f i j hij (Sum.inr ⟨(b, c), hbc⟩)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.multilinearExtension_basis_cross_sum_zero
statement:
theorem multilinearExtension_basis_cross_sum_zero
    (m : ContinuousMultilinearMap (K p r) (fun _ : Fin p => D p r) (G p r))
    (f : Fin p → Fin p) (i j : Fin p) (hij : i ≠ j) (b c : Fin p) :
    multilinearExtension p r m
        (update (update (fun k => e p r (f k)) i (e p r c)) j (e p r b)) +
      multilinearExtension p r m
        (update (update (fun k => e p r (f k)) i (e p r b)) j (e p r c)) = 0
proof:
:=
  multilinear_basis_cross_sum_zero (multilinearExtension p r m)
    (TruncatedPolynomial.basis (L p r) p)
    (multilinearExtension_repeated_basis_eq_zero p r m)
    (multilinearExtension_repeated_basis_add_eq_zero p r m) f i j hij b c

    (x : Fin p → A p r) (i j : Fin p) (hx : x i = x j) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    multilinearExtension p r m x = 0
proof:
:=
  multilinear_alternating_of_basis_repeated (multilinearExtension p r m)
    (TruncatedPolynomial.basis (L p r) p)
    (multilinearExtension_repeated_basis_eq_zero p r m)
    (multilinearExtension_repeated_basis_add_eq_zero p r m) x i j hx hij

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.multilinear_map_eq_zero_of_eq
statement:
theorem multilinear_map_eq_zero_of_eq
    (m : ContinuousMultilinearMap (K p r) (fun _ : Fin p => D p r) (G p r))
    (x : Fin p → D p r) (i j : Fin p) (hx : x i = x j) (hij : i ≠ j) : m x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (m x : L p r) = 0
  rw [← multilinearExtension_apply p r m x]
  exact multilinearExtension_map_eq_zero_of_eq p r m (fun k => (x k : A p r)) i j
    (congrArg Subtype.val hx) hij

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.norm_retractionR_le
statement: theorem norm_retractionR_le : ‖retractionR p r‖ ≤ 1

  (allAlternatingEquiv p r).symm.toLinearIsometry.norm_toContinuousLinearMap_le

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.all_multilinear_maps_alternating
statement:
theorem all_multilinear_maps_alternating :
    (∀ (m : ContinuousMultilinearMap (K p r) (fun _ : Fin p => D p r) (G p r))
      (x : Fin p → D p r),
      multilinearExtension p r m (fun i => (x i : A p r)) = (m x : L p r)) ∧
    (∀ m, ‖multilinearExtension p r m‖ = ‖m‖) ∧
    (∀ m (x : Fin p → A p r) (i j : Fin p), x i = x j → i ≠ j →
      multilinearExtension p r m x = 0) ∧
    (∀ (m : ContinuousMultilinearMap (K p r) (fun _ : Fin p => D p r) (G p r))
      (x : Fin p → D p r) (i j : Fin p), x i = x j → i ≠ j → m x = 0) ∧
    Function.Surjective (ContinuousAlternatingMap.toContinuousMultilinearMapLI :
      (D p r [⋀^Fin p]→L[K p r] G p r) →ₗᵢ[K p r]
        ContinuousMultilinearMap (K p r) (fun _ : Fin p => D p r) (G p r)) ∧
    (∀ a, allAlternatingEquiv p r a = inclusionJ p r a) ∧
    (∀ a, retractionR p r (inclusionJ p r a) = a) ∧
    (∀ m, inclusionJ p r (retractionR p r m) = m) ∧
    (∀ m x, retractionR p r m x = m x) ∧
    (∀ m, ‖retractionR p r m‖ = ‖m‖) ∧ ‖retractionR p r‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨multilinearExtension_apply p r, norm_multilinearExtension p r,
    multilinearExtension_map_eq_zero_of_eq p r, multilinear_map_eq_zero_of_eq p r,
    toContinuousMultilinearMapLI_surjective p r, fun _ => rfl,
    retractionR_inclusionJ p r, inclusionJ_retractionR p r, retractionR_apply p r,
    norm_retractionR_apply p r, norm_retractionR_le p r⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.alternatingMapAction_zero_const

name: AlternatingAnalytic.alternatingMapAction_zero_conjugate_apply

theorem alternatingMapAction_zero_conjugate_apply
    (u : E' →L[K] E) (v : F →L[K] F') (y : F) :
    (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE K E' F' (Fin 0)).symm
        (alternatingMapAction 0 (u, v)
          (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE K E F (Fin 0) y)) = v y
proof:
:= by
  rw [alternatingMapAction_zero_const]
  exact (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE K E' F' (Fin 0)).symm_apply_apply _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.alternatingMapAction_zero_conjugate
statement:
theorem alternatingMapAction_zero_conjugate (u : E' →L[K] E) (v : F →L[K] F') :
    ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE K E' F' (Fin 0)).symm :
      (E' [⋀^Fin 0]→L[K] F') →L[K] F').comp
        ((alternatingMapAction 0 (u, v)).comp
          (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE K E F (Fin 0) :
            F →L[K] (E [⋀^Fin 0]→L[K] F))) =
      v

:= by
  ext y
  exact alternatingMapAction_zero_conjugate_apply u v y

name: AlternatingAnalytic.alternatingMapAction_zero_eq
statement:
theorem alternatingMapAction_zero_eq (u : E' →L[K] E) (v : F →L[K] F') :
    alternatingMapAction 0 (u, v) =
      (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE K E' F' (Fin 0) :
        F' →L[K] (E' [⋀^Fin 0]→L[K] F')).comp
        (v.comp
          ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE K E F (Fin 0)).symm :
            (E [⋀^Fin 0]→L[K] F) →L[K] F))
proof:
:= by
  ext m x
  change v (m (fun i => u (x i))) = v (m 0)
  exact congrArg (fun z => v (m z)) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.alternatingMapAction_zero_independent
statement:
theorem alternatingMapAction_zero_independent (u₁ u₂ : E' →L[K] E) (v : F →L[K] F') :
    alternatingMapAction 0 (u₁, v) = alternatingMapAction 0 (u₂, v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [alternatingMapAction_zero_eq u₁ v, alternatingMapAction_zero_eq u₂ v]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_alternatingMapAction_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_alternatingMapAction_zero (u : E' →L[K] E) (v : F →L[K] F') :
    ‖alternatingMapAction 0 (u, v)‖ = ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [alternatingMapAction_zero_eq]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_linearIsometryEquiv_comp _ _).trans
    (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_linearIsometryEquiv _ _)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.alternatingMapAction_zero
statement:
theorem alternatingMapAction_zero (u : E' →L[K] E) (v : F →L[K] F') :
    (∀ y : F, alternatingMapAction 0 (u, v)
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE K E F (Fin 0) y) =
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE K E' F' (Fin 0) (v y)) ∧
    ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE K E' F' (Fin 0)).symm :
      (E' [⋀^Fin 0]→L[K] F') →L[K] F').comp
        ((alternatingMapAction 0 (u, v)).comp
          (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE K E F (Fin 0) :
            F →L[K] (E [⋀^Fin 0]→L[K] F))) = v ∧
    (∀ u' : E' →L[K] E, alternatingMapAction 0 (u, v) = alternatingMapAction 0 (u', v)) ∧
    ‖alternatingMapAction 0 (u, v)‖ = ‖v‖
proof:
:=
  ⟨alternatingMapAction_zero_const u v, alternatingMapAction_zero_conjugate u v,
    (fun u' => alternatingMapAction_zero_independent u u' v),
    norm_alternatingMapAction_zero u v⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exists_norm_eq_of_discrete
statement:
theorem exists_norm_eq_of_discrete (e : ℝ) (he : 1 < e)
    (hdiscrete : ∀ y : Y, y ≠ 0 → ∃ n : ℤ, ‖y‖ = e ^ n)
    (f : S →ᵇ Y) (hf : f ≠ 0) : ∃ s : S, f s ≠ 0 ∧ ‖f‖ = ‖f s‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnonzero : ∃ s, f s ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hf
    ext s
    exact h s
  let exponents : Set ℤ := {n | ∃ s, f s ≠ 0 ∧ ‖f s‖ = e ^ n}
  have hne : exponents.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hnonzero
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hdiscrete (f s) hs
    exact ⟨n, s, hs, hn⟩
  obtain ⟨N, _, hN⟩ := exists_nat_pow_near (le_max_left 1 ‖f‖) he
  have hbound : ‖f‖ ≤ e ^ (N + 1) := (le_max_right 1 ‖f‖).trans hN.le
  have hbdd : BddAbove exponents := by
    refine ⟨(N + 1 : ℕ), ?_⟩
    rintro n ⟨s, hs, hn⟩
    apply (zpow_le_zpow_iff_right₀ he).1
    calc
      e ^ n = ‖f s‖ := hn.symm
      _ ≤ ‖f‖ := f.norm_coe_le_norm s
      _ ≤ e ^ ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by simpa only [zpow_natCast] using hbound
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hn⟩ := Int.csSup_mem hne hbdd
  refine ⟨s, hs, le_antisymm ?_ (f.norm_coe_le_norm s)⟩
  apply (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (norm_nonneg (f s))).2
  intro t
  by_cases ht : f t = 0
  · simp [ht]
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hdiscrete (f t) ht
    rw [hm, hn]
    exact (zpow_le_zpow_iff_right₀ he).2 (le_csSup hbdd ⟨t, ht, hm⟩)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.basis_eq_pow
statement: theorem basis_eq_pow (i : Fin n) : basis L n i = epsilon L n ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basis, Module.Basis.reindex_apply,
    (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' (Polynomial.monic_X_pow n :
      (Polynomial.X ^ n : Polynomial L).Monic)).basis_eq_pow]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.epsilon_pow
statement: @[simp] theorem epsilon_pow : epsilon L n ^ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root (Polynomial.X ^ n : Polynomial L)
  simpa [epsilon] using h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.epsilon_pow_eq_zero
statement: theorem epsilon_pow_eq_zero {m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) : epsilon L n ^ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [pow_add, epsilon_pow, zero_mul]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.coeff_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_basis (i j : Fin n) :
    coeff L n (basis L n i) j = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (basis L n).equivFun_self i j

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.coeff_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_pow (m : ℕ) (k : Fin n) :
    coeff L n (epsilon L n ^ m) k = if m = (k : ℕ) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m < n
  · rw [← basis_eq_pow L n ⟨m, hm⟩, coeff_basis]
    simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
  · rw [epsilon_pow_eq_zero L n (Nat.le_of_not_gt hm)]
    have hmk : m ≠ (k : ℕ) := by omega
    simp [hmk]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.expansion
statement: theorem expansion (x : A L n) : x = ∑ i : Fin n, coeff L n x i • basis L n i
proof:
:= by
  exact ((basis L n).sum_equivFun x).symm

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_mul (x y : A L n) (k : Fin n) :
    coeff L n (x * y) k =
      ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n,
        if (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) then coeff L n x i * coeff L n y j else 0
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [expansion L n x, expansion L n y]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, smul_mul_smul_comm,
    basis_eq_pow, ← pow_add, map_sum, map_smul, Finset.sum_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, coeff_pow, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.coefficientIsometry_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coefficientIsometry_apply (x : A L n) :
    coefficientIsometry L n x = coeff L n x
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.coefficientIsometry_symm_apply
statement:
theorem coefficientIsometry_symm_apply (v : Fin n → L) :
    (coefficientIsometry L n).symm v = ∑ i : Fin n, v i • epsilon L n ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  change (basis L n).equivFun.symm v = _
  rw [Module.Basis.equivFun_symm_apply]
  simp_rw [basis_eq_pow]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.norm_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_coeff (x : A L n) : ‖coeff L n x‖ = ‖x‖
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.norm_eq_max
statement:
theorem norm_eq_max (x : A L n) :
    ‖x‖ = (Finset.univ.sup fun i : Fin n => ‖coeff L n x i‖₊ : ℝ≥0)
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.norm_coefficient_le
statement:
theorem norm_coefficient_le (x : A L n) (i : Fin n) :
    ‖coeff L n x i‖ ≤ ‖x‖
proof: := norm_le_pi_norm (coeff L n x) i

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.norm_basis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_basis (i : Fin n) : ‖basis L n i‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← norm_coeff]
  have h : coeff L n (basis L n i) = Pi.single i 1 := by
    ext j
    simp [coeff_basis, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
  rw [h, Pi.norm_single, norm_one]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.norm_epsilon_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_epsilon_pow (i : Fin n) : ‖epsilon L n ^ (i : ℕ)‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← basis_eq_pow, norm_basis]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.norm_mul_le
statement: theorem norm_mul_le (x y : A L n) : ‖x * y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖
proof:
:= by
  change ‖coeff L n (x * y)‖ ≤ ‖coeff L n x‖ * ‖coeff L n y‖
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).2
  intro k
  rw [coeff_mul]
  change ‖∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n,
    if (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) then coeff L n x i * coeff L n y j else 0‖₊ ≤
      ‖coeff L n x‖₊ * ‖coeff L n y‖₊
  apply (Finset.nnnorm_sum_le_sup_nnnorm _ _).trans
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro i _
  apply (Finset.nnnorm_sum_le_sup_nnnorm _ _).trans
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro j _
  split_ifs
  · rw [nnnorm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul' (nnnorm_le_pi_nnnorm _ i) (nnnorm_le_pi_nnnorm _ j)
  · simp

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.max_norm_properties
statement:
theorem max_norm_properties [NeZero n] :
    (∀ x : A L n,
      ‖x‖ = (Finset.univ.sup fun i : Fin n => ‖coeff L n x i‖₊ : ℝ≥0)) ∧
      Isometry (coefficientIsometry L n) ∧
      (∀ x : A L n, coefficientIsometry L n x = coeff L n x) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin n → L,
        (coefficientIsometry L n).symm v = ∑ i : Fin n, v i • epsilon L n ^ (i : ℕ)) ∧
      (∀ (x y : A L n) (k : Fin n),
        coeff L n (x * y) k =
          ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n,
            if (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) then coeff L n x i * coeff L n y j else 0) ∧
      (CompleteSpace L → CompleteSpace (A L n)) ∧
      epsilon L n ^ n = 0 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, basis L n i = epsilon L n ^ (i : ℕ)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, ‖basis L n i‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, ‖epsilon L n ^ (i : ℕ)‖ = 1) ∧
      ‖(1 : A L n)‖ = 1 ∧
      (∀ x y : A L n, ‖x * y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨norm_eq_max L n, (coefficientIsometry L n).isometry,
    coefficientIsometry_apply L n, coefficientIsometry_symm_apply L n,
    coeff_mul L n, fun _ => instCompleteSpace L n, epsilon_pow L n,
    basis_eq_pow L n, norm_basis L n, norm_epsilon_pow L n, norm_one, norm_mul_le L n⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.TruncatedPolynomial.prime_max_norm_properties
statement:
theorem prime_max_norm_properties (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    (∀ x : A L p,
      ‖x‖ = (Finset.univ.sup fun i : Fin p => ‖coeff L p x i‖₊ : ℝ≥0)) ∧
      Isometry (coefficientIsometry L p) ∧
      (∀ x : A L p, coefficientIsometry L p x = coeff L p x) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin p → L,
        (coefficientIsometry L p).symm v = ∑ i : Fin p, v i • epsilon L p ^ (i : ℕ)) ∧
      (∀ (x y : A L p) (k : Fin p),
        coeff L p (x * y) k =
          ∑ i : Fin p, ∑ j : Fin p,
            if (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) then coeff L p x i * coeff L p y j else 0) ∧
      (CompleteSpace L → CompleteSpace (A L p)) ∧
      epsilon L p ^ p = 0 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin p, basis L p i = epsilon L p ^ (i : ℕ)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin p, ‖basis L p i‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin p, ‖epsilon L p ^ (i : ℕ)‖ = 1) ∧
      ‖(1 : A L p)‖ = 1 ∧
      (∀ x y : A L p, ‖x * y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖)
proof:
:=
  max_norm_properties L p

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_lift_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_lift_apply_le (n : ℕ)
    (P : (E →L[K] E) [×n]→L[K]
      ((E [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F) →L[K] (E [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F)))
    (f : Fin n → E →L[K] E) :
    ‖P f‖ ≤ ‖P‖ * ∏ i, ‖f i‖
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set ℝ := {c | 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ fs : Fin n → E →L[K] E,
    ‖P fs‖ ≤ c * ∏ i, ‖fs i‖}
  have hclosed : IsClosed S := by
    dsimp only [S]
    simp only [Set.ofPred_and, Set.ofPred_forall]
    exact isClosed_Ici.inter (isClosed_iInter fun fs =>
      isClosed_le continuous_const (by fun_prop))
  have hnonempty : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := ContinuousMultilinearMap.bound (𝕜 := K)
      (E := fun _ : Fin n => E →L[K] E)
      (G := (E [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F) →L[K] (E [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F)) P
    exact ⟨C, hC.le, hbound⟩
  have hbelow : BddBelow S := ⟨0, fun _ h => h.1⟩
  change ‖P f‖ ≤ sInf S * ∏ i, ‖f i‖
  exact (hclosed.isLeast_csInf hnonempty hbelow).1.2 f

name: AlternatingAnalytic.baseChangeFormRestriction_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeFormRestriction_apply
    (r : CompletedBaseChange K F L →L[K] F) (n : ℕ)
    (m : CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L)
    (x : Fin n → E) :
    baseChangeFormRestriction K E F L r n m x =
      r (m (fun i => completedBaseChangeEmbedding K E L (x i)))
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_baseChangeFormRestriction_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_baseChangeFormRestriction_apply_le
    (r : CompletedBaseChange K F L →L[K] F) (n : ℕ)
    (m : CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L) :
    ‖baseChangeFormRestriction K E F L r n m‖ ≤ ‖r‖ * ‖m‖
proof:
:= by
  change ‖r.compContinuousAlternatingMap
    ((m.restrictScalars K).compContinuousLinearMap
      (completedBaseChangeEmbedding K E L).toContinuousLinearMap)‖ ≤ ‖r‖ * ‖m‖
  apply (r.norm_compContinuousAlternatingMap_le _).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (norm_nonneg r)
  exact (m.restrictScalars K).toContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuous_linearIsometry_le
    (fun _ => completedBaseChangeEmbedding K E L)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_baseChangeFormRestriction_le
statement:
theorem norm_baseChangeFormRestriction_le
    (r : CompletedBaseChange K F L →L[K] F) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖baseChangeFormRestriction K E F L r n‖ ≤ ‖r‖
proof:
:=
  ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg r)
    (norm_baseChangeFormRestriction_apply_le K E F L r n)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.baseChangeLiftRestriction_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeLiftRestriction_apply
    (r : CompletedBaseChange K F L →L[K] F) (n : ℕ)
    (T : (CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L) →L[L]
      (CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L))
    (m : E [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F) (x : Fin n → E) :
    baseChangeLiftRestriction K E F L r n T m x =
      r (T (baseChangeAlternatingForms K E F L n m)
        (fun i => completedBaseChangeEmbedding K E L (x i)))
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_baseChangeLiftRestriction_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_baseChangeLiftRestriction_apply_le
    (r : CompletedBaseChange K F L →L[K] F) (n : ℕ)
    (T : (CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L) →L[L]
      (CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L)) :
    ‖baseChangeLiftRestriction K E F L r n T‖ ≤ ‖r‖ * ‖T‖
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg r) (norm_nonneg T))
  intro m
  change ‖baseChangeFormRestriction K E F L r n
    (T (baseChangeAlternatingForms K E F L n m))‖ ≤ (‖r‖ * ‖T‖) * ‖m‖
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖r‖ * ‖T (baseChangeAlternatingForms K E F L n m)‖ :=
      norm_baseChangeFormRestriction_apply_le K E F L r n _
    _ ≤ ‖r‖ * (‖T‖ * ‖baseChangeAlternatingForms K E F L n m‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (T.le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg r)
    _ ≤ ‖r‖ * (‖T‖ * ‖m‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_baseChangeAlternatingForms_apply_le K E F L n m)
        (norm_nonneg T)) (norm_nonneg r)
    _ = (‖r‖ * ‖T‖) * ‖m‖ := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: AlternatingAnalytic.baseChangeLiftDescent_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeLiftDescent_apply
    (r : CompletedBaseChange K F L →L[K] F) (n : ℕ)
    (P : (CompletedBaseChange K E L →L[L] CompletedBaseChange K E L) [×n]→L[L]
      ((CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L) →L[L]
        (CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L)))
    (f : Fin n → E →L[K] E) (m : E [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F) (x : Fin n → E) :
    baseChangeLiftDescent K E F L r n P f m x =
      r (P (fun i => completedBaseChangeOperator K E L (f i))
        (baseChangeAlternatingForms K E F L n m)
        (fun i => completedBaseChangeEmbedding K E L (x i)))
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_baseChangeLiftDescent_le
statement:
theorem norm_baseChangeLiftDescent_le
    (r : CompletedBaseChange K F L →L[K] F) (n : ℕ)
    (P : (CompletedBaseChange K E L →L[L] CompletedBaseChange K E L) [×n]→L[L]
      ((CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L) →L[L]
        (CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L))) :
    ‖baseChangeLiftDescent K E F L r n P‖ ≤ ‖r‖ * ‖P‖
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg r) (norm_nonneg P))
  intro f
  change ‖baseChangeLiftRestriction K E F L r n
    (P (fun i => completedBaseChangeOperator K E L (f i)))‖ ≤
      (‖r‖ * ‖P‖) * ∏ i, ‖f i‖
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖r‖ * ‖P (fun i => completedBaseChangeOperator K E L (f i))‖ :=
      norm_baseChangeLiftRestriction_apply_le K E F L r n _
    _ ≤ ‖r‖ * (‖P‖ * ∏ i, ‖completedBaseChangeOperator K E L (f i)‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (norm_lift_apply_le L (CompletedBaseChange K E L) (CompletedBaseChange K F L)
          n P (fun i => completedBaseChangeOperator K E L (f i))) (norm_nonneg r)
    _ ≤ ‖r‖ * (‖P‖ * ∏ i, ‖f i‖) := by
      gcongr with i
      exact norm_completedBaseChangeOperator_le K E L (f i)
    _ = (‖r‖ * ‖P‖) * ∏ i, ‖f i‖ := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: AlternatingAnalytic.baseChangeLiftDescent_diag
statement:
theorem baseChangeLiftDescent_diag
    (r : CompletedBaseChange K F L →L[K] F)
    (hr : ∀ y : F, r (completedBaseChangeEmbedding K F L y) = y) (n : ℕ)
    (P : (CompletedBaseChange K E L →L[L] CompletedBaseChange K E L) [×n]→L[L]
      ((CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L) →L[L]
        (CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L)))
    (hP : ∀ f, P (fun _ => f) = LiftCriterion.Q L (Fin n)
      (CompletedBaseChange K E L) (CompletedBaseChange K E L) (CompletedBaseChange K F L) f)
    (f : E →L[K] E) :
    baseChangeLiftDescent K E F L r n P (fun _ => f) = LiftCriterion.Q K (Fin n) E E F f
proof:
:= by
  ext m x
  simp only [baseChangeLiftDescent_apply, hP, LiftCriterion.Q,
    ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM_apply,
    ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
  change r ((baseChangeAlternatingForms K E F L n m)
    (fun i => completedBaseChangeOperator K E L f (completedBaseChangeEmbedding K E L (x i)))) =
      m (fun i => f (x i))
  simp_rw [completedBaseChangeOperator_embedding]
  rw [baseChangeAlternatingForms_embedding, hr]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exists_baseChangeLiftDescent
statement:
theorem exists_baseChangeLiftDescent (n : ℕ)
    (P : (CompletedBaseChange K E L →L[L] CompletedBaseChange K E L) [×n]→L[L]
      ((CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L) →L[L]
        (CompletedBaseChange K E L [⋀^Fin n]→L[L] CompletedBaseChange K F L)))
    (hP : ∀ f, P (fun _ => f) = LiftCriterion.Q L (Fin n)
      (CompletedBaseChange K E L) (CompletedBaseChange K E L) (CompletedBaseChange K F L) f) :
    ∃ P₁ : (E →L[K] E) [×n]→L[K]
        ((E [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F) →L[K] (E [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F)),
      ‖P₁‖ ≤ ‖P‖ ∧ ∀ f, P₁ (fun _ => f) = LiftCriterion.Q K (Fin n) E E F f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hfix⟩ := exists_completedBaseChange_retraction K F L
  refine ⟨baseChangeLiftDescent K E F L r n P, ?_, baseChangeLiftDescent_diag K E F L r hfix n P hP⟩
  apply (norm_baseChangeLiftDescent_le K E F L r n P).trans
  simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr (norm_nonneg P)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.hasBoundedLift_of_completedBaseChange
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_of_completedBaseChange (n : ℕ)
    (h : LiftCriterion.HasBoundedLift L (Fin n) (CompletedBaseChange K E L)
      (CompletedBaseChange K E L) (CompletedBaseChange K F L)) :
    LiftCriterion.HasBoundedLift K (Fin n) E E F
proof:
:= by
  unfold LiftCriterion.HasBoundedLift at h ⊢
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨P₁, _, hP₁⟩ := exists_baseChangeLiftDescent K E F L n P hP
  exact ⟨P₁, hP₁⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.not_hasBoundedLift_completedBaseChange
statement:
theorem not_hasBoundedLift_completedBaseChange (n : ℕ)
    (h : ¬ LiftCriterion.HasBoundedLift K (Fin n) E E F) :
    ¬ LiftCriterion.HasBoundedLift L (Fin n) (CompletedBaseChange K E L)
      (CompletedBaseChange K E L) (CompletedBaseChange K F L)
proof:
:=
  fun hL => h (hasBoundedLift_of_completedBaseChange K E F L n hL)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.not_analyticAt_completedBaseChange_of_not_analyticAt
statement:
theorem not_analyticAt_completedBaseChange_of_not_analyticAt (n : ℕ) {f₀ : E →L[K] E}
    (h : ¬ AnalyticAt K (LiftCriterion.Q K (Fin n) E E F) f₀)
    (g₀ : CompletedBaseChange K E L →L[L] CompletedBaseChange K E L) :
    ¬ AnalyticAt L (LiftCriterion.Q L (Fin n) (CompletedBaseChange K E L)
      (CompletedBaseChange K E L) (CompletedBaseChange K F L)) g₀
proof:
:= by
  intro hg
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hasBoundedLift_of_completedBaseChange K E F L n
    (LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_of_analyticAt hg)
  exact h (LiftCriterion.cpolynomialAt_of_lift P hP f₀).analyticAt

name: L1Coordinates.coordinateTerm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateTerm_apply {d : ℕ} (c : (Fin d → J) → W) (a : Fin d → J)
    (x : Fin d → lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) :
    coordinateTerm (K := K) c a x = (∏ r, x r (a r)) • c a
proof: := rfl

name: L1Coordinates.norm_coordinateTerm_le
statement:
theorem norm_coordinateTerm_le {d : ℕ} (c : (Fin d → J) → W) (M : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ a, ‖c a‖ ≤ M) (x : Fin d → lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) (a : Fin d → J) :
    ‖coordinateTerm (K := K) c a x‖ ≤ M * ∏ r, ‖x r (a r)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateTerm_apply, norm_smul, norm_prod, mul_comm]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc a) (Finset.prod_nonneg fun r _ => norm_nonneg _)

name: L1Coordinates.summable_norm_coordinateTerm
statement:
theorem summable_norm_coordinateTerm {d : ℕ} (c : (Fin d → J) → W) (M : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ a, ‖c a‖ ≤ M) (x : Fin d → lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) :
    Summable (fun a => ‖coordinateTerm (K := K) c a x‖)
proof:
:=
  ((hasSum_prod_norm d x).summable.mul_left M).of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (norm_coordinateTerm_le c M hc x)

name: L1Coordinates.summable_coordinateTerm
statement:
theorem summable_coordinateTerm {d : ℕ} (c : (Fin d → J) → W) (M : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ a, ‖c a‖ ≤ M) (x : Fin d → lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) :
    Summable (fun a => coordinateTerm (K := K) c a x)
proof:
:=
  (summable_norm_coordinateTerm (K := K) c M hc x).of_norm

name: L1Coordinates.norm_multilinearOfBounded_le
statement:
theorem norm_multilinearOfBounded_le {d : ℕ} (c : (Fin d → J) → W) (M : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ a, ‖c a‖ ≤ M) (x : Fin d → lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) :
    ‖multilinearOfBounded (K := K) c M hc x‖ ≤ M * ∏ r, ‖x r‖
proof:
:=
  (summable_coordinateTerm (K := K) c M hc x).hasSum.norm_le_of_bounded
    ((hasSum_prod_norm d x).mul_left M) (norm_coordinateTerm_le c M hc x)

name: L1Coordinates.continuousMultilinearOfBounded_hasSum
statement:
theorem continuousMultilinearOfBounded_hasSum {d : ℕ} (c : (Fin d → J) → W)
    (M : ℝ) (hc : ∀ a, ‖c a‖ ≤ M) (x : Fin d → lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) :
    HasSum (fun a : Fin d → J => (∏ r, x r (a r)) • c a)
      (continuousMultilinearOfBounded (K := K) c M hc x)
proof:
:=
  (summable_coordinateTerm (K := K) c M hc x).hasSum

name: L1Coordinates.continuousMultilinearOfBounded_norm_le
statement:
theorem continuousMultilinearOfBounded_norm_le {d : ℕ} (c : (Fin d → J) → W)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hc : ∀ a, ‖c a‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖continuousMultilinearOfBounded (K := K) c M hc‖ ≤ M
proof:
:=
  (multilinearOfBounded (K := K) c M hc).mkContinuous_norm_le hM _

name: L1Coordinates.continuousMultilinearOfBounded_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem continuousMultilinearOfBounded_single {d : ℕ} (c : (Fin d → J) → W)
    (M : ℝ) (hc : ∀ a, ‖c a‖ ≤ M) (a : Fin d → J) :
    continuousMultilinearOfBounded (K := K) c M hc (fun r => lp.single 1 (a r) (1 : K)) = c a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (∑' b, coordinateTerm (K := K) c b (fun r => lp.single 1 (a r) (1 : K))) = c a
  rw [tsum_eq_single a]
  · simp [coordinateTerm_apply]
  · intro b hba
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hba
    rw [coordinateTerm_apply,
      Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ r) (lp.single_apply_ne 1 (a r) 1 hr), zero_smul]

name: L1Coordinates.continuousMultilinearOfBounded_sum_single
statement:
theorem continuousMultilinearOfBounded_sum_single {d : ℕ} (c : (Fin d → J) → W)
    (M : ℝ) (hc : ∀ a, ‖c a‖ ≤ M) (x : Fin d → J → K) (s : Fin d → Finset J) :
    continuousMultilinearOfBounded (K := K) c M hc
        (fun r => ∑ j ∈ s r, lp.single 1 j (x r j)) =
      ∑ a ∈ Fintype.piFinset s, (∏ r, x r (a r)) • c a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [map_sum_single, continuousMultilinearOfBounded_single]

name: L1Coordinates.continuousMultilinearOfBounded_tendsto
statement:
theorem continuousMultilinearOfBounded_tendsto {d : ℕ} (c : (Fin d → J) → W)
    (M : ℝ) (hc : ∀ a, ‖c a‖ ≤ M) (x : Fin d → lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun s : Finset J =>
        ∑ a ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin d => s), (∏ r, x r (a r)) • c a)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (continuousMultilinearOfBounded (K := K) c M hc x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [continuousMultilinearOfBounded_sum_single] using
    tendsto_map_sum_single (continuousMultilinearOfBounded (K := K) c M hc) x

name: L1Coordinates.exists_l1_multilinear_of_bounded_coefficients
statement:
theorem exists_l1_multilinear_of_bounded_coefficients
    (d : ℕ) (c : (Fin d → J) → W)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hc : ∀ a, ‖c a‖ ≤ M) :
    ∃ C : ContinuousMultilinearMap K
        (fun _ : Fin d => lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) W,
      (∀ x, HasSum
        (fun a : Fin d → J => (∏ r, x r (a r)) • c a) (C x)) ∧
      ‖C‖ ≤ M ∧
      (∀ a : Fin d → J, C (fun r => lp.single 1 (a r) (1 : K)) = c a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨continuousMultilinearOfBounded (K := K) c M hc,
    continuousMultilinearOfBounded_hasSum c M hc,
    continuousMultilinearOfBounded_norm_le c M hM hc,
    continuousMultilinearOfBounded_single c M hc⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.sphericallyCompleteSpace_of_discreteDist
statement:
theorem sphericallyCompleteSpace_of_discreteDist {e : ℝ} (he : 1 < e)
    (hval : ∀ x y : Y, x ≠ y → ∃ n : ℤ, dist x y = e ^ n) :
    SphericallyCompleteSpace Y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  intro S hSne hmeet
  let : Nonempty Y := ⟨hSne.choose.1⟩
  
  have hrnn : ∀ p ∈ S, 0 ≤ p.2 := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨z, hz, -⟩ := hmeet p hp p hp
    exact le_trans dist_nonneg (mem_closedBall.mp hz)
  
  have hdist : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ S, dist p.1 q.1 ≤ max p.2 q.2 := by
    intro p hp q hq
    obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ := hmeet p hp q hq
    have h1 : dist p.1 z ≤ p.2 := by
      rw [dist_comm]; exact mem_closedBall.mp hz1
    have h2 : dist z q.1 ≤ q.2 := by
      exact mem_closedBall.mp hz2
    exact (IsUltrametricDist.dist_triangle_max p.1 z q.1).trans (max_le_max h1 h2)
  by_cases hcase : ∃ p ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ S, dist p.1 q.1 ≤ q.2
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, h⟩ := hcase
    refine ⟨p.1, ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
    intro q hq
    rw [mem_closedBall]
    exact h q hq
  · push Not at hcase
    
    have step : ∀ p : Y × ℝ, p ∈ S → ∃ q, q ∈ S ∧ dist p.1 q.1 ≤ p.2 ∧ q.2 < dist p.1 q.1 := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hlt⟩ := hcase p hp
      refine ⟨q, hq, ?_, hlt⟩
      have := hdist p hp q hq
      rcases max_cases p.2 q.2 with ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩
      · rwa [h] at this
      · exact absurd (this.trans_eq h) (not_le.mpr hlt)
    choose! nxt hnxtS hnxt1 hnxt2 using step
    obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩ := hSne
    set u : ℕ → Y × ℝ := fun n => Nat.rec p₀ (fun _ q => nxt q) n with hu
    have huS : ∀ n, u n ∈ S := by
      intro n; induction n with
      | zero => exact hp₀
      | succ n ih => exact hnxtS _ ih
    set d : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => dist (u n).1 (u (n + 1)).1 with hd
    have hd_le : ∀ n, d n ≤ (u n).2 := fun n => hnxt1 _ (huS n)
    have hd_gt : ∀ n, (u (n + 1)).2 < d n := fun n => hnxt2 _ (huS n)
    have hd_pos : ∀ n, 0 < d n := fun n => lt_of_le_of_lt (hrnn _ (huS (n + 1))) (hd_gt n)
    have hd_anti : ∀ n, d (n + 1) < d n := fun n => lt_of_le_of_lt (hd_le (n + 1)) (hd_gt n)
    have hd_mono : ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m → d m ≤ d n := by
      intro n m h
      induction m with
      | zero => have hn : n = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h; subst hn; exact le_rfl
      | succ m ih =>
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n (m + 1) with hh | hh
        · exact le_trans (hd_anti m).le (ih (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hh))
        · have hn : n = m + 1 := le_antisymm h hh
          subst hn; exact le_rfl
    have hexp : ∀ n, ∃ k : ℤ, d n = e ^ k := by
      intro n
      refine hval (u n).1 (u (n + 1)).1 (fun h0 => ?_)
      have hz : d n = 0 := by simp [hd, h0]
      exact absurd hz (hd_pos n).ne'
    choose k hk using hexp
    have hk_anti : ∀ n, k (n + 1) < k n := by
      intro n
      have := hd_anti n
      rw [hk (n + 1), hk n] at this
      exact (zpow_lt_zpow_iff_right₀ he).mp this
    have hk_le : ∀ n, k n ≤ k 0 - n := by
      intro n; induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih =>
        have := hk_anti n
        push_cast
        omega
    have he0 : (0:ℝ) < e := lt_trans zero_lt_one he
    have hd_tendsto : Tendsto d atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, d n ≤ (e ^ (k 0)) * (e⁻¹) ^ n := by
        intro n
        rw [hk n]
        have : k n ≤ k 0 - n := hk_le n
        calc e ^ (k n) ≤ e ^ (k 0 - (n:ℤ)) := by
              exact zpow_le_zpow_right₀ he.le this
          _ = (e ^ (k 0)) * (e⁻¹) ^ n := by
              rw [zpow_sub₀ (ne_of_gt he0)]
              simp [zpow_natCast, inv_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
      have h1 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (e ^ (k 0)) * (e⁻¹) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
        have : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (e⁻¹) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
          tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by positivity)
            (by rw [inv_lt_one₀ he0]; exact he)
        simpa using this.const_mul (e ^ (k 0))
      exact squeeze_zero (fun n => (hd_pos n).le) hbound h1
    
    have hchain : ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m → dist (u n).1 (u m).1 ≤ d n := by
      intro n m hnm
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        have hn : n = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hnm
        subst hn; simpa using (hd_pos 0).le
      | succ m ih =>
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n (m + 1) with h | h
        · have hnm' : n ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp h
          have h1 := ih hnm'
          have h2 : dist (u m).1 (u (m + 1)).1 = d m := rfl
          exact (IsUltrametricDist.dist_triangle_max (u n).1 (u m).1 (u (m + 1)).1).trans
            (max_le h1 (by rw [h2]; exact hd_mono n m hnm'))
        · have hn : n = m + 1 := le_antisymm hnm h
          subst hn; simpa using (hd_pos (m + 1)).le
    have hcauchy : CauchySeq (fun n => (u n).1) := by
      refine cauchySeq_of_le_tendsto_0 d (fun n m N hn hm => ?_) hd_tendsto
      have h1 : dist (u N).1 (u n).1 ≤ d N := hchain N n hn
      have h2 : dist (u N).1 (u m).1 ≤ d N := hchain N m hm
      exact (IsUltrametricDist.dist_triangle_max (u n).1 (u N).1 (u m).1).trans
        (max_le (by simpa only [dist_comm] using h1) h2)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hcauchy
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
    intro q hq
    rw [mem_closedBall]
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hpos : 0 < dist x q.1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (hrnn q hq) hcon
    have ha : Tendsto (fun n => dist x (u n).1) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have h := tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mp hx
      simpa only [dist_comm] using h
    have hb : Tendsto (fun n => (u (n + 1)).2) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      squeeze_zero (fun n => hrnn _ (huS (n + 1))) (fun n => (hd_gt n).le) hd_tendsto
    have hA : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, dist x (u n).1 < dist x q.1 := ha.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hpos)
    have hB : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (u (n + 1)).2 < dist x q.1 := hb.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hpos)
    obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hA
    obtain ⟨N2, hN2⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hB
    set j := max N1 N2 with hj
    have h1 : dist x (u (j + 1)).1 < dist x q.1 :=
      hN1 (j + 1) (le_trans (le_max_left N1 N2) (Nat.le_succ j))
    have h2 : (u (j + 1)).2 < dist x q.1 := hN2 j (le_max_right N1 N2)
    have h3 : dist (u (j + 1)).1 q.1 ≤ max ((u (j + 1)).2) q.2 :=
      hdist _ (huS (j + 1)) q hq
    have h4 : dist x q.1 ≤ max (dist x (u (j + 1)).1) (dist (u (j + 1)).1 q.1) := by
      exact IsUltrametricDist.dist_triangle_max x (u (j + 1)).1 q.1
    have h5 : max (dist x (u (j + 1)).1) (dist (u (j + 1)).1 q.1) < dist x q.1 :=
      max_lt h1 (lt_of_le_of_lt h3 (max_lt h2 hcon))
    exact absurd h4 (not_le.mpr h5)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.sphericallyCompleteSpace_of_discreteDist_radius
statement:
theorem sphericallyCompleteSpace_of_discreteDist_radius {r : ℝ}
    (hr0 : 0 < r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (hval : ∀ x y : Y, x ≠ y → ∃ n : ℤ, dist x y = r ^ n) :
    SphericallyCompleteSpace Y
proof:
:= by
  apply sphericallyCompleteSpace_of_discreteDist ((one_lt_inv₀ hr0).mpr hr1)
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hval x y hxy
  exact ⟨-n, by simpa [zpow_neg] using hn⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.degreeOf_det_column_family_le_one
statement:
theorem degreeOf_det_column_family_le_one
    {K n J σ : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq J]
    (g : J → n → MvPolynomial σ K) (j₀ : J) (v : σ)
    (hdeg : ∀ j i, degreeOf v (g j i) ≤ if j = j₀ then 1 else 0)
    (s : n → J) :
    degreeOf v (Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i k => g (s k) i))) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hrep : ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ s i = j₀ ∧ s j = j₀
  · obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hi, hj⟩ := hrep
    rw [Matrix.det_zero_of_column_eq (M := Matrix.of (fun i k => g (s k) i)) hij
      (by intro k; simp [hi, hj])]
    simp
  · have hsum : (∑ k : n, if s k = j₀ then 1 else 0) ≤ 1 := by
      by_cases hex : ∃ k, s k = j₀
      · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hex
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
        · simp [hk]
        · intro b _ hbk
          have hb : s b ≠ j₀ := fun hb => hrep ⟨b, k, hbk, hb, hk⟩
          simp [hb]
        · simp
      · simp only [not_exists] at hex
        simp [hex]
    rw [Matrix.det_apply']
    refine (degreeOf_sum_le v _ _).trans ?_
    refine Finset.sup_le ?_
    intro π _
    have hsign := degreeOf_C_mul_le (∏ k, g (s k) (π k)) v
      (((Equiv.Perm.sign π : ℤ) : K))
    have hprod := degreeOf_prod_le v Finset.univ (fun k => g (s k) (π k))
    apply le_trans (show degreeOf v _ ≤ degreeOf v (∏ k, g (s k) (π k)) by
      simpa using hsign)
    exact hprod.trans ((Finset.sum_le_sum
      (fun k _ => hdeg (s k) (π k))).trans hsum)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.degreeOf_mem_span_det_column_family_le_one
