name: LiftCriterion.polySeries_apply
statement:
lemma polySeries_apply (k : ℕ) (b : ℕ → Z) (n : ℕ) (m : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    polySeries 𝕜 k b n m = (∏ i, m i) • (if n ≤ k then b n else 0)
proof:
:=
  ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiRing_apply _ _

name: LiftCriterion.polySeries_eq_zero_of_gt
statement:
lemma polySeries_eq_zero_of_gt (k : ℕ) (b : ℕ → Z) {n : ℕ} (hn : k < n) :
    polySeries 𝕜 k b n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (if n ≤ k then b n else 0) = 0 := by simp [Nat.not_le.mpr hn]
  rw [polySeries, hb]
  exact ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiRing_zero

name: LiftCriterion.hasFPowerSeriesAt_polySeries
statement:
lemma hasFPowerSeriesAt_polySeries (k : ℕ) (b : ℕ → Z) :
    HasFPowerSeriesAt (fun t : 𝕜 => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), t ^ r • b r)
      (polySeries 𝕜 k b) 0
proof:
:= by
  have H : HasFiniteFPowerSeriesOnBall
      (fun t : 𝕜 => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), t ^ r • b r) (polySeries 𝕜 k b) 0 (k + 1) ⊤ := by
    refine HasFiniteFPowerSeriesOnBall.mk' ?_ ENNReal.zero_lt_top ?_
    · intro m hm
      exact polySeries_eq_zero_of_gt k b (by omega)
    · intro y _
      have : ∀ r ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          polySeries 𝕜 k b r (fun _ => y) = y ^ r • b r := by
        intro r hr
        rw [polySeries_apply]
        have hrk : r ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
        simp [hrk]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this]
      simp
  exact H.hasFiniteFPowerSeriesAt.hasFPowerSeriesAt

name: LiftCriterion.hasFPowerSeriesAt_shift
statement:
lemma hasFPowerSeriesAt_shift {Q : X → Z} {x₀ : X} {p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 X Z}
    (hp : HasFPowerSeriesAt Q p x₀) : HasFPowerSeriesAt (fun z => Q (x₀ + z)) p 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨r, { r_le := hr.r_le, r_pos := hr.r_pos,
              hasSum := fun {y} hy => by simpa using hr.hasSum hy }⟩

name: LiftCriterion.coeff_eq_of_hasFPowerSeriesAt
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_of_hasFPowerSeriesAt (Q : X → Z) (x₀ : X) (k : ℕ) (B : ℕ → X → Z)
    (hB : ∀ (t : 𝕜) (x : X), Q (x₀ + t • x) = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), t ^ r • B r x)
    (p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 X Z) (hp : HasFPowerSeriesAt Q p x₀) :
    ∀ x, p k (fun _ => x) = B k x
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  have hp0 : HasFPowerSeriesAt (fun z => Q (x₀ + z)) p 0 := hasFPowerSeriesAt_shift hp
  obtain ⟨u, huapp⟩ : ∃ u : 𝕜 →L[𝕜] X, ∀ t : 𝕜, u t = t • y :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 𝕜).smulRight y, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hp0' : HasFPowerSeriesAt (fun z => Q (x₀ + z)) p (u 0) := by
    rw [huapp, zero_smul]; exact hp0
  have h1 : HasFPowerSeriesAt ((fun z => Q (x₀ + z)) ∘ u) (p.compContinuousLinearMap u) 0 :=
    hp0'.compContinuousLinearMap
  have h2 : ((fun z => Q (x₀ + z)) ∘ u) =
      fun t : 𝕜 => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), t ^ r • B r y := by
    funext t
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, huapp, hB]
  rw [h2] at h1
  have heq := h1.eq_formalMultilinearSeries (hasFPowerSeriesAt_polySeries k (fun r => B r y))
  have key : (p.compContinuousLinearMap u) k (fun _ => (1 : 𝕜))
      = polySeries 𝕜 k (fun r => B r y) k (fun _ => (1 : 𝕜)) := by rw [heq]
  rw [FormalMultilinearSeries.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, polySeries_apply] at key
  simp only [Function.comp_def, huapp, one_smul, Finset.prod_const_one] at key
  simpa using key

name: LiftCriterion.coeff_eq_of_ambient
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_of_ambient (Q : X → Z) (x₀ : X) (k : ℕ) (B : ℕ → X → W) (j : Z →L[𝕜] W)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (Qtop : X → Z)
    (hB : ∀ (t : 𝕜) (x : X), j (Q (x₀ + t • x)) = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), t ^ r • B r x)
    (htop : ∀ x, B k x = j (Qtop x))
    (p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 X Z) (hp : HasFPowerSeriesAt Q p x₀) :
    ∀ x, p k (fun _ => x) = Qtop x
proof:
:= by
  have hjp : HasFPowerSeriesAt (j ∘ Q) (j.compFormalMultilinearSeries p) x₀ := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨r, j.comp_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall hr⟩
  have h := coeff_eq_of_hasFPowerSeriesAt (j ∘ Q) x₀ k B
    (by intro t x; simpa using hB t x) (j.compFormalMultilinearSeries p) hjp
  intro x
  apply hj
  have h1 := h x
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.compFormalMultilinearSeries_apply] at h1
  simpa [htop x] using h1

name: LiftCriterion.map_diag_add_smul
statement:
theorem map_diag_add_smul (A : ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun _ : ι => X) W) (x₀ h : X)
    (t : 𝕜) :
    A (fun _ => x₀ + t • h) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card ι + 1), t ^ r • lineCoeff A x₀ r h
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (fun _ : ι => x₀ + t • h) = (fun _ : ι => t • h) + (fun _ : ι => x₀) := by
    funext i; simp [add_comm]
  rw [h1, A.map_add_univ]
  have h2 : ∀ s : Finset ι, A (s.piecewise (fun _ => t • h) (fun _ => x₀)) =
      t ^ s.card • A (s.piecewise (fun _ => h) (fun _ => x₀)) := by
    intro s
    have := A.map_piecewise_smul (fun _ => t) (s.piecewise (fun _ => h) (fun _ => x₀)) s
    rw [Finset.prod_const] at this
    rw [← this]
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s <;> simp [Finset.piecewise, hi]
  simp_rw [h2]
  unfold lineCoeff
  simp_rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset ι)))
    (t := Finset.range (Fintype.card ι + 1)) (g := Finset.card)]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs => ?_
    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2]
  · intro s _
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.card_le_univ s))

name: LiftCriterion.lineCoeff_card
statement:
theorem lineCoeff_card (A : ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun _ : ι => X) W) (x₀ h : X) :
    lineCoeff A x₀ (Fintype.card ι) h = A (fun _ => h)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lineCoeff
  have : (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset ι)).filter (fun s => s.card = Fintype.card ι) =
      {Finset.univ} := by
    ext s
    simp [Finset.card_eq_iff_eq_univ]
  rw [this, Finset.sum_singleton, Finset.piecewise_univ]

name: LiftCriterion.jAmb_apply_apply
statement:
lemma jAmb_apply_apply (T : (E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)) (m : E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) :
    jAmb 𝕜 ι E E' F T m = (T m).toContinuousMultilinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: LiftCriterion.jAmb_injective
statement: lemma jAmb_injective : Function.Injective (jAmb 𝕜 ι E E' F)
proof:
:= by
  intro T₁ T₂ h
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun m => toContinuousMultilinearMap_injective ?_
  have := congrArg (fun T => T m) h
  simpa only [jAmb_apply_apply] using this

name: LiftCriterion.ambLift_diag
statement:
lemma ambLift_diag (f : E →L[𝕜] E') :
    ambLift 𝕜 ι E E' F (fun _ => f) = jAmb 𝕜 ι E E' F (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F f)
proof:
:= by
  ext m x
  rfl

name: LiftCriterion.coeff_card_eq_Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdiag : ∀ x, jAmb 𝕜 ι E E' F (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F x) = ambLift 𝕜 ι E E' F (fun _ => x) :=
    fun x => (ambLift_diag x).symm
  have hinj : Function.Injective (jAmb 𝕜 ι E E' F) := jAmb_injective
  have hB : ∀ (t : 𝕜) (x : E →L[𝕜] E'), jAmb 𝕜 ι E E' F (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F (f₀ + t • x)) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card ι + 1),
        t ^ r • lineCoeff (𝕜 := 𝕜) (ambLift 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀ r x := by
    intro t x
    rw [hdiag]
    exact map_diag_add_smul (𝕜 := 𝕜) (ι := ι) (X := E →L[𝕜] E')
      (W := ((E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun _ : ι => E) F)) (ambLift 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀ x t
  have htop : ∀ x, lineCoeff (𝕜 := 𝕜) (ambLift 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀ (Fintype.card ι) x =
      jAmb 𝕜 ι E E' F (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F x) := by
    intro x
    rw [hdiag]
    exact lineCoeff_card (𝕜 := 𝕜) (ι := ι) (X := E →L[𝕜] E')
      (W := ((E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun _ : ι => E) F)) (ambLift 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀ x
  exact coeff_eq_of_ambient (𝕜 := 𝕜) (X := E →L[𝕜] E') (Z := ((E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)))
    (W := ((E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun _ : ι => E) F)) (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀ (Fintype.card ι)
    (fun r x => lineCoeff (𝕜 := 𝕜) (ambLift 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀ r x) (jAmb 𝕜 ι E E' F) hinj
    (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) hB htop p hp h

name: LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_of_analyticAt
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_of_analyticAt {f₀ : E →L[𝕜] E'} (h : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀) :
    HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h
  exact ⟨p (Fintype.card ι), coeff_card_eq_Q hp⟩

name: LiftCriterion.cpolynomialAt_of_lift
statement:
theorem cpolynomialAt_of_lift {n : ℕ} (P : ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun _ : Fin n => E →L[𝕜] E')
      ((E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)))
    (hP : ∀ f, P (fun _ => f) = Q 𝕜 ι E E' F f) (f₀ : E →L[𝕜] E') :
    CPolynomialAt 𝕜 (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : Q 𝕜 ι E E' F = P ∘ (fun f => fun _ : Fin n => f) := funext fun f => (hP f).symm
  rw [hQ]
  exact CPolynomialAt.comp (g := ⇑P) (f := fun f : E →L[𝕜] E' => fun _ : Fin n => f)
    (ContinuousMultilinearMap.cpolynomialAt _)
    (ContinuousLinearMap.cpolynomialAt
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun _ : Fin n => ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 (E →L[𝕜] E')) f₀)

name: LiftCriterion.tfae_Q
statement:
theorem tfae_Q : List.TFAE
    [HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F,
     ∀ f₀, CPolynomialAt 𝕜 (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀,
     ∀ f₀, AnalyticAt 𝕜 (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀,
     ∃ f₀, AnalyticAt 𝕜 (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀,
     ContDiff 𝕜 ω (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F),
     ∃ f₀, ContDiffAt 𝕜 ω (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := fun ⟨P, hP⟩ f₀ => cpolynomialAt_of_lift P hP f₀
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := fun h f₀ => (h f₀).analyticAt
  tfae_have 3 → 4 := fun h => ⟨0, h 0⟩
  tfae_have 4 → 1 := fun ⟨_, h⟩ => hasBoundedLift_of_analyticAt h
  tfae_have 2 → 5 := fun h => contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.2 fun f₀ => (h f₀).contDiffAt
  tfae_have 5 → 6 := fun h => ⟨0, h.contDiffAt⟩
  tfae_have 6 → 4 := fun ⟨f₀, h⟩ => ⟨f₀, h.analyticAt⟩
  tfae_finish

name: LiftCriterion.contDiff_omega_iff_hasBoundedLift
statement:
theorem contDiff_omega_iff_hasBoundedLift :
    ContDiff 𝕜 ω (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) ↔ HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F

name: LiftCriterion.cpolynomialAt_of_analyticAt
statement:
theorem cpolynomialAt_of_analyticAt {f₀ : E →L[𝕜] E'} (h : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀)
    (f₁ : E →L[𝕜] E') : CPolynomialAt 𝕜 (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hasBoundedLift_of_analyticAt h
  exact cpolynomialAt_of_lift P hP f₁

name: LiftCriterion.not_analyticAt_of_not_analyticAt
statement:
theorem not_analyticAt_of_not_analyticAt {f₀ : E →L[𝕜] E'} (h : ¬ AnalyticAt 𝕜 (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₀)
    (f₁ : E →L[𝕜] E') : ¬ AnalyticAt 𝕜 (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) f₁
proof:
:=
  fun h₁ => h (cpolynomialAt_of_analyticAt h₁ f₀).analyticAt

name: LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_iff_exists_ι
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_iff_exists_ι :
    HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F ↔
      ∃ P : ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun _ : ι => E →L[𝕜] E')
          ((E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)),
        ∀ f, P (fun _ => f) = Q 𝕜 ι E E' F f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, hP⟩
    exact ⟨P.domDomCongr (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm, fun f => hP f⟩
  · rintro ⟨P, hP⟩
    exact ⟨P.domDomCongr (Fintype.equivFin ι), fun f => hP f⟩

name: LiftCriterion.Smap_apply
statement:
lemma Smap_apply (m : E' [⋀^Fin n]→L[𝕜] F) (v : Fin (n + 1) → E' × 𝕜) :
    Smap 𝕜 E' F n m v =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) • ((v i).2 • m (fun j => (i.removeNth v j).1))
proof:
:= by
  simp [Smap, alternatizeUncurryFin_apply]
  rfl

name: LiftCriterion.Rmap_apply
statement:
lemma Rmap_apply (M : (E × 𝕜) [⋀^Fin (n + 1)]→L[𝕜] F) (x : Fin n → E) :
    Rmap 𝕜 E F n M x = M (Matrix.vecCons ((0 : E), (1 : 𝕜)) (fun j => (x j, (0 : 𝕜))))
proof: := rfl

name: LiftCriterion.Rmap_Smap
statement: theorem Rmap_Smap (m : E' [⋀^Fin n]→L[𝕜] F) : Rmap 𝕜 E' F n (Smap 𝕜 E' F n m) = m
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Rmap_apply, Smap_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp

name: LiftCriterion.Γ_apply
statement:
lemma Γ_apply (T : ((E' × 𝕜) [⋀^Fin (n + 1)]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] ((E × 𝕜) [⋀^Fin (n + 1)]→L[𝕜] F))
    (m : E' [⋀^Fin n]→L[𝕜] F) : Γ 𝕜 E E' F n T m = Rmap 𝕜 E F n (T (Smap 𝕜 E' F n m))
proof: := rfl

name: LiftCriterion.φ_apply
statement: lemma φ_apply (f : E →L[𝕜] E') (x : E × 𝕜) : φ 𝕜 E E' f x = (f x.1, 0)
proof: := rfl

name: LiftCriterion.jj_apply
statement: lemma jj_apply (x : E × 𝕜) : jj 𝕜 E E' x = (0, x.2)
proof: := rfl

name: LiftCriterion.Γ_Q_succ
statement:
theorem Γ_Q_succ (f : E →L[𝕜] E') :
    Γ 𝕜 E E' F n (Q 𝕜 (Fin (n + 1)) (E × 𝕜) (E' × 𝕜) F (φ 𝕜 E E' f + jj 𝕜 E E')) =
      Q 𝕜 (Fin n) E E' F f
proof:
:= by
  ext m x
  rw [Γ_apply, Rmap_apply]
  simp only [Q, compContinuousLinearMapCLM_apply, compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
  rw [Smap_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp [φ_apply, jj_apply]
  congr 1
  funext j
  simp [Fin.tail, φ_apply, jj_apply]

name: LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_of_hasBoundedLift_succ
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_of_hasBoundedLift_succ
    (h : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 (Fin (n + 1)) (E × 𝕜) (E' × 𝕜) F) : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 (Fin n) E E' F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := h
  
  have hup : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (Q 𝕜 (Fin (n + 1)) (E × 𝕜) (E' × 𝕜) F) (φ 𝕜 E E' 0 + jj 𝕜 E E') :=
    (cpolynomialAt_of_lift P hP _).analyticAt
  have haff : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (fun f : E →L[𝕜] E' => φ 𝕜 E E' f + jj 𝕜 E E') 0 :=
    ((φ 𝕜 E E').analyticAt 0).add analyticAt_const
  have h2 : AnalyticAt 𝕜
      ((Q 𝕜 (Fin (n + 1)) (E × 𝕜) (E' × 𝕜) F) ∘ (fun f : E →L[𝕜] E' => φ 𝕜 E E' f + jj 𝕜 E E'))
      0 := AnalyticAt.comp (𝕜 := 𝕜) hup haff
  have h3 : AnalyticAt 𝕜 ((Γ 𝕜 E E' F n) ∘
      ((Q 𝕜 (Fin (n + 1)) (E × 𝕜) (E' × 𝕜) F) ∘ (fun f : E →L[𝕜] E' => φ 𝕜 E E' f + jj 𝕜 E E')))
      0 := by
    have hΓ : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (Γ 𝕜 E E' F n)
        (((Q 𝕜 (Fin (n + 1)) (E × 𝕜) (E' × 𝕜) F) ∘
          (fun f : E →L[𝕜] E' => φ 𝕜 E E' f + jj 𝕜 E E')) 0) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.analyticAt (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := (((E' × 𝕜) [⋀^Fin (n + 1)]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] ((E × 𝕜) [⋀^Fin (n + 1)]→L[𝕜] F))) (F := ((E' [⋀^Fin n]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] (E [⋀^Fin n]→L[𝕜] F))) (Γ 𝕜 E E' F n) _
    exact AnalyticAt.comp (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E →L[𝕜] E') (F := (((E' × 𝕜) [⋀^Fin (n + 1)]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] ((E × 𝕜) [⋀^Fin (n + 1)]→L[𝕜] F))) (G := ((E' [⋀^Fin n]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] (E [⋀^Fin n]→L[𝕜] F))) hΓ h2
  
  have heq : ((Γ 𝕜 E E' F n) ∘
      ((Q 𝕜 (Fin (n + 1)) (E × 𝕜) (E' × 𝕜) F) ∘ (fun f : E →L[𝕜] E' => φ 𝕜 E E' f + jj 𝕜 E E')))
      = Q 𝕜 (Fin n) E E' F := funext fun f => Γ_Q_succ f
  rw [heq] at h3
  exact hasBoundedLift_of_analyticAt h3

name: LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_of_eq_comp
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_of_eq_comp
    (A : (E₁ →L[𝕜] E₁') → (E →L[𝕜] E')) {a : E₁ →L[𝕜] E₁'} (hA : AnalyticAt 𝕜 A a)
    (Ψ : ((E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)) →L[𝕜]
      ((E₁' [⋀^ι₁]→L[𝕜] F₁) →L[𝕜] (E₁ [⋀^ι₁]→L[𝕜] F₁)))
    (hΨ : ∀ f, Q 𝕜 ι₁ E₁ E₁' F₁ f = Ψ (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F (A f)))
    (h : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F) : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι₁ E₁ E₁' F₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := h
  have hQ : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) (A a) := (cpolynomialAt_of_lift P hP _).analyticAt
  have h2 : AnalyticAt 𝕜 ((Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) ∘ A) a := AnalyticAt.comp (𝕜 := 𝕜) hQ hA
  have hΨa : AnalyticAt 𝕜 Ψ (((Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) ∘ A) a) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.analyticAt (𝕜 := 𝕜)
      (E := (E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F))
      (F := (E₁' [⋀^ι₁]→L[𝕜] F₁) →L[𝕜] (E₁ [⋀^ι₁]→L[𝕜] F₁)) Ψ _
  have h3 : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (Ψ ∘ ((Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) ∘ A)) a :=
    AnalyticAt.comp (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E₁ →L[𝕜] E₁')
      (F := (E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) →L[𝕜] (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F))
      (G := (E₁' [⋀^ι₁]→L[𝕜] F₁) →L[𝕜] (E₁ [⋀^ι₁]→L[𝕜] F₁)) hΨa h2
  have heq : (Ψ ∘ ((Q 𝕜 ι E E' F) ∘ A)) = Q 𝕜 ι₁ E₁ E₁' F₁ := funext fun f => (hΨ f).symm
  rw [heq] at h3
  exact hasBoundedLift_of_analyticAt h3

name: LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_of_equiv
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_of_equiv (e : E ≃L[𝕜] E₁) (e' : E' ≃L[𝕜] E₁')
    (h : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F) : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E₁ E₁' F
proof:
:= by
  refine hasBoundedLift_of_eq_comp (a := 0)
    (((ContinuousLinearMap.compL 𝕜 E E₁' E') (e'.symm : E₁' →L[𝕜] E')).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL 𝕜 E E₁ E₁').flip (e : E →L[𝕜] E₁)))
    (ContinuousLinearMap.analyticAt _ _)
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL 𝕜 (E₁' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) (E₁ [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)
        (compContinuousLinearMapCLM (e.symm : E₁ →L[𝕜] E))).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL 𝕜 (E₁' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) (E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)
        (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)).flip (compContinuousLinearMapCLM (e' : E' →L[𝕜] E₁'))))
    ?_ h
  intro f
  ext m x
  simp only [Q, compContinuousLinearMapCLM_apply, compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
  congr 1
  funext i
  simp

name: LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_equiv_iff
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_equiv_iff (e : E ≃L[𝕜] E₁) (e' : E' ≃L[𝕜] E₁') :
    HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F ↔ HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E₁ E₁' F
proof:
:=
  ⟨hasBoundedLift_of_equiv e e', hasBoundedLift_of_equiv e.symm e'.symm⟩

name: LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_of_retract
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_of_retract (g : F →L[𝕜] F₁) (π : F₁ →L[𝕜] F) (hπg : ∀ y, π (g y) = y)
    (h : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F₁) : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F
proof:
:= by
  refine hasBoundedLift_of_eq_comp (a := 0) id (analyticAt_id)
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL 𝕜 (E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F₁) (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousAlternatingMapCLM 𝕜 E F₁ F ι π)).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL 𝕜 (E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) (E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F₁)
        (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F₁)).flip (ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousAlternatingMapCLM 𝕜 E' F F₁ ι g)))
    ?_ h
  intro f
  ext m x
  simp [hπg]

name: LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_of_prod_same_degree
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_of_prod_same_degree
    (h : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι (E × 𝕜) (E' × 𝕜) F) : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F
proof:
:= by
  refine hasBoundedLift_of_eq_comp (a := 0) (φ 𝕜 E E') ((φ 𝕜 E E').analyticAt 0)
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL 𝕜 (E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) ((E × 𝕜) [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)
        (compContinuousLinearMapCLM (ContinuousLinearMap.inl 𝕜 E 𝕜))).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL 𝕜 (E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) ((E' × 𝕜) [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)
        ((E × 𝕜) [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)).flip
          (compContinuousLinearMapCLM (ContinuousLinearMap.fst 𝕜 E' 𝕜))))
    ?_ h
  intro f
  ext m x
  simp only [Q, compContinuousLinearMapCLM_apply, compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
  congr 1

name: LiftCriterion.not_analyticAt_prod_of_not_analyticAt
proof:
:= by
  intro hg
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hasBoundedLift_of_prod_same_degree (hasBoundedLift_of_analyticAt hg)
  exact h (cpolynomialAt_of_lift P hP f₀).analyticAt

name: LiftCriterion.not_hasBoundedLift_of_le
proof:
:= by
  induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact h
  | succ m _ ih =>
    intro hsucc
    exact ih (hasBoundedLift_of_hasBoundedLift_succ
      (hasBoundedLift_of_equiv u.symm u'.symm hsucc))

name: LiftCriterion.not_analyticAt_of_le
proof:
:= by
  intro h₁
  have hn : ¬ HasBoundedLift 𝕜 (Fin n) E E' F := fun ⟨P, hP⟩ =>
    h (cpolynomialAt_of_lift P hP f₀).analyticAt
  exact not_hasBoundedLift_of_le u u' hn hm (hasBoundedLift_of_analyticAt h₁)

name: LiftCriterion.reindexAlt_apply
statement:
lemma reindexAlt_apply (σ : ι ≃ ι₁) (m : E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) (v : ι₁ → E) :
    reindexAlt σ m v = m (fun k => v (σ k))
proof: := rfl

name: LiftCriterion.reindexCLM_apply
statement:
lemma reindexCLM_apply (σ : ι ≃ ι₁) (m : E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) (v : ι₁ → E) :
    reindexCLM 𝕜 E F σ m v = m (fun k => v (σ k))
proof: := rfl

name: LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_reindex
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_reindex (σ : ι ≃ ι₁) (h : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F) :
    HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι₁ E E' F
proof:
:= by
  refine hasBoundedLift_of_eq_comp (a := 0) id analyticAt_id
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL 𝕜 (E' [⋀^ι₁]→L[𝕜] F) (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F) (E [⋀^ι₁]→L[𝕜] F)
        (reindexCLM 𝕜 E F σ)).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL 𝕜 (E' [⋀^ι₁]→L[𝕜] F) (E' [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)
        (E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F)).flip (reindexCLM 𝕜 E' F σ.symm)))
    ?_ h
  intro f
  ext m v
  simp only [Q, compContinuousLinearMapCLM_apply, compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, reindexCLM_apply, id]
  congr 1
  funext l
  simp

name: LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_reindex_iff
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_reindex_iff (σ : ι ≃ ι₁) :
    HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F ↔ HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι₁ E E' F
proof:
:=
  ⟨hasBoundedLift_reindex σ, hasBoundedLift_reindex σ.symm⟩

name: LiftCriterion.not_analyticAt_of_equiv_index
proof:
:= by
  intro h₁
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hasBoundedLift_reindex σ.symm (hasBoundedLift_of_analyticAt h₁)
  exact h (cpolynomialAt_of_lift P hP f₀).analyticAt

name: LiftCriterion.hasBoundedLift_of_card_eq_succ
statement:
theorem hasBoundedLift_of_card_eq_succ (hcard : Fintype.card ι₁ = Fintype.card ι + 1)
    (h : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι₁ (E × 𝕜) (E' × 𝕜) F) : HasBoundedLift 𝕜 ι E E' F
proof:
:=
  hasBoundedLift_reindex (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
    (hasBoundedLift_of_hasBoundedLift_succ
      (hasBoundedLift_reindex (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard) h))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.completedExteriorArray_laurentBlockWedge
statement:
theorem completedExteriorArray_laurentBlockWedge (j : ℕ) :
    completedExteriorArray (LaurentField κ r) ℕ k (laurentBlockWedge κ r k j)
      (fun i : Fin k => k * j + i.val + 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [laurentBlockWedge, completedExteriorArray_wedge]
  have hm : (fun i l : Fin k =>
      constantLaurentArray κ r (Pi.single (k * j + l.val + 1) (1 : κ))
        (k * j + i.val + 1)) = (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) (LaurentField κ r)) := by
    ext i l
    by_cases h : i = l
    · subst l
      simp [constantLaurentArray_apply]
    · have hval : i.val ≠ l.val := fun he => h (Fin.ext he)
      simp [constantLaurentArray_apply, h, hval]
  rw [hm, Matrix.det_one]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_laurentBlockWedge
statement: theorem norm_laurentBlockWedge (j : ℕ) : ‖laurentBlockWedge κ r k j‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (norm_laurentBlockWedge_le_one κ r k j)
  have h := (completedExteriorArray (LaurentField κ r) ℕ k
    (laurentBlockWedge κ r k j)).norm_coe_le_norm (fun i : Fin k => k * j + i.val + 1)
  rw [completedExteriorArray_laurentBlockWedge, norm_one] at h
  exact h.trans (norm_completedExteriorArray_le _ _ _ _)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_sum_laurentBlockWedge_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_laurentBlockWedge_le (N : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, laurentBlockWedge κ r k j‖ ≤ (N : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, ‖laurentBlockWedge κ r k j‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = N := by simp [norm_laurentBlockWedge]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.le_norm_sum_laurentBlockWedge
statement:
theorem le_norm_sum_laurentBlockWedge (hk : 2 ≤ k) (N : ℕ) :
    (N : ℝ) / geometricWeightMaximum r ≤
      ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, laurentBlockWedge κ r k j‖
proof:
:= by
  let α : Fin k := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  exact exteriorCoefficient_block_growth hk (completedLaurentCoefficient κ r ℕ k α)
    (laurentBlockWedge κ r k)
    (fun j => completedLaurentCoefficient_constant_wedge κ r ℕ k α
      (fun i => Pi.single (k * j + i.val + 1) (1 : κ)))
    (zero_lt_one.trans_le (one_le_geometricWeightMaximum r))
    (completedLaurentCoefficient_support_le κ r ℕ k α) N

name: AlternatingAnalytic.geometricWeightMaximum_eq_one
statement:
theorem geometricWeightMaximum_eq_one (hr : (r : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    geometricWeightMaximum r = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (one_le_geometricWeightMaximum r)
  unfold geometricWeightMaximum
  exact geometricWeight_le_one r.coe_nonneg hr _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_sum_laurentBlockWedge_eq
statement:
theorem norm_sum_laurentBlockWedge_eq (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hr : (r : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, laurentBlockWedge κ r k j‖ = (N : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (norm_sum_laurentBlockWedge_le κ r k N)
  simpa only [geometricWeightMaximum_eq_one r hr, div_one] using
    le_norm_sum_laurentBlockWedge κ r k hk N

name: L1PolynomialLift.norm_groupedCoefficient_le
statement:
theorem norm_groupedCoefficient_le {d : ℕ}
    (B : ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin d => lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) Z)
    (a : Fin d → J) :
    ‖FiniteWord.groupedCoefficient B.toMultilinearMap
      (fun j => lp.single 1 j (1 : K)) a‖ ≤ (d.factorial : ℝ) * ‖B‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold FiniteWord.groupedCoefficient
  split_ifs
  · calc
      ‖∑ u ∈ FiniteWord.wordOrbit a, B (fun i => lp.single 1 (u i) (1 : K))‖
          ≤ ∑ u ∈ FiniteWord.wordOrbit a,
              ‖B (fun i => lp.single 1 (u i) (1 : K))‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _u ∈ FiniteWord.wordOrbit a, ‖B‖ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro u hu
        simpa using B.le_opNorm (fun i => lp.single 1 (u i) (1 : K))
      _ = ((FiniteWord.wordOrbit a).card : ℝ) * ‖B‖ := by simp
      _ ≤ (d.factorial : ℝ) * ‖B‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast FiniteWord.card_wordOrbit_le a)
          (norm_nonneg B)
  · simp only [norm_zero]
    positivity

name: L1PolynomialLift.sum_piFinset_eq_sum_subtype
statement:
private theorem sum_piFinset_eq_sum_subtype
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (s : Finset J) (f : (Fin d → J) → A) :
    (∑ a ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin d => s), f a) =
      ∑ a : Fin d → s, f (fun i => (a i : J))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun a _ i => (a i : J)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro a ha
    exact Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr (fun i => (a i).property)
  · intro a ha a' ha' haa'
    funext i
    exact Subtype.ext (congrFun haa' i)
  · intro a ha
    exact ⟨fun i => ⟨a i, Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp ha i⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  · intro a ha
    rfl

name: L1PolynomialLift.diagonal_eq_sum_single
statement:
theorem diagonal_eq_sum_single
    (B D : ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin d => lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) Z)
    (hD : ∀ a : Fin d → J,
      D (fun r => lp.single 1 (a r) (1 : K)) =
        FiniteWord.groupedCoefficient B.toMultilinearMap
          (fun j => lp.single 1 j (1 : K)) a)
    (s : Finset J) (x : J → K) :
    D (fun _ => ∑ j ∈ s, lp.single 1 j (x j)) =
      B (fun _ => ∑ j ∈ s, lp.single 1 j (x j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [L1Coordinates.map_sum_single D (fun _ => x) (fun _ => s)]
  simp only [hD]
  rw [sum_piFinset_eq_sum_subtype]
  have hsingle (j : J) :
      x j • lp.single (E := fun _ : J => K) 1 j (1 : K) =
        lp.single 1 j (x j) := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using
      (lp.single_smul (E := fun _ : J => K) 1 j (x j) (1 : K)).symm
  simpa only [hsingle, ContinuousMultilinearMap.coe_coe] using
    (FiniteWord.finite_diagonal_grouping B.toMultilinearMap
      (fun j => lp.single 1 j (1 : K)) s x).symm

name: L1PolynomialLift.diagonal_eq_of_sum_single_eq
statement:
theorem diagonal_eq_of_sum_single_eq
    (D B : ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin d => lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) Z)
    (h : ∀ (s : Finset J) (x : J → K),
      D (fun _ => ∑ j ∈ s, lp.single 1 j (x j)) =
        B (fun _ => ∑ j ∈ s, lp.single 1 j (x j)))
    (x : lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) : D (fun _ => x) = B (fun _ => x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique (L1Coordinates.tendsto_map_sum_single D (fun _ => x))
  simpa only [h] using L1Coordinates.tendsto_map_sum_single B (fun _ => x)

name: L1PolynomialLift.exists_l1_diagonal_lift_of_completeSpace
statement:
theorem exists_l1_diagonal_lift_of_completeSpace
    (W : Submodule K Z) [CompleteSpace W] (d : ℕ)
    (B : ContinuousMultilinearMap K
      (fun _ : Fin d => lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) Z)
    (hB : ∀ x, B (fun _ => x) ∈ W) :
    ∃ C : ContinuousMultilinearMap K
        (fun _ : Fin d => lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) W,
      (∀ x, (C (fun _ => x) : Z) = B (fun _ => x)) ∧
      ‖C‖ ≤ (d.factorial : ℝ) * ‖B‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c : (Fin d → J) → W := fun a =>
    ⟨FiniteWord.groupedCoefficient B.toMultilinearMap
        (fun j => lp.single 1 j (1 : K)) a,
      FiniteWord.groupedCoefficient_mem W B.toMultilinearMap
        (fun j => lp.single 1 j (1 : K)) hB a⟩
  have hc (a : Fin d → J) : ‖c a‖ ≤ (d.factorial : ℝ) * ‖B‖ :=
    norm_groupedCoefficient_le B a
  let C := L1Coordinates.continuousMultilinearOfBounded (K := K) c
    ((d.factorial : ℝ) * ‖B‖) hc
  refine ⟨C, ?_, L1Coordinates.continuousMultilinearOfBounded_norm_le
    c _ (by positivity) hc⟩
  let D := W.subtypeL.compContinuousMultilinearMap C
  have hD (a : Fin d → J) :
      D (fun r => lp.single 1 (a r) (1 : K)) =
        FiniteWord.groupedCoefficient B.toMultilinearMap
          (fun j => lp.single 1 j (1 : K)) a := by
    change (C (fun r => lp.single 1 (a r) (1 : K)) : Z) = _
    rw [L1Coordinates.continuousMultilinearOfBounded_single]
  exact diagonal_eq_of_sum_single_eq D B (diagonal_eq_sum_single B D hD)

name: L1PolynomialLift.exists_l1_diagonal_lift
statement:
theorem exists_l1_diagonal_lift [CompleteSpace Z]
    (W : Submodule K Z) (hW : IsClosed (W : Set Z)) (d : ℕ)
    (B : ContinuousMultilinearMap K
      (fun _ : Fin d => lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) Z)
    (hB : ∀ x, B (fun _ => x) ∈ W) :
    ∃ C : ContinuousMultilinearMap K
        (fun _ : Fin d => lp (fun _ : J => K) 1) W,
      (∀ x, (C (fun _ => x) : Z) = B (fun _ => x)) ∧
      ‖C‖ ≤ (d.factorial : ℝ) * ‖B‖
proof:
:= by
  let : CompleteSpace W := hW.completeSpace_coe
  exact exists_l1_diagonal_lift_of_completeSpace W d B hB

name: AlternatingAnalytic.root_limsup_lt_top_iff_exponential_bound
statement:
theorem root_limsup_lt_top_iff_exponential_bound (s : ℕ → ℝ≥0) :
    Filter.limsup
      (fun m : ℕ => (s m : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹))
      Filter.atTop < ⊤ ↔
    ∃ A : ℝ, 1 ≤ A ∧ ∀ m, (s m : ℝ) ≤ A ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨B, hB, _⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_nnreal_btwn.mp h
    have he := Filter.eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt hB
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp he
    let A : ℝ≥0 := max 1 (max B (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, s i))
    have hA : 1 ≤ A := le_max_left _ _
    refine ⟨A, by exact_mod_cast hA, fun m => ?_⟩
    have hm : s m ≤ A ^ (m + 1) := by
      by_cases hn : N ≤ m
      · have hroot := (hN m hn).le
        have hpow := (ENNReal.rpow_inv_le_iff (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (m + 1 : ℕ))).mp hroot
        rw [ENNReal.rpow_natCast] at hpow
        have hsmall : s m ≤ B ^ (m + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hpow
        exact hsmall.trans (pow_le_pow_left' ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)) _)
      · have hsmall : s m ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, s i := by
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => by positivity) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
        exact hsmall.trans (((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)).trans
          (le_self_pow₀ hA (Nat.succ_ne_zero m)))
    exact_mod_cast hm
  · rintro ⟨A, hA, hs⟩
    let B : ℝ≥0 := ⟨A, by linarith⟩
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt (b := (B : ℝ≥0∞))
    · apply Filter.limsup_le_of_le (by isBoundedDefault)
      apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      intro m
      apply (ENNReal.rpow_inv_le_iff (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (m + 1 : ℕ))).mpr
      rw [ENNReal.rpow_natCast]
      have hm : s m ≤ B ^ (m + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hs m
      exact_mod_cast hm
    · exact ENNReal.coe_lt_top

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exponential_bound_of_mul_pow_bound
statement:
theorem exponential_bound_of_mul_pow_bound (s : ℕ → ℝ)
    {C r : ℝ} (_hC : 0 < C) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hs : ∀ m, s m ≤ C * r ^ (m + 1)) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 1 ≤ A ∧ ∀ m, s m ≤ A ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := max 1 C
  let t : ℝ := max 1 r
  have hc : 1 ≤ c := le_max_left _ _
  have ht : 1 ≤ t := le_max_left _ _
  refine ⟨c * t, one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hc ht, fun m => ?_⟩
  calc
    s m ≤ C * r ^ (m + 1) := hs m
    _ ≤ c ^ (m + 1) * t ^ (m + 1) := by
      apply mul_le_mul
      · exact (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_self_pow₀ hc (Nat.succ_ne_zero m))
      · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hr.le (le_max_right _ _) _
      · positivity
      · positivity
    _ = (c * t) ^ (m + 1) := (mul_pow _ _ _).symm

name: AlternatingAnalytic.UniversalAnalyticReflection.analyticOnNhd_extend
statement:
theorem UniversalAnalyticReflection.analyticOnNhd_extend
    (h : UniversalAnalyticReflection K P)
    {Z : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace K Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
    (W : Submodule K Z) (hW : IsClosed (W : Set Z))
    {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U) (f : U → W)
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd K (W.subtypeL ∘ Function.extend Subtype.val f 0) U) :

proof:
:=
  h Z W hW U hU _ hf

name: AlternatingAnalytic.UniversalAnalyticReflection.analyticOn_extend
statement:
theorem UniversalAnalyticReflection.analyticOn_extend
    (h : UniversalAnalyticReflection K P)
    {Z : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace K Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
    (W : Submodule K Z) (hW : IsClosed (W : Set Z))
    {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U) (f : U → W)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exists_zero_subspace_coefficient
statement:
theorem exists_zero_subspace_coefficient
    {Z : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace K Z]
    (W : Submodule K Z)
    (B : ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin 0 => P) Z)
    (hB : ∀ x, B (fun _ => x) ∈ W) :
    ∃ C : ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin 0 => P) W,
      (∀ x, (C (fun _ => x) : Z) = B (fun _ => x)) ∧ ‖C‖ ≤ ‖B‖
proof:
:= by
  have hmem (v : Fin 0 → P) : B v ∈ W := by
    have hv : v = fun _ => (0 : P) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hv]
    exact hB 0
  refine ⟨B.codRestrict W hmem, fun _ => rfl, ?_⟩
  exact ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg B) (fun v => B.le_opNorm v)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticAt_subtype_of_tensor_projections
statement:
theorem analyticAt_subtype_of_tensor_projections
    (R : ∀ m : ℕ, TensorPower K P (m + 1) →L[K] DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1))
    (hR : ∀ m, (R m).comp (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1)).subtypeL =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id K (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1)))
    {A : ℝ} (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hbound : ∀ m, ‖R m‖ ≤ A ^ (m + 1))
    {Z : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace K Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
    (W : Submodule K Z) (hW : IsClosed (W : Set Z))
    {f : P → W} {x : P} (hf : AnalyticAt K (fun y => (f y : Z)) x) :
    AnalyticAt K f x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf
  have hmem (n : ℕ) (y : P) : p n (fun _ => y) ∈ W :=
    HasFPowerSeriesAt.diagonal_mem_closedSubspace W hW hp
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => (f z).property) n y
  have hcoeff (n : ℕ) :
      ∃ C : ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin n => P) W,
        (∀ y, (C (fun _ => y) : Z) = p n (fun _ => y)) ∧
          ‖C‖ ≤ A ^ n * ‖p n‖ := by
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      simpa only [pow_zero, one_mul] using
        exists_zero_subspace_coefficient W (p 0) (hmem 0)
    | succ m =>
      obtain ⟨C, hdiag, hnorm⟩ := exists_diagonal_lift_of_projection (m + 1)
        (R m) (hR m) W hW (p (m + 1)) (hmem (m + 1))
      refine ⟨C, hdiag, hnorm.trans ?_⟩
      calc
        ‖p (m + 1)‖ * ‖R m‖ ≤ ‖p (m + 1)‖ * A ^ (m + 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound m) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = A ^ (m + 1) * ‖p (m + 1)‖ := mul_comm _ _
  choose q hdiag hnorm using hcoeff
  exact analyticAt_of_subspace_series W hp q (zero_le_one.trans hA) hnorm hdiag

name: AlternatingAnalytic.universal_analytic_reflection_of_tensor_projections
statement:
theorem universal_analytic_reflection_of_tensor_projections
    (R : ∀ m : ℕ, TensorPower K P (m + 1) →L[K] DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1))
    (hR : ∀ m, (R m).comp (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1)).subtypeL =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id K (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1)))
    {A : ℝ} (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hbound : ∀ m, ‖R m‖ ≤ A ^ (m + 1)) :
    UniversalAnalyticReflection K P
proof:
:= by
  intro Z _ _ _ W hW U _ f hf x hx
  exact analyticAt_subtype_of_tensor_projections R hR hA hbound W hW (hf x hx)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.tensorTest_expansion_deltaCoordinate
statement:
theorem tensorTest_expansion_deltaCoordinate
    {q : FormalMultilinearSeries K P (tensorTestSubmodule (K := K) (P := P))}
    (hq : HasFPowerSeriesAt (tensorTestMap (K := K) (P := P)) q 0)
    (m : ℕ) (x : P) :
    (tensorTestDeltaCoordinate m (q (m + 1) (fun _ => x)) : TensorPower K P (m + 1)) =
      diagonalTensor (K := K) (m + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  let j := (tensorTestSubmodule (K := K) (P := P)).subtypeL
  have hjq : HasFPowerSeriesAt
      (fun x : P => (tensorTestMap (K := K) x : tensorTestSpace K P))
      (j.compFormalMultilinearSeries q) 0 := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hq
    exact ⟨r, j.comp_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall hr⟩
  have ha : HasFPowerSeriesAt
      (fun x : P => (tensorTestMap (K := K) x : tensorTestSpace K P))
      tensorTestSeries 0 := ⟨1, tensorTestMap_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall⟩
  have hz : HasFPowerSeriesAt (0 : P → tensorTestSpace K P)
      (j.compFormalMultilinearSeries q - tensorTestSeries) 0 := by
    simpa only [sub_self] using hjq.sub ha
  have hd := hz.apply_eq_zero (m + 1) x
  have he : j (q (m + 1) (fun _ => x)) =
      tensorTestSeries (K := K) (m + 1) (fun _ => x) := by
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hd
  simpa only [tensorTestDeltaCoordinate_coe, j, Submodule.subtypeL_apply,
    tensorTestSeries_coordinate, diagonalTensor] using congrArg (tensorTestCoordinate m) he

name: AlternatingAnalytic.tensorTestProjection_retraction
statement:
theorem tensorTestProjection_retraction
    {q : FormalMultilinearSeries K P (tensorTestSubmodule (K := K) (P := P))}
    (hq : HasFPowerSeriesAt (tensorTestMap (K := K) (P := P)) q 0) (m : ℕ) :
    (tensorTestProjection q m).comp (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1)).subtypeL =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id K (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply retraction_of_fixes_diagonalTensor
  intro x
  simpa only [tensorTestProjection, diagonalTensor,
    completedProjectiveTensorLiftIsometry_tprod,
    ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply] using
      tensorTest_expansion_deltaCoordinate hq m x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_tensorTestProjection_le
statement:
theorem norm_tensorTestProjection_le
    (q : FormalMultilinearSeries K P (tensorTestSubmodule (K := K) (P := P))) (m : ℕ) :
    ‖tensorTestProjection q m‖ ≤ ‖q (m + 1)‖
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖tensorTestProjection q m‖ =
        ‖(tensorTestDeltaCoordinate m).compContinuousMultilinearMap (q (m + 1))‖ :=
      norm_completedProjectiveTensorLiftIsometry _ _
    _ ≤ ‖tensorTestDeltaCoordinate (K := K) (P := P) m‖ * ‖q (m + 1)‖ :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
    _ ≤ 1 * ‖q (m + 1)‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (norm_tensorTestDeltaCoordinate_le m) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = ‖q (m + 1)‖ := one_mul _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.tensor_projections_of_analyticAt_tensorTestMap
statement:
theorem tensor_projections_of_analyticAt_tensorTestMap
    (h : AnalyticAt K (tensorTestMap (K := K) (P := P)) 0) :
    ∃ R : ∀ m : ℕ, TensorPower K P (m + 1) →L[K] DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1),
      (∀ m, (R m).comp (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1)).subtypeL =
        ContinuousLinearMap.id K (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1))) ∧
      ∃ C r : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < r ∧ ∀ m, ‖R m‖ ≤ C * r ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨C, r, hC, hr, hbound⟩ := q.le_mul_pow_of_radius_pos hq.radius_pos
  refine ⟨tensorTestProjection q, tensorTestProjection_retraction hq, C, r, hC, hr, ?_⟩
  intro m
  exact (norm_tensorTestProjection_le q m).trans (hbound (m + 1))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.tensor_projections_of_universal_analytic_reflection
statement:
theorem tensor_projections_of_universal_analytic_reflection
    (h : UniversalAnalyticReflection K P) :
    ∃ R : ∀ m : ℕ, TensorPower K P (m + 1) →L[K] DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1),
      (∀ m, (R m).comp (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1)).subtypeL =
        ContinuousLinearMap.id K (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1))) ∧
      ∃ C r : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < r ∧ ∀ m, ‖R m‖ ≤ C * r ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply tensor_projections_of_analyticAt_tensorTestMap
  exact h (tensorTestSpace K P) tensorTestSubmodule isClosed_tensorTestSubmodule
    (Metric.ball 0 1) Metric.isOpen_ball tensorTestMap tensorTestMap_analyticOnNhd
    0 (by simp)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.tensor_projections_root_limsup_iff
statement:
theorem tensor_projections_root_limsup_iff
    (R : ∀ m : ℕ, TensorPower K P (m + 1) →L[K] DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1)) :
    Filter.limsup
      (fun m : ℕ => (‖R m‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹))
      Filter.atTop < ⊤ ↔
    ∃ A : ℝ, 1 ≤ A ∧ ∀ m, ‖R m‖ ≤ A ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:=
  root_limsup_lt_top_iff_exponential_bound (fun m => ‖R m‖₊)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.universal_analytic_reflection_iff_exponential_tensor_projections
statement:
theorem universal_analytic_reflection_iff_exponential_tensor_projections :
    UniversalAnalyticReflection K P ↔
      ∃ R : ∀ m : ℕ, TensorPower K P (m + 1) →L[K] DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1),
        (∀ m, (R m).comp (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1)).subtypeL =
          ContinuousLinearMap.id K (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1))) ∧
        ∃ A : ℝ, 1 ≤ A ∧ ∀ m, ‖R m‖ ≤ A ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨R, hR, C, r, hC, hr, hbound⟩ :=
      tensor_projections_of_universal_analytic_reflection h
    exact ⟨R, hR, exponential_bound_of_mul_pow_bound (fun m => ‖R m‖) hC hr hbound⟩
  · rintro ⟨R, hR, A, hA, hbound⟩
    exact universal_analytic_reflection_of_tensor_projections R hR hA hbound

name: AlternatingAnalytic.universal_analytic_reflection_iff_tensor_projections
statement:
theorem universal_analytic_reflection_iff_tensor_projections :
    UniversalAnalyticReflection K P ↔
      ∃ R : ∀ m : ℕ, TensorPower K P (m + 1) →L[K] DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1),
        (∀ m, (R m).comp (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1)).subtypeL =
          ContinuousLinearMap.id K (DiagonalSpan K P (m + 1))) ∧
        Filter.limsup
          (fun m : ℕ => (‖R m‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹))
          Filter.atTop < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [universal_analytic_reflection_iff_exponential_tensor_projections]
  simp only [tensor_projections_root_limsup_iff]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.sortedAlternatingMap_apply
statement:
theorem sortedAlternatingMap_apply (b : Basis I K D) (n : ℕ)
    (g : D [×n]→L[K] F) (v : Fin n → D) :
    sortedAlternatingMap b n g v =
      ((b.exteriorPower n).repr (exteriorPower.ιMulti K n v)).sum
        (fun s c => c • g (b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s))
proof:
:= by
  simp [sortedAlternatingMap, exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv_symm_apply,
    Basis.constr_apply]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.sortedAlternatingMap_basis
statement:
theorem sortedAlternatingMap_basis (b : Basis I K D) (n : ℕ)
    (g : D [×n]→L[K] F) (s : Set.powersetCard I n) :
    sortedAlternatingMap b n g (b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s) =
      g (b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s)
proof:
:= by
  change (b.exteriorPower n).constr K
    (fun t => g (b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t))
    (exteriorPower.ιMulti_family K n b s) = _
  rw [← exteriorPower.basis_apply, Basis.constr_basis]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.sortedAlternatingMap_retract
statement:
theorem sortedAlternatingMap_retract (b : Basis I K D) (n : ℕ)
    (g : D [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F) :
    sortedAlternatingMap b n g.toContinuousMultilinearMap = g.toAlternatingMap
proof:
:= by
  apply exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv.injective
  change exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv
    (exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv.symm _) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply (b.exteriorPower n).ext
  intro s
  change (b.exteriorPower n).constr K
    (fun t => g (b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t))
    ((b.exteriorPower n) s) = _
  rw [Basis.constr_basis, exteriorPower.basis_apply]
  simp [exteriorPower.ιMulti_family]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_sortedAlternatingMap_le
statement:
theorem norm_sortedAlternatingMap_le (b : Basis I K D)
    (hb : ∀ i x, ‖b.coord i x‖ * ‖b i‖ ≤ ‖x‖) (n : ℕ)
    (g : D [×n]→L[K] F) (v : Fin n → D) :
    ‖sortedAlternatingMap b n g v‖ ≤ ‖g‖ * ∏ i, ‖v i‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sortedAlternatingMap_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  apply IsUltrametricDist.norm_sum_le_of_forall_le_of_nonneg (by positivity)
  intro s _
  rw [exteriorPower.basis_repr_apply, exteriorPower.ιMultiDual_apply_ιMulti, norm_smul]
  let t := Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s
  have hdet := norm_det_mul_prod_le
    (Matrix.of fun i j => b.coord (t i) (v j)) (fun i => ‖b (t i)‖)
    (fun j => ‖v j‖) (fun i => norm_nonneg _) (fun i j => hb _ _)
  have htrans : (Matrix.of fun i j => b.coord (t j) (v i)).det =
      (Matrix.of fun i j => b.coord (t i) (v j)).det := Matrix.det_transpose _
  change ‖(Matrix.of fun i j => b.coord (t j) (v i)).det‖ * ‖g (b ∘ t)‖ ≤ _
  rw [htrans]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(Matrix.of fun i j => b.coord (t i) (v j)).det‖ *
        (‖g‖ * ∏ i, ‖b (t i)‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (g.le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = ‖g‖ * (‖(Matrix.of fun i j => b.coord (t i) (v j)).det‖ *
        ∏ i, ‖b (t i)‖) := by ring
    _ ≤ ‖g‖ * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdet (norm_nonneg _)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_sortedBasisRetraction_le
statement:
theorem norm_sortedBasisRetraction_le (b : Basis I K D)
    (hb : ∀ i x, ‖b.coord i x‖ * ‖b i‖ ≤ ‖x‖) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖sortedBasisRetraction (F := F) b hb n‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  AlternatingMap.mkContinuousLinear_norm_le _ zero_le_one _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.sortedBasisRetraction_apply
statement:
theorem sortedBasisRetraction_apply (b : Basis I K D)
    (hb : ∀ i x, ‖b.coord i x‖ * ‖b i‖ ≤ ‖x‖) (n : ℕ)
    (g : D [×n]→L[K] F) (v : Fin n → D) :
    sortedBasisRetraction b hb n g v = sortedAlternatingMap b n g v
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.sortedBasisRetraction_retract
statement:
theorem sortedBasisRetraction_retract (b : Basis I K D)
    (hb : ∀ i x, ‖b.coord i x‖ * ‖b i‖ ≤ ‖x‖) (n : ℕ)
    (g : D [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F) :
    sortedBasisRetraction b hb n g.toContinuousMultilinearMap = g
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (sortedAlternatingMap_retract b n g) v

name: AlternatingAnalytic.schauderSpanBasis_coord
statement:
theorem schauderSpanBasis_coord (b : UnconditionalSchauderBasis I K D)
    (i : I) (x : Submodule.span K (Set.range b)) :
    (Basis.span b.linearIndependent).coord i x = b.coord i x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : (Basis.span b.linearIndependent).coord i =
      (b.coord i).toLinearMap.comp (Submodule.span K (Set.range b)).subtype := by
    apply (Basis.span b.linearIndependent).ext
    intro j
    simp [b.ortho, Pi.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.schauderSpanBasis_bound
statement:
theorem schauderSpanBasis_bound (b : UnconditionalSchauderBasis I K D)
    (hb : ∀ i x, ‖b.coord i x‖ * ‖b i‖ ≤ ‖x‖)
    (i : I) (x : Submodule.span K (Set.range b)) :
    ‖(Basis.span b.linearIndependent).coord i x‖ *
      ‖Basis.span b.linearIndependent i‖ ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [schauderSpanBasis_coord]
  simpa only [← Submodule.norm_coe, Basis.coe_span_apply] using hb i x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.schauderSpan_denseRange
statement:
theorem schauderSpan_denseRange (b : UnconditionalSchauderBasis I K D) :
    DenseRange (Submodule.span K (Set.range b)).subtypeₗᵢ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x
  apply mem_closure_of_tendsto (b.tendsto_proj x)
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro A
  refine ⟨⟨b.proj A x, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [b.proj_apply]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
    Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.bounded_linearFunctional_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem bounded_linearFunctional_of_finiteDimensional [FiniteDimensional K E]
    (ℓ : E →ₗ[K] K) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x : E, ‖ℓ x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  let ℓc : E →L[K] K := ⟨ℓ, ℓ.continuous_of_finiteDimensional⟩
  exact ⟨‖ℓc‖, norm_nonneg _, ℓc.le_opNorm⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.finiteDimensional_bounded_and_complete
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_bounded_and_complete [FiniteDimensional K E] :
    (∀ ℓ : E →ₗ[K] K, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x : E, ‖ℓ x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖) ∧
      CompleteSpace E
proof:
:=
  ⟨bounded_linearFunctional_of_finiteDimensional, FiniteDimensional.complete K E⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.continuous_finBasis_coord
statement:
theorem continuous_finBasis_coord [FiniteDimensional K E]
    (i : Fin (Module.finrank K E)) : Continuous ((Module.finBasis K E).coord i)
proof:
:=
  ((Module.finBasis K E).coord i).continuous_of_finiteDimensional

name: AlternatingAnalytic.cpolynomialAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalDomain
statement:
theorem cpolynomialAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalDomain [FiniteDimensional K E]
    (k : ℕ) (f₀ : E →L[K] E') :
    CPolynomialAt K (LiftCriterion.Q K (Fin k) E E' F) f₀
proof:
:=
  cpolynomialAt_Q_of_finiteCoordinateDomain (Module.finBasis K E)
    continuous_finBasis_coord k f₀

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalDomain
statement:
theorem analyticAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalDomain [FiniteDimensional K E]
    (k : ℕ) (f₀ : E →L[K] E') :
    AnalyticAt K (LiftCriterion.Q K (Fin k) E E' F) f₀
proof:
:=
  (cpolynomialAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalDomain k f₀).analyticAt

name: AlternatingAnalytic.cpolynomialAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalCodomain
statement:
theorem cpolynomialAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalCodomain [FiniteDimensional K E']
    (k : ℕ) (f₀ : E →L[K] E') :
    CPolynomialAt K (LiftCriterion.Q K (Fin k) E E' F) f₀
proof:
:=
  cpolynomialAt_Q_of_finiteCoordinateCodomain (Module.finBasis K E')
    continuous_finBasis_coord k f₀

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalCodomain
statement:
theorem analyticAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalCodomain [FiniteDimensional K E']
    (k : ℕ) (f₀ : E →L[K] E') :
    AnalyticAt K (LiftCriterion.Q K (Fin k) E E' F) f₀
proof:
:=
  (cpolynomialAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalCodomain k f₀).analyticAt

name: AlternatingAnalytic.finiteDimensional_positive
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_positive
    (h : FiniteDimensional K E ∨ FiniteDimensional K E') :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (f₀ : E →L[K] E'),
      CPolynomialAt K (LiftCriterion.Q K (Fin k) E E' F) f₀ ∧
        AnalyticAt K (LiftCriterion.Q K (Fin k) E E' F) f₀
proof:
:= by
  intro k f₀
  rcases h with h | h
  · let := h
    exact ⟨cpolynomialAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalDomain k f₀,
      analyticAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalDomain k f₀⟩
  · let := h
    exact ⟨cpolynomialAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalCodomain k f₀,
      analyticAt_Q_of_finiteDimensionalCodomain k f₀⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.auxiliaryInclusion_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryInclusion_apply (x : Fin n → K p r) (i : Fin n) :
    auxiliaryInclusion p r n x i = algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) (x i)
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.denseRange_auxiliaryInclusion
statement: theorem denseRange_auxiliaryInclusion : DenseRange (auxiliaryInclusion p r n)
proof:
:=
  DenseRange.piMap fun _ => RationalField.denseRange_algebraMap (ZMod p) r

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.inclusionE_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusionE_apply (x : E p r n) :
    inclusionE p r n x = ((x.1 : A p r), fun i => algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) (x.2 i))
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.inclusionD_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusionD_apply (x : D p r n) :
    inclusionD p r n x = ((x.1 : A p r), fun i => algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) (x.2 i))
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.denseRange_inclusionE
statement: theorem denseRange_inclusionE : DenseRange (inclusionE p r n)
proof:
:=
  (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.denseRange_subtype p r).prodMap
    (denseRange_auxiliaryInclusion p r n)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.denseRange_inclusionD
statement: theorem denseRange_inclusionD : DenseRange (inclusionD p r n)

  (DeterminantPair.denseRange_D_subtype p r).prodMap (denseRange_auxiliaryInclusion p r n)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.basis_castAdd
statement:
@[simp] theorem basis_castAdd (i : Fin p) :
    basis p r n (Fin.castAdd n i) = (e p r i, 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [basis, Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Module.Basis.prod_apply, e]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.basis_natAdd
statement:
@[simp] theorem basis_natAdd (i : Fin n) :
    basis p r n (Fin.natAdd p i) = (0, Pi.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [basis, Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Module.Basis.prod_apply, Pi.basisFun_apply]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.inclusionE_standardE
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusionE_standardE (i : Fin (p + n)) :
    inclusionE p r n (standardE p r n i) = basis p r n i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective i
  cases i with
  | inl i => simp [standardE, e_eq_epsilon_pow]; rfl
  | inr i =>
      ext j <;> simp [standardE, Pi.single_apply, apply_ite]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.inclusionD_standardD
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusionD_standardD (i : Fin (p + n)) :
    inclusionD p r n (standardD p r n i) = basis p r n i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective i
  cases i with
  | inl i => simp [standardD]; rfl
  | inr i =>
      ext j <;> simp [standardD, Pi.single_apply, apply_ite]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.norm_basis
statement: @[simp] theorem norm_basis (i : Fin (p + n)) : ‖basis p r n i‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective i
  cases i <;> simp [Prod.norm_def, e, Pi.norm_single]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.norm_standardE
statement: @[simp] theorem norm_standardE (i : Fin (p + n)) : ‖standardE p r n i‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (inclusionE p r n).norm_map, inclusionE_standardE, norm_basis]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.norm_standardD
statement: @[simp] theorem norm_standardD (i : Fin (p + n)) : ‖standardD p r n i‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (inclusionD p r n).norm_map, inclusionD_standardD, norm_basis]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.delta_basis
statement: @[simp] theorem delta_basis : delta p r n (basis p r n) = 1
proof:
:=
  (basis p r n).det_self

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.delta_standardE
statement:
@[simp] theorem delta_standardE :
    delta p r n (fun i => inclusionE p r n (standardE p r n i)) = 1
proof: := by simp only [inclusionE_standardE, delta_basis]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.delta_standardD
statement:
@[simp] theorem delta_standardD :
    delta p r n (fun i => inclusionD p r n (standardD p r n i)) = 1
proof: := by simp only [inclusionD_standardD, delta_basis]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.norm_repr_le
statement:
theorem norm_repr_le (x : H p r n) (i : Fin (p + n)) :
    ‖(basis p r n).repr x i‖ ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective i
  cases i with
  | inl i =>
      simp only [basis, Module.Basis.repr_reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
        Module.Basis.prod_repr_inl]
      exact (TruncatedPolynomial.norm_coefficient_le (L p r) p x.1 i).trans
        (le_max_left _ _)
  | inr i =>
      simp only [basis, Module.Basis.repr_reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
        Module.Basis.prod_repr_inr, Pi.basisFun_repr]
      exact (norm_le_pi_norm x.2 i).trans (le_max_right _ _)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.norm_delta_le
statement:
theorem norm_delta_le (x : Fin (p + n) → H p r n) :
    ‖delta p r n x‖ ≤ ∏ i, ‖x i‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa [delta, Module.Basis.det_apply] using
    norm_det_mul_prod_le ((basis p r n).toMatrix x) (fun _ => 1) (fun j => ‖x j‖)
      (fun _ => zero_le_one) (fun i j => by simpa only [Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply, mul_one] using norm_repr_le p r n (x j) i)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.norm_delta_inclusionE_le
statement:
theorem norm_delta_inclusionE_le (x : Fin (p + n) → E p r n) :
    ‖delta p r n (fun i => inclusionE p r n (x i))‖ ≤ ∏ i, ‖x i‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [LinearIsometry.norm_map] using norm_delta_le p r n (fun i => inclusionE p r n (x i))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.norm_delta_inclusionD_le
statement:
theorem norm_delta_inclusionD_le (x : Fin (p + n) → D p r n) :
    ‖delta p r n (fun i => inclusionD p r n (x i))‖ ≤ ∏ i, ‖x i‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [LinearIsometry.norm_map] using norm_delta_le p r n (fun i => inclusionD p r n (x i))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.repr_castAdd
statement:
@[simp] theorem repr_castAdd (x : H p r n) (i : Fin p) :
    (basis p r n).repr x (Fin.castAdd n i) = TruncatedPolynomial.coeff (L p r) p x.1 i
proof:
:= by
  simp [basis, TruncatedPolynomial.coeff,
    Module.Basis.equivFun_apply]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.repr_natAdd
statement:
@[simp] theorem repr_natAdd (x : H p r n) (i : Fin n) :
    (basis p r n).repr x (Fin.natAdd p i) = x.2 i
proof:
:= by
  simp [basis]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.repr_castSucc
statement:
theorem repr_castSucc (x : H p r (n + 1)) (i : Fin (p + n)) :
    (basis p r (n + 1)).repr x i.castSucc =
      (basis p r n).repr (x.1, fun j => x.2 j.castSucc) i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective i
  cases i with
  | inl i => simp only [finSumFinEquiv_apply_left, Fin.castSucc_castAdd, repr_castAdd]
  | inr i =>
      change (basis p r (n + 1)).repr x (Fin.natAdd p i.castSucc) = _
      rw [repr_natAdd]
      simp only [finSumFinEquiv_apply_right, repr_natAdd]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.repr_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem repr_last (x : H p r (n + 1)) :
    (basis p r (n + 1)).repr x (Fin.last (p + n)) = x.2 (Fin.last n)
proof:
:= by
  change (basis p r (n + 1)).repr x (Fin.natAdd p (Fin.last n)) = _
  exact repr_natAdd p r (n+1) x (Fin.last n)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.delta_succ
statement:
theorem delta_succ (x : Fin (p + (n + 1)) → H p r (n + 1)) :
    delta p r (n + 1) x = ∑ j : Fin (p + n + 1),
      (-1 : L p r) ^ ((p + n) + (j : ℕ)) * (x j).2 (Fin.last n) *
        delta p r n (fun i => ((x (j.succAbove i)).1,
          fun k => (x (j.succAbove i)).2 k.castSucc))
proof:
:= by
  rw [delta, Module.Basis.det_apply, Matrix.det_succ_row _ (Fin.last (p+n))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [Fin.val_last, Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply, repr_last]
  congr 1
  unfold delta
  rw [Module.Basis.det_apply]
  congr 1
  ext i k
  simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply,
    Fin.succAbove_last, repr_castSucc]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.delta_mem_of_unpadded
statement:
theorem delta_mem_of_unpadded (S : Submodule (K p r) (A p r))
    (T : Submodule (K p r) (L p r))
    (h : ∀ x : Fin p → S, DeterminantPair.delta p r (fun i => x i) ∈ T)
    (x : Fin (p + n) → S × (Fin n → K p r)) :
    delta p r n (fun i => ((x i).1, fun j => algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) ((x i).2 j))) ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have heq : delta p r 0 (fun i => ((x i).1,
          fun j => algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) ((x i).2 j))) =
          DeterminantPair.delta p r (fun i => (x i).1) := by
        rw [delta, Module.Basis.det_apply, DeterminantPair.delta]
        congr 1
        ext i j
        change (basis p r 0).repr _ (Fin.castAdd 0 i) = _
        rw [repr_castAdd]
        rfl
      rw [heq]
      exact h (fun i => (x i).1)
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [delta_succ]
      apply T.sum_mem
      intro j _
      have hminor := ih (fun i => ((x (j.succAbove i)).1,
        fun k => (x (j.succAbove i)).2 k.castSucc))
      convert T.smul_mem ((-1 : K p r) ^ ((p+n)+(j : ℕ)) *
        (x j).2 (Fin.last n)) hminor using 1;
        simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.delta_inclusionD_mem
statement:
theorem delta_inclusionD_mem (x : Fin (p+n) → D p r n) :

proof:
:= by

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.delta_padTuple
statement:
theorem delta_padTuple (S : Submodule (K p r) (A p r)) (x : Fin p → S) :
    delta p r n (fun i => ((padTuple p r n S x i).1,
      fun j => algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) ((padTuple p r n S x i).2 j))) =
      DeterminantPair.delta p r (fun i => x i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [delta, Module.Basis.det_apply,
    ← Matrix.det_reindex_self finSumFinEquiv.symm]
  have hmat : Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv.symm finSumFinEquiv.symm
      ((basis p r n).toMatrix (fun i => ((padTuple p r n S x i).1,
        fun j => algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) ((padTuple p r n S x i).2 j)))) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks
        (fun i j => TruncatedPolynomial.coeff (L p r) p (x j) i) 0 0
        (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (L p r)) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;>
      simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply,
        Matrix.fromBlocks, Pi.single_apply, Matrix.one_apply, eq_comm]
  rw [hmat, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, Matrix.det_one, mul_one]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.span_delta_eq_unpadded
statement:
theorem span_delta_eq_unpadded (S : Submodule (K p r) (A p r)) :
    Submodule.span (K p r) (Set.range (fun x : Fin (p+n) → S × (Fin n → K p r) =>
      delta p r n (fun i => ((x i).1,
        fun j => algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) ((x i).2 j))))) =
    Submodule.span (K p r) (Set.range (fun x : Fin p → S =>
      DeterminantPair.delta p r (fun i => x i)))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact delta_mem_of_unpadded p r n S _
      (fun y => Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self y)) x
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change DeterminantPair.delta p r (fun i => x i) ∈ _
    rw [← delta_padTuple p r n S x]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨padTuple p r n S x, rfl⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.span_delta_E
statement:
theorem span_delta_E :
    Submodule.span (K p r) (Set.range (fun x : Fin (p+n) → E p r n =>
      delta p r n (fun i => inclusionE p r n (x i)))) = primarySpan p r
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (fun x : Fin (p+n) → E p r n => delta p r n (fun i => inclusionE p r n (x i))) =
    (fun x : Fin (p+n) → RigidDenseSource.Concrete.source p r × (Fin n → K p r) =>
      delta p r n (fun i => ((x i).1,
        fun j => algebraMap (K p r) (L p r) ((x i).2 j)))) from rfl]
  rw [span_delta_eq_unpadded, delta_span_E]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.Padding.norm_determinantD
statement: @[simp] theorem norm_determinantD : ‖determinantD p r n‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (determinantD p r n).opNorm_le_bound zero_le_one
    intro x
    change ‖delta p r n (fun i => inclusionD p r n (x i))‖ ≤ 1 * ∏ i, ‖x i‖
    simpa only [one_mul] using norm_delta_inclusionD_le p r n x
  · have h := (determinantD p r n).le_opNorm (standardD p r n)
    have hnorm : ‖determinantD p r n (standardD p r n)‖ = 1 := by
      change ‖(determinantD p r n (standardD p r n) : L p r)‖ = 1
      rw [determinantD_standard, norm_one]
    simpa only [hnorm, norm_standardD, Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one] using h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.multilinear_mem_span_generator_tuples
statement:
theorem multilinear_mem_span_generator_tuples
    (f : MultilinearMap K (fun _ : ι => A) B) (gen : J → A) (v : ι → A)
    (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range gen)) :
    f v ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun s : ι → J => f (fun i => gen (s i))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose c hc using fun i => (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun K).mp (hv i)
  have heq : v = fun i => ∑ j, c i j • gen j := funext fun i => (hc i).symm
  rw [heq, f.map_sum]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro s _
  rw [f.map_smul_univ]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self s))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.multilinear_span_generator_tuples
statement:
theorem multilinear_span_generator_tuples
    (f : MultilinearMap K (fun _ : ι => A) B) (gen : J → A) :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun v : ι → Submodule.span K (Set.range gen) =>
      f (fun i => (v i : A)))) =
    Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun s : ι → J => f (fun i => gen (s i))))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact multilinear_mem_span_generator_tuples f gen _ (fun i => (v i).property)
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    exact ⟨fun i => ⟨gen (s i), Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self (s i))⟩, rfl⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.determinant_span_generator_tuples
statement:
theorem determinant_span_generator_tuples (coord : A →ₗ[L] (Fin p → L)) (gen : J → A) :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun v : Fin p → Submodule.span K (Set.range gen) =>
      Matrix.det (fun i j => coord (v j : A) i))) =

name: AlternatingAnalytic.finiteDimensional_determinant_span

      (fun v : Fin p → Submodule.span K (Set.range gen) =>

  exact FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite K (Set.finite_range _)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.c0_exists_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_subtype
statement:
theorem c0_exists_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_subtype
    (S : Submodule K Z) [CompleteSpace S]
    {f : C₀(I, K) → S} {x : C₀(I, K)} {r : ℝ≥0∞}
    {p : FormalMultilinearSeries K C₀(I, K) Z}
    (hp : HasFPowerSeriesOnBall (fun y => (f y : Z)) p x r) :
    ∃ q : FormalMultilinearSeries K C₀(I, K) S,
      (∀ n, ‖q n‖ ≤ ‖p n‖) ∧
      (∀ n y, (q n (fun _ => y) : Z) = p n (fun _ => y)) ∧
      p.radius ≤ q.radius ∧ HasFPowerSeriesOnBall f q x r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hS : IsClosed (S : Set Z) := by
    simpa using S.subtypeₗᵢ.isometry.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
  have hmem (n : ℕ) (y : C₀(I, K)) : p n (fun _ => y) ∈ S :=
    HasFPowerSeriesAt.diagonal_mem_closedSubspace S hS hp.hasFPowerSeriesAt
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => (f z).property) n y
  choose q hdiag hnorm using fun n =>
    CZero.homogeneous_diagonal_lifting S (p n) (hmem n)
  exact ⟨q, hnorm, hdiag, FormalMultilinearSeries.radius_le_of_le hnorm,
    hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_subtype_of_diagonal_of_norm_le S hp q hnorm hdiag⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.c0_exists_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_linearIsometry
statement:
theorem c0_exists_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_linearIsometry
    (j : W →ₗᵢ[K] Z) {f : C₀(I, K) → W} {x : C₀(I, K)} {r : ℝ≥0∞}
    {p : FormalMultilinearSeries K C₀(I, K) Z}
    (hp : HasFPowerSeriesOnBall (j ∘ f) p x r) :
    ∃ q : FormalMultilinearSeries K C₀(I, K) W,
      (∀ n, ‖q n‖ ≤ ‖p n‖) ∧
      (∀ n y, j (q n (fun _ => y)) = p n (fun _ => y)) ∧
      p.radius ≤ q.radius ∧ HasFPowerSeriesOnBall f q x r
proof:
:= by
  let : CompleteSpace j.range := j.equivRange.symm.toIsometryEquiv.completeSpace
  let g : C₀(I, K) → j.range := fun y => j.equivRange (f y)
  obtain ⟨q, hnorm, hdiag, _, hq⟩ :=
    c0_exists_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_subtype j.range (f := g) hp
  let e := j.equivRange.symm.toLinearIsometry
  let q' := e.toContinuousLinearMap.compFormalMultilinearSeries q
  have hnorm' (n : ℕ) : ‖q' n‖ ≤ ‖p n‖ :=
    (e.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap (q n)).le.trans (hnorm n)
  refine ⟨q', hnorm', ?_, FormalMultilinearSeries.radius_le_of_le hnorm', ?_⟩
  · intro n y
    change j (j.equivRange.symm (q n (fun _ => y))) = p n (fun _ => y)
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val (j.equivRange.apply_symm_apply (q n (fun _ => y)))).trans
      (hdiag n y)
  · have h := e.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall hq
    change HasFPowerSeriesOnBall
      (fun y => j.equivRange.symm (j.equivRange (f y))) q' x r at h
    simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.c0_analyticAt_linearIsometry
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, r, hp⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨q, _, _, _, hq⟩ := c0_exists_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_linearIsometry j hp
  exact ⟨q, r, hq⟩

:=

name: AlternatingAnalytic.c0_analyticAt_linearIsometry_of_equiv
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : AnalyticAt K (j ∘ f) (e.symm (e x)) := by
    simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using hf
  have hcomp : AnalyticAt K (j ∘ (f ∘ e.symm)) (e x) :=
    hf'.comp (e.symm.analyticAt (e x))
  have h := (c0_analyticAt_linearIsometry j hcomp).comp (e.analyticAt x)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, e.symm_apply_apply] using h

    (j : W →ₗᵢ[K] Z) {U : Set C₀(I, K)} (hU : IsOpen U) (f : U → W)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exists_geometricWeight_max
statement:
theorem exists_geometricWeight_max {r : ℝ} (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * r ^ n ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, ((m : ℝ) + 1) * r ^ m ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * r ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 1) * r ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa [add_mul] using
      (tendsto_self_mul_const_pow_of_lt_one hr0 hr1).add
        (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hr0 hr1)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (ht.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds zero_lt_one))
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hmax⟩ := (Finset.range (N + 1)).exists_max_image
    (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 1) * r ^ n) ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have hpos : 1 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * r ^ n := by
    simpa using hmax 0 (by simp)
  refine ⟨n, hpos, fun m => ?_⟩
  by_cases hm : m < N + 1
  · exact hmax m (Finset.mem_range.mpr hm)
  · exact (hN m (by omega)).le.trans hpos

name: AlternatingAnalytic.geometricWeight_le_one
statement:
theorem geometricWeight_le_one {r : ℝ} (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hrhalf : r ≤ 1 / 2)
    (n : ℕ) : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * r ^ n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      have hn : (n : ℝ) + 2 ≤ 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
      have hpow : 0 ≤ r ^ n := pow_nonneg hr0 _
      calc
        (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * r ^ (n + 1)
            = (((n : ℝ) + 2) * r) * r ^ n := by
                push_cast
                rw [pow_succ]
                ring
        _ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * r ^ n := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hpow
              nlinarith
        _ ≤ 1 := ih

name: AlternatingAnalytic.tendsto_fin_product_cofinite_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fin_product_cofinite_zero {I : Type*} (n : ℕ)
    (a : Fin n → I → ℝ) (ha : ∀ j, Tendsto (a j) cofinite (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun t : Fin n → I => ∏ j, a j (t j)) cofinite (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Filter.cofinite_eq_bot, tendsto_bot]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := tendsto_mul_cofinite_nhds_zero (ha 0)
      (ih (fun j => a j.succ) (fun j => ha j.succ))
    have hc := h.comp (Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => I)).symm.injective.tendsto_cofinite
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Fin.consEquiv_symm_apply, Fin.tail_def,
      Fin.prod_univ_succ] using hc

name: AlternatingAnalytic.tendsto_schauder_weighted_coord
statement:
theorem tendsto_schauder_weighted_coord (b : UnconditionalSchauderBasis I K E) (x : E) :
    Tendsto (fun i => ‖b.coord i x‖ * ‖b i‖) cofinite (𝓝 0)
proof:
