name: AlternatingAnalytic.RigidDenseSource.endScalarEquivOfRigidity_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem endScalarEquivOfRigidity_symm_apply (s : K) :
    (endScalarEquivOfRigidity hr).symm s = s • ContinuousLinearMap.id K E
proof:
:= by
  change scalarActionIsometry s = _
  exact scalarActionIsometry_apply s

name: AlternatingAnalytic.RigidDenseSource.endScalarEquivOfRigidity_apply
statement:
theorem endScalarEquivOfRigidity_apply (T : E →L[K] E) (x : E) :
    T x = endScalarEquivOfRigidity hr T • x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (endScalarEquivOfRigidity hr).symm_apply_apply T
  rw [endScalarEquivOfRigidity_symm_apply] at h
  exact (congrArg (fun U : E →L[K] E => U x) h).symm

name: AlternatingAnalytic.RigidDenseSource.norm_endScalarEquivOfRigidity
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_endScalarEquivOfRigidity (T : E →L[K] E) :
    ‖endScalarEquivOfRigidity hr T‖ = ‖T‖
proof:
:=
  (endScalarEquivOfRigidity hr).norm_map T

name: AlternatingAnalytic.RigidDenseSource.endScalarEquivOfRigidity_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem endScalarEquivOfRigidity_id :
    endScalarEquivOfRigidity hr (ContinuousLinearMap.id K E) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (endScalarEquivOfRigidity hr).symm.injective
  simp

name: AlternatingAnalytic.RigidDenseSource.endScalarEquivOfRigidity_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem endScalarEquivOfRigidity_comp (T U : E →L[K] E) :
    endScalarEquivOfRigidity hr (T.comp U) =
      endScalarEquivOfRigidity hr T * endScalarEquivOfRigidity hr U
proof:
:= by
  apply (endScalarEquivOfRigidity hr).symm.injective
  simp only [LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply, endScalarEquivOfRigidity_symm_apply]
  ext x
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
  rw [endScalarEquivOfRigidity_apply hr T, endScalarEquivOfRigidity_apply hr U,
    mul_smul]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.concrete_a_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem concrete_a_eq (i : Fin p) :
    RigidDenseSource.Concrete.a p r i = z p r (Sum.inl i)
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.concrete_vector_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem concrete_vector_eq : RigidDenseSource.Concrete.vector p r = a p r
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.e_mem_E
statement: theorem e_mem_E (i : Fin p) : e p r i ∈ E p r
proof:
:= by
  rw [e_eq_epsilon_pow]
  exact RigidDenseSource.Concrete.coe_standard p r i ▸
    (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.standard p r i).property

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.a_mem_E
statement: theorem a_mem_E : a p r ∈ E p r
proof:
:= by
  apply (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.mem_source p r _).mpr
  exact ⟨0, 1, by simp⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.E_eq_span_sourceGen
statement: theorem E_eq_span_sourceGen : E p r = Submodule.span (K p r) (Set.range (sourceGen p r))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨b, s, rfl⟩ := (RigidDenseSource.Concrete.mem_source p r x).mp hx
    apply Submodule.add_mem
    · apply Submodule.sum_mem
      intro i _
      apply Submodule.smul_mem
      rw [← e_eq_epsilon_pow]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩
    · apply Submodule.smul_mem
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨Sum.inr (), rfl⟩
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    cases i with
    | inl i => exact e_mem_E p r i
    | inr i => exact a_mem_E p r

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.a_mem_D
statement: theorem a_mem_D : a p r ∈ D p r
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin p := ⟨0, (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos⟩
  have h := gen_mem_D p r (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))
  simpa [gen, e_eq_epsilon_pow, i] using h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.E_le_D
statement: theorem E_le_D : E p r ≤ D p r
proof:
:= by
  rw [E_eq_span_sourceGen]
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  cases i with
  | inl i => exact e_mem_D p r i
  | inr i => exact a_mem_D p r

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.deltaAlternating_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem deltaAlternating_apply (v : Fin p → A p r) :
    deltaAlternating p r v = delta p r v
proof:
:= by
  change Matrix.det (fun i j => TruncatedPolynomial.coeff (L p r) p (v i) j) = _
  exact Matrix.det_transpose _ |>.symm

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.delta_update_e_a
statement:
theorem delta_update_e_a (i : Fin p) :
    delta p r (Function.update (e p r) i (a p r)) = z p r (Sum.inl i)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Matrix.of (fun k j => TruncatedPolynomial.coeff (L p r) p
      (Function.update (e p r) i (a p r) j) k) =
      Matrix.updateCol (1 : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) (L p r)) i
        (fun k => z p r (Sum.inl k)) := by
    ext k j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j; simp
    · simp [hj, e,
        TruncatedPolynomial.coeff_basis, Matrix.one_apply, eq_comm]
  rw [delta, h]
  have hcol : (fun k => z p r (Sum.inl k)) =
      (fun k => ∑ j : Fin p, z p r (Sum.inl j) • (1 : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) (L p r)) k j) := by
    ext k
    simp [Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [hcol, Matrix.det_updateCol_sum, Matrix.det_one, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.primary_mem_G
statement: theorem primary_mem_G (i : Fin p) : z p r (Sum.inl i) ∈ G p r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← delta_update_e_a p r i]
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨fun j => ⟨Function.update (e p r) i (a p r) j, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst j; simpa using a_mem_D p r
  · simpa [Function.update_of_ne hj] using e_mem_D p r j

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.delta_eq_basis_det
statement:
theorem delta_eq_basis_det (v : Fin p → A p r) :
    delta p r v = (TruncatedPolynomial.basis (L p r) p).det v
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.delta_standard_tuple
statement:
theorem delta_standard_tuple (t : Fin p → Fin p) :
    delta p r (fun j => e p r (t j)) = algebraMap (K p r) (L p r)
      (Matrix.det (fun i j => if t j = i then (1 : K p r) else 0))
proof:
:= by
  rw [delta, RingHom.map_det]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp [e, TruncatedPolynomial.coeff_basis, apply_ite]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.delta_standard_tuple_mem
statement:
private theorem delta_standard_tuple_mem (t : Fin p → Fin p) :
    delta p r (fun j => e p r (t j)) ∈ primarySpan p r
proof:
:= by
  rw [delta_standard_tuple]
  have h : (1 : L p r) ∈ primarySpan p r := Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl rfl)
  simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using (primarySpan p r).smul_mem
    (Matrix.det (fun i j => if t j = i then (1 : K p r) else 0)) h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.delta_sourceGen_tuple_mem
statement:
private theorem delta_sourceGen_tuple_mem (s : Fin p → Fin p ⊕ Unit) :
    delta p r (fun i => sourceGen p r (s i)) ∈ primarySpan p r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hex : ∃ i, s i = Sum.inr ()
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
    by_cases hdup : ∃ j, j ≠ i ∧ s j = Sum.inr ()
    · obtain ⟨j, hji, hj⟩ := hdup
      have hz := (deltaAlternating p r).map_eq_zero_of_eq
        (fun k => sourceGen p r (s k)) (i := j) (j := i) (by rw [hi, hj]) hji
      rw [deltaAlternating_apply] at hz
      rw [hz]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · have ho : ∀ j, j ≠ i → ∃ k, s j = Sum.inl k := by
        intro j hji
        cases hs : s j with
        | inl k => exact ⟨k, rfl⟩
        | inr u => exact False.elim (hdup ⟨j, hji, by cases u; exact hs⟩)
      let t : Fin p → Fin p := fun j => if hji : j = i then i else Classical.choose (ho j hji)
      have heq : (fun j => sourceGen p r (s j)) =
          Function.update (fun j => e p r (t j)) i (a p r) := by
        funext j
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · subst j; simp [hi, sourceGen]
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne hji]
          dsimp [t]
          rw [dite_eq_right hji]
          exact congrArg (sourceGen p r) (Classical.choose_spec (ho j hji))
      rw [heq, ← deltaAlternating_apply, a_expansion,
        (deltaAlternating p r).map_update_sum]
      apply Submodule.sum_mem
      intro j _
      rw [(deltaAlternating p r).map_update_smul, deltaAlternating_apply]
      have hup : Function.update (fun j => e p r (t j)) i (e p r j) =
          (fun k => e p r (Function.update t i j k)) := by
        funext k
        by_cases hki : k = i <;> simp [hki]
      rw [hup, delta_standard_tuple, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using (primarySpan p r).smul_mem
        (Matrix.det (fun k l => if Function.update t i j l = k then (1 : K p r) else 0))
        (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨j, rfl⟩) : z p r (Sum.inl j) ∈ primarySpan p r)
  · have ho : ∀ j, ∃ k, s j = Sum.inl k := by
      intro j
      cases hs : s j with
      | inl k => exact ⟨k, rfl⟩
      | inr u => exact False.elim (hex ⟨j, by cases u; exact hs⟩)
    choose t ht using ho
    have heq : (fun j => sourceGen p r (s j)) = (fun j => e p r (t j)) := by
      funext j
      rw [ht j]
      rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact delta_standard_tuple_mem p r t

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.delta_span_E
statement:
theorem delta_span_E :
    Submodule.span (K p r) (Set.range (fun v : Fin p → E p r =>
      delta p r (fun i => (v i : A p r)))) = primarySpan p r
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [E_eq_span_sourceGen]
    apply (determinant_span_generator_tuples (K := K p r)
      (TruncatedPolynomial.coeff (L p r) p).toLinearMap (sourceGen p r)).le.trans
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact delta_sourceGen_tuple_mem p r s
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro x (hx | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · have hx' : x = 1 := hx
      rw [hx', ← delta_e p r]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨fun i => ⟨e p r i, e_mem_E p r i⟩, rfl⟩
    · dsimp only
      rw [← delta_update_e_a p r i]
      apply Submodule.subset_span
      refine ⟨fun j => ⟨Function.update (e p r) i (a p r) j, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j; simpa using a_mem_E p r
      · simpa [Function.update_of_ne hj] using e_mem_E p r j

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.delta_mem_primarySpan
statement:
theorem delta_mem_primarySpan (v : Fin p → E p r) :
    delta p r (fun i => (v i : A p r)) ∈ primarySpan p r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← delta_span_E]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨v, rfl⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.delta_mem_G_E
statement:
theorem delta_mem_G_E (v : Fin p → E p r) :
    delta p r (fun i => (v i : A p r)) ∈ G p r
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨fun i => ⟨v i, E_le_D p r (v i).property⟩, rfl⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.radius_pos_of_exponential_bound
statement:
theorem radius_pos_of_exponential_bound
    {p : FormalMultilinearSeries K E F} {q : FormalMultilinearSeries K E G}
    (hp : 0 < p.radius) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hq : ∀ n, ‖q n‖ ≤ a ^ n * ‖p n‖) : 0 < q.radius
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, r, hC, hr, hpr⟩ := p.le_mul_pow_of_radius_pos hp
  let b : ℝ := (a + 1) * r
  have hb : 0 < b := mul_pos (by positivity) hr
  let s : ℝ≥0 := ⟨b⁻¹, (inv_pos.mpr hb).le⟩
  have hs : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < s := by
    exact_mod_cast (inv_pos.mpr hb)
  refine hs.trans_le (q.le_radius_of_bound C fun n => ?_)
  calc
    ‖q n‖ * (s : ℝ) ^ n ≤ (a ^ n * (C * r ^ n)) * (b⁻¹) ^ n := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        ((hq n).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpr n) (pow_nonneg ha n)))
        (pow_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr hb).le n)
    _ ≤ ((a + 1) ^ n * (C * r ^ n)) * (b⁻¹) ^ n := by
      gcongr
      linarith
    _ = C := by
      rw [show (a + 1) ^ n * (C * r ^ n) = C * b ^ n by
        dsimp only [b]
        rw [mul_pow]
        ring]
      rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hb.ne', one_pow, mul_one]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticAt_of_subspace_series
statement:
theorem analyticAt_of_subspace_series
    (W : Submodule K F) {f : E → W} {x : E}
    {p : FormalMultilinearSeries K E F}
    (hp : HasFPowerSeriesAt (fun y => (f y : F)) p x)
    (q : FormalMultilinearSeries K E W) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hq : ∀ n, ‖q n‖ ≤ a ^ n * ‖p n‖)
    (hdiag : ∀ n y, (q n (fun _ => y) : F) = p n (fun _ => y)) :
    AnalyticAt K f x
proof:
:= by
  have hqpos := radius_pos_of_exponential_bound hp.radius_pos ha hq
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨q, min r q.radius, min_le_right _ _, lt_min hr.r_pos hqpos, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hsum := hr.hasSum (Metric.eball_subset_eball (min_le_left _ _) hy)
  apply (W.subtypeₗᵢ.isEmbedding.isInducing.hasSum_iff
    (g := W.subtypeL) (fun n => q n (fun _ => y)) (f (x + y))).mp
  change HasSum (fun n => (q n (fun _ => y) : F)) (f (x + y) : F)
  simpa only [hdiag] using hsum

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticAt_subtype_of_finite_coordinates
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf
  have hmem (n : ℕ) (y : Fin d → K) : p n (fun _ => y) ∈ W :=
    HasFPowerSeriesAt.diagonal_mem_closedSubspace W hW hp
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => (f z).property) n y
  choose q hdiag hnorm using fun n =>
    FiniteCoordinateReflection.exists_lift W (p n) (hmem n)
  exact analyticAt_of_subspace_series W hp q (Nat.cast_nonneg d) hnorm hdiag

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticAt_of_closed_linearIsometry
proof:
:= by
  let g : (Fin d → K) → j.range := fun y => j.equivRange (f y)
  have hg : AnalyticAt K g x :=
    analyticAt_subtype_of_finite_coordinates j.range hj hf
  have h := (j.equivRange.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.analyticAt (g x)).comp hg
  change AnalyticAt K (fun y => j.equivRange.symm (j.equivRange (f y))) x at h
  simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticOn_of_closed_linearIsometry
proof:
:= by
  apply hU.analyticOn_iff_analyticOnNhd.mpr
  intro x hx
  exact analyticAt_of_closed_linearIsometry j hj
    (hU.analyticOn_iff_analyticOnNhd.mp hf x hx)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticAt_of_closed_linearIsometry_of_equiv
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : AnalyticAt K (j ∘ f) (e.symm (e x)) := by
    simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using hf
  have hcomp : AnalyticAt K (j ∘ (f ∘ e.symm)) (e x) := by
    exact hf'.comp (e.symm.analyticAt (e x))
  have h := (analyticAt_of_closed_linearIsometry j hj hcomp).comp (e.analyticAt x)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, e.symm_apply_apply] using h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticOn_of_closed_linearIsometry_of_equiv
proof:
:= by
  apply hU.analyticOn_iff_analyticOnNhd.mpr
  intro x hx
  exact analyticAt_of_closed_linearIsometry_of_equiv e j hj
    (hU.analyticOn_iff_analyticOnNhd.mp hf x hx)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticOn_extend_of_closed_linearIsometry
statement:
theorem analyticOn_extend_of_closed_linearIsometry {d : ℕ}
    (j : F →ₗᵢ[K] G) (hj : IsClosed (Set.range j))
    {U : Set (Fin d → K)} (hU : IsOpen U) (f : U → F)
    (hf : AnalyticOn K (j ∘ Function.extend Subtype.val f 0) U) :
    AnalyticOn K (Function.extend Subtype.val f 0) U
proof:
:=
  analyticOn_of_closed_linearIsometry j hj hU hf

name: AlternatingAnalytic.laurentLift_grouped
statement:
theorem laurentLift_grouped (P : LaurentLiftCandidate κ r k)
    (hP : ∀ f : E →L[K] E, P (fun _ => f) = LiftCriterion.Q K (Fin k) E E B f)
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (b : J → E) (ν : J → ℕ) (x : Fin k → E) :
    (∑ f ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → J => Polarization.selectionType f = ν),
      P (fun i => boundedSequenceMultiplier K ℕ (b (f i)))
        (completedExteriorWedge K ℕ k) x) =
    ∑ f ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → J => Polarization.selectionType f = ν),
      completedExteriorWedge K ℕ k
        (fun i => boundedSequenceMultiplier K ℕ (b (f i)) (x i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hd (a : E) : laurentLiftFixedVectors κ r k P x (fun _ => a) =
      completedExteriorWedge K ℕ k (fun i => boundedSequenceMultiplier K ℕ a (x i)) := by
    change P (fun _ => boundedSequenceMultiplier K ℕ a) (completedExteriorWedge K ℕ k) x = _
    rw [hP]
    rfl
  exact MultilinearMap.sumOfType_eq_of_multiplier_diagonal
    (laurentLiftFixedVectors κ r k P x) (completedExteriorWedge K ℕ k).toMultilinearMap
    (boundedSequenceMultiplier K ℕ).toLinearMap₁₂ x hd b ν

name: AlternatingAnalytic.laurentResidueLift_pol
statement:
theorem laurentResidueLift_pol (α : Fin k) (P : LaurentLiftCandidate κ r k)
    (hP : ∀ f : E →L[K] E, P (fun _ => f) = LiftCriterion.Q K (Fin k) E E B f)
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (b : J → ℕ → κ) (ν : J → ℕ) (x : Fin k → ℕ → κ) :
    (∑ f ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → J => Polarization.selectionType f = ν),
      laurentResidueLift κ r k α P (fun i => b (f i)) x) =
    ∑ f ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → J => Polarization.selectionType f = ν),
      exteriorPower.ιMulti κ k (fun i => b (f i) * x i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := congrArg (completedLaurentCoefficient κ r ℕ k α)
    (laurentLift_grouped κ r k P hP (fun j => constantLaurentArray κ r (b j)) ν
      (fun i => constantLaurentArray κ r (x i)))
  simpa only [map_sum, boundedSequenceMultiplier_constant,
    completedLaurentCoefficient_constant_wedge, laurentResidueLift_apply] using h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exteriorDecompositionValue_smul
statement:
theorem exteriorDecompositionValue_smul (p : FreeAddMonoid (K × (Fin k → V))) (a : K) :
    exteriorDecompositionValue (p.map fun y ↦ (a * y.1, y.2)) =
      a • exteriorDecompositionValue p
proof:
:= by
  simp [exteriorDecompositionValue, FreeAddMonoid.lift_apply,
    Function.comp_def, mul_smul, List.smul_sum]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exists_exterior_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_decomposition (ω : ⋀[K]^k V) :
    ∃ p : FreeAddMonoid (K × (Fin k → V)), exteriorDecompositionValue p = ω
proof:
:= by
  have hω : ω ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (exteriorPower.ιMulti K k)) := by
    rw [exteriorPower.ιMulti_span]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  induction hω using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem _ hx =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨FreeAddMonoid.of (1, x), by simp [exteriorDecompositionValue]⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | add ω η _ _ hω hη =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hω
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hη
    exact ⟨p + q, map_add _ _ _⟩
  | smul a ω _ hω =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hω
    exact ⟨_, exteriorDecompositionValue_smul p a⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exteriorDecompositionCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem exteriorDecompositionCost_nonneg (p : FreeAddMonoid (K × (Fin k → V))) :
    0 ≤ exteriorDecompositionCost p
proof: := PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminormAux_nonneg p

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exteriorDecompositionCost_bddBelow
statement:
theorem exteriorDecompositionCost_bddBelow (ω : ⋀[K]^k V) :
    BddBelow (Set.range fun p : exteriorDecompositions ω ↦ exteriorDecompositionCost p.val)
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩; exact exteriorDecompositionCost_nonneg p.val⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorSeminormFun_zero
statement:
theorem projectiveExteriorSeminormFun_zero :
    projectiveExteriorSeminormFun (0 : ⋀[K]^k V) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (ciInf_le (exteriorDecompositionCost_bddBelow _) ⟨0, map_zero _⟩).trans_eq rfl
  · exact le_ciInf fun p ↦ exteriorDecompositionCost_nonneg p.val

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorSeminormFun_add_le
statement:
theorem projectiveExteriorSeminormFun_add_le (ω η : ⋀[K]^k V) :
    projectiveExteriorSeminormFun (ω + η) ≤
      projectiveExteriorSeminormFun ω + projectiveExteriorSeminormFun η
proof:
:= by
  apply le_ciInf_add_ciInf
  intro p q
  refine ciInf_le_of_le (exteriorDecompositionCost_bddBelow _) ⟨p.val + q.val, ?_⟩ ?_
  · change exteriorDecompositionValue (p.val + q.val) = ω + η
    rw [map_add, p.property, q.property]
  · exact PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminormAux_add_le _ _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorSeminormFun_smul_le
statement:
theorem projectiveExteriorSeminormFun_smul_le (a : K) (ω : ⋀[K]^k V) :
    projectiveExteriorSeminormFun (a • ω) ≤ ‖a‖ * projectiveExteriorSeminormFun ω
proof:
:= by
  simp only [projectiveExteriorSeminormFun, Real.mul_iInf_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
  apply le_ciInf
  intro p
  refine ciInf_le_of_le (exteriorDecompositionCost_bddBelow _)
    ⟨p.val.map (fun y ↦ (a * y.1, y.2)), ?_⟩ ?_
  · change exteriorDecompositionValue _ = a • ω
    rw [exteriorDecompositionValue_smul, p.property]
  · exact (PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminormAux_smul p.val a).le

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorSeminorm_def
statement:
theorem projectiveExteriorSeminorm_def (ω : ⋀[K]^k V) :
    projectiveExteriorSeminorm ω =
      ⨅ p : exteriorDecompositions ω, exteriorDecompositionCost p.val
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorSeminorm_ιMulti_le
statement:
theorem projectiveExteriorSeminorm_ιMulti_le (x : Fin k → V) :
    projectiveExteriorSeminorm (exteriorPower.ιMulti K k x) ≤ ∏ i, ‖x i‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := ciInf_le (exteriorDecompositionCost_bddBelow (exteriorPower.ιMulti K k x))
    ⟨FreeAddMonoid.of (1, x), by simp [exteriorDecompositions, exteriorDecompositionValue]⟩
  simpa [projectiveExteriorSeminorm_def, exteriorDecompositionCost,
    PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminormAux] using h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exteriorWedgeCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem exteriorWedgeCost_nonneg (q : FreeAddMonoid (Fin k → V)) :
    0 ≤ exteriorWedgeCost q
proof:
:= by
  apply List.sum_nonneg
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hr
  exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ norm_nonneg _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.prod_norm_update_smul
statement:
theorem prod_norm_update_smul (α : Fin k) (a : K) (x : Fin k → V) :
    (∏ i, ‖Function.update x α (a • x α) i‖) = ‖a‖ * ∏ i, ‖x i‖
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Function.apply_update (fun _ ↦ norm)]
  rw [Finset.prod_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ α), norm_smul]
  simp only [Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm ‖x α‖, Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ (Finset.mem_univ α)]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exteriorWedgeSum_absorb
statement:
theorem exteriorWedgeSum_absorb (α : Fin k) (p : FreeAddMonoid (K × (Fin k → V))) :
    exteriorWedgeSum (p.map fun y ↦ Function.update y.2 α (y.1 • y.2 α)) =
      exteriorDecompositionValue p
proof:
:= by
  simp [exteriorWedgeSum, exteriorDecompositionValue, FreeAddMonoid.lift_apply,
    Function.comp_def]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exteriorWedgeCost_absorb
statement:
theorem exteriorWedgeCost_absorb (α : Fin k) (p : FreeAddMonoid (K × (Fin k → V))) :
    exteriorWedgeCost (p.map fun y ↦ Function.update y.2 α (y.1 • y.2 α)) =
      exteriorDecompositionCost p
proof:
:= by
  simp [exteriorWedgeCost, exteriorDecompositionCost, PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminormAux,
    Function.comp_def, prod_norm_update_smul]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorSeminorm_eq_iInf_wedgeCost
statement:
theorem projectiveExteriorSeminorm_eq_iInf_wedgeCost (α : Fin k) (ω : ⋀[K]^k V) :
    projectiveExteriorSeminorm ω =
      ⨅ q : {q : FreeAddMonoid (Fin k → V) // exteriorWedgeSum q = ω},
        exteriorWedgeCost q.val
proof:
:= by
  have hex : Nonempty {q : FreeAddMonoid (Fin k → V) // exteriorWedgeSum q = ω} := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_exterior_decomposition ω
    exact ⟨⟨_, (exteriorWedgeSum_absorb α p).trans hp⟩⟩
  have hb : BddBelow (Set.range fun q :
      {q : FreeAddMonoid (Fin k → V) // exteriorWedgeSum q = ω} ↦ exteriorWedgeCost q.val) :=
    ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩; exact exteriorWedgeCost_nonneg q.val⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_ciInf
    intro q
    refine ciInf_le_of_le (exteriorDecompositionCost_bddBelow _)
      ⟨q.val.map (fun x ↦ (1, x)), ?_⟩ ?_
    · change exteriorDecompositionValue _ = ω
      simpa [exteriorDecompositionValue, exteriorWedgeSum, FreeAddMonoid.lift_apply,
        Function.comp_def] using q.property
    · simp [exteriorDecompositionCost, exteriorWedgeCost,
        PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminormAux, Function.comp_def]
  · apply le_ciInf
    intro p
    refine ciInf_le_of_le hb ⟨_, (exteriorWedgeSum_absorb α p.val).trans p.property⟩ ?_
    exact (exteriorWedgeCost_absorb α p.val).le

name: AlternatingAnalytic.coordinateExteriorArray_ιMulti
statement:
theorem coordinateExteriorArray_ιMulti (e : V →ₗ[K] (S → K))
    (x : Fin k → V) (c : Fin k → S) :
    coordinateExteriorArray e (exteriorPower.ιMulti K k x) c =
      Matrix.det (fun i j ↦ e (x j) (c i))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateExteriorArray, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti, determinantArray_ιMulti, Function.comp_apply]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.coordinateExteriorArray_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateExteriorArray_injective (e : V →ₗ[K] (S → K))
    (he : Function.Injective e) : Function.Injective (coordinateExteriorArray (k := k) e)
proof:
:=
  determinantArray_injective.comp (exteriorPower.map_injective_field he)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_coordinateExteriorArray_ιMulti_le
statement:
theorem norm_coordinateExteriorArray_ιMulti_le (e : V →ₗ[K] (S → K))
    (he : ∀ v s, ‖e v s‖ ≤ ‖v‖) (x : Fin k → V) (c : Fin k → S) :
    ‖coordinateExteriorArray e (exteriorPower.ιMulti K k x) c‖ ≤ ∏ i, ‖x i‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coordinateExteriorArray_ιMulti]
  change ‖(Matrix.of (fun i j ↦ e (x j) (c i))).det‖ ≤ _
  rw [Matrix.det_apply]
  apply IsUltrametricDist.norm_sum_le_of_forall_le_of_nonneg
    (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)
  intro σ hσ
  rw [norm_units_zsmul, norm_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun _ _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) (fun i _ ↦ he (x i) (c (σ i)))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_coordinateExteriorArray_decomposition_le
statement:
theorem norm_coordinateExteriorArray_decomposition_le (e : V →ₗ[K] (S → K))
    (he : ∀ v s, ‖e v s‖ ≤ ‖v‖) (p : FreeAddMonoid (K × (Fin k → V)))
    (c : Fin k → S) :
    ‖coordinateExteriorArray e (exteriorDecompositionValue p) c‖ ≤
      exteriorDecompositionCost p
proof:
:= by
  induction p using FreeAddMonoid.inductionOn' with
  | zero => simp [exteriorDecompositionCost, PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminormAux]
  | of_add b p ih =>
    simp only [map_add, exteriorDecompositionValue, FreeAddMonoid.lift_eval_of,
      map_smul, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖b.1 • coordinateExteriorArray e (exteriorPower.ιMulti K k b.2) c‖ +
          ‖coordinateExteriorArray e (exteriorDecompositionValue p) c‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖b.1‖ * (∏ i, ‖b.2 i‖) + exteriorDecompositionCost p := by
        rw [norm_smul]
        exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (norm_coordinateExteriorArray_ιMulti_le e he b.2 c) (norm_nonneg _)) ih
      _ = _ := by simp [exteriorDecompositionCost, PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminormAux]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_coordinateExteriorArray_le
statement:
theorem norm_coordinateExteriorArray_le (e : V →ₗ[K] (S → K))
    (he : ∀ v s, ‖e v s‖ ≤ ‖v‖) (ω : ⋀[K]^k V) (c : Fin k → S) :
    ‖coordinateExteriorArray e ω c‖ ≤ projectiveExteriorSeminorm ω
proof:
:= by
  apply le_ciInf
  intro p
  have hp : exteriorDecompositionValue p.val = ω := p.property
  simpa only [hp] using norm_coordinateExteriorArray_decomposition_le e he p.val c

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorSeminorm_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem projectiveExteriorSeminorm_eq_zero_iff (e : V →ₗ[K] (S → K))
    (hinj : Function.Injective e) (he : ∀ v s, ‖e v s‖ ≤ ‖v‖) (ω : ⋀[K]^k V) :
    projectiveExteriorSeminorm ω = 0 ↔ ω = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hω
    apply coordinateExteriorArray_injective e hinj
    ext c
    rw [map_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm ((norm_coordinateExteriorArray_le e he ω c).trans_eq hω)
      (norm_nonneg _))
  · rintro rfl
    exact map_zero _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.boundedFunctionCoordinates_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem boundedFunctionCoordinates_apply [TopologicalSpace S] (f : S →ᵇ K) (s : S) :
    boundedFunctionCoordinates (K := K) f s = f s
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.boundedFunctionCoordinates_injective
statement:
theorem boundedFunctionCoordinates_injective [TopologicalSpace S] :
    Function.Injective (boundedFunctionCoordinates (K := K) (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  exact DFunLike.coe_injective h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.boundedFunction_projectiveExteriorSeminorm_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem boundedFunction_projectiveExteriorSeminorm_eq_zero_iff [TopologicalSpace S]
    (ω : ⋀[K]^k (S →ᵇ K)) : projectiveExteriorSeminorm ω = 0 ↔ ω = 0
proof:
:=
  projectiveExteriorSeminorm_eq_zero_iff boundedFunctionCoordinates
    boundedFunctionCoordinates_injective (fun f s ↦ f.norm_coe_le_norm s) ω

name: AlternatingAnalytic.boundedExteriorArray_norm_le
statement:
theorem boundedExteriorArray_norm_le (e : V →ₗ[K] (S → K))
    (he : ∀ v s, ‖e v s‖ ≤ ‖v‖) (ω : ⋀[K]^k V) :
    ‖boundedExteriorArray e he ω‖ ≤ projectiveExteriorSeminorm ω
proof:
:=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (apply_nonneg projectiveExteriorSeminorm ω)).mpr
    (norm_coordinateExteriorArray_le e he ω)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.boundedExteriorArray_injective
statement:
theorem boundedExteriorArray_injective (e : V →ₗ[K] (S → K))
    (hinj : Function.Injective e) (he : ∀ v s, ‖e v s‖ ≤ ‖v‖) :
    Function.Injective (boundedExteriorArray (k := k) e he)
proof:
:= by
  intro ω η h
  apply coordinateExteriorArray_injective e hinj
  exact congrArg (fun f : (Fin k → S) →ᵇ K ↦ (f : (Fin k → S) → K)) h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.boundedFunction_projectiveExterior_properties
statement:
theorem boundedFunction_projectiveExterior_properties (α : Fin k) :
    (∀ ω : ⋀[K]^k (S →ᵇ K), projectiveExteriorSeminorm ω =
      ⨅ q : {q : FreeAddMonoid (Fin k → (S →ᵇ K)) // exteriorWedgeSum q = ω},
        exteriorWedgeCost q.val) ∧
    (∀ x : Fin k → (S →ᵇ K),
      projectiveExteriorSeminorm (exteriorPower.ιMulti K k x) ≤ ∏ i, ‖x i‖) ∧
    (∀ ω : ⋀[K]^k (S →ᵇ K),
      ‖boundedExteriorArray boundedFunctionCoordinates (fun f s ↦ f.norm_coe_le_norm s) ω‖ ≤
        projectiveExteriorSeminorm ω) ∧
    Function.Injective (boundedExteriorArray (k := k) (boundedFunctionCoordinates (K := K) (S := S))
      (fun f s ↦ f.norm_coe_le_norm s)) ∧
    (∀ ω : ⋀[K]^k (S →ᵇ K), projectiveExteriorSeminorm ω = 0 ↔ ω = 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨projectiveExteriorSeminorm_eq_iInf_wedgeCost α,
    projectiveExteriorSeminorm_ιMulti_le, boundedExteriorArray_norm_le _ _,
    boundedExteriorArray_injective _ boundedFunctionCoordinates_injective _,
    boundedFunction_projectiveExteriorSeminorm_eq_zero_iff⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.ProjectiveExterior.norm_eq
statement:
theorem norm_eq (ω : ProjectiveExterior K S k) :
    ‖ω‖ = projectiveExteriorSeminorm (show ⋀[K]^k (S →ᵇ K) from ω)
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorWedge_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveExteriorWedge_apply (x : Fin k → (S →ᵇ K)) :
    (show ⋀[K]^k (S →ᵇ K) from projectiveExteriorWedge K S k x) =
      exteriorPower.ιMulti K k x
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorWedge_norm_le
statement: theorem projectiveExteriorWedge_norm_le : ‖projectiveExteriorWedge K S k‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  AlternatingMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ zero_le_one _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorArray_norm_le
statement: theorem projectiveExteriorArray_norm_le : ‖projectiveExteriorArray K S k‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ zero_le_one _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorArray_injective
statement: theorem projectiveExteriorArray_injective : Function.Injective (projectiveExteriorArray K S k)
proof:
:=
  boundedExteriorArray_injective (boundedFunctionCoordinates (K := K) (S := S))
    boundedFunctionCoordinates_injective
    (fun f s ↦ f.norm_coe_le_norm s)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorArray_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveExteriorArray_apply (ω : ProjectiveExterior K S k) (c : Fin k → S) :
    projectiveExteriorArray K S k ω c =
      coordinateExteriorArray (boundedFunctionCoordinates (K := K) (S := S)) ω c
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorArray_wedge
statement:
theorem projectiveExteriorArray_wedge (x : Fin k → (S →ᵇ K)) (c : Fin k → S) :
    projectiveExteriorArray K S k (projectiveExteriorWedge K S k x) c =
      Matrix.det (fun i j ↦ x j (c i))
proof:
:= by
  change coordinateExteriorArray (boundedFunctionCoordinates (K := K) (S := S))
    (exteriorPower.ιMulti K k x) c = _
  simpa only [boundedFunctionCoordinates_apply] using
    coordinateExteriorArray_ιMulti (boundedFunctionCoordinates (K := K) (S := S)) x c

name: AlternatingAnalytic.completedExteriorWedge_norm_le
statement: theorem completedExteriorWedge_norm_le : ‖completedExteriorWedge K S k‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousAlternatingMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro x
  change ‖((projectiveExteriorWedge K S k x : ProjectiveExterior K S k) :
    ProjectiveExteriorCompletion K S k)‖ ≤ _
  rw [UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe, one_mul]
  rw [ProjectiveExterior.norm_eq]
  exact projectiveExteriorSeminorm_ιMulti_le x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_completedExteriorArray_le
statement:
theorem norm_completedExteriorArray_le (ω : ProjectiveExteriorCompletion K S k) :
    ‖completedExteriorArray K S k ω‖ ≤ ‖ω‖
proof:
:= by
  induction ω using UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on with
  | hp => exact isClosed_le (ContinuousLinearMap.continuous _).norm continuous_norm
  | ih ω =>
    simpa only [completedExteriorArray, ContinuousLinearMap.fromCompletion_apply_coe,
      UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe, one_mul] using
      (projectiveExteriorArray K S k).le_of_opNorm_le
        (projectiveExteriorArray_norm_le K S k) ω

name: AlternatingAnalytic.completedExteriorArray_norm_le
statement: theorem completedExteriorArray_norm_le : ‖completedExteriorArray K S k‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro ω
  simpa only [one_mul] using norm_completedExteriorArray_le K S k ω

name: AlternatingAnalytic.completedExteriorArray_wedge
statement:
theorem completedExteriorArray_wedge (x : Fin k → (S →ᵇ K)) (c : Fin k → S) :
    completedExteriorArray K S k (completedExteriorWedge K S k x) c =
      Matrix.det (fun i j ↦ x j (c i))
proof:
:= by
  change (projectiveExteriorArray K S k).fromCompletion
    ((projectiveExteriorWedge K S k x : ProjectiveExterior K S k) :
      ProjectiveExteriorCompletion K S k) c = _
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.fromCompletion_apply_coe]
  exact projectiveExteriorArray_wedge K S k x c

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExteriorCompletion_properties
statement:
theorem projectiveExteriorCompletion_properties :
    Function.Injective (projectiveExteriorArray K S k) ∧
    ‖projectiveExteriorArray K S k‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    ‖completedExteriorWedge K S k‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    ‖completedExteriorArray K S k‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (∀ (x : Fin k → (S →ᵇ K)) (c : Fin k → S),
      completedExteriorArray K S k (completedExteriorWedge K S k x) c =
        Matrix.det (fun i j ↦ x j (c i)))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨projectiveExteriorArray_injective K S k, projectiveExteriorArray_norm_le K S k,
    completedExteriorWedge_norm_le K S k, completedExteriorArray_norm_le K S k,
    completedExteriorArray_wedge K S k⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.projectiveExterior_properties
statement:
theorem projectiveExterior_properties (α : Fin k) :
    (∀ ω : ProjectiveExterior K S k, ‖ω‖ =
      ⨅ q : {q : FreeAddMonoid (Fin k → (S →ᵇ K)) //
        exteriorWedgeSum q = (show ⋀[K]^k (S →ᵇ K) from ω)}, exteriorWedgeCost q.val) ∧
    (∀ x : Fin k → (S →ᵇ K), ‖projectiveExteriorWedge K S k x‖ ≤ ∏ i, ‖x i‖) ∧
    (∀ ω : ProjectiveExterior K S k, ‖ω‖ = 0 ↔ ω = 0) ∧
    Function.Injective (projectiveExteriorArray K S k) ∧
    ‖projectiveExteriorArray K S k‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    CompleteSpace (ProjectiveExteriorCompletion K S k) ∧
    ‖completedExteriorWedge K S k‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    ‖completedExteriorArray K S k‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (∀ (x : Fin k → (S →ᵇ K)) (c : Fin k → S),
      completedExteriorArray K S k (completedExteriorWedge K S k x) c =
        Matrix.det (fun i j ↦ x j (c i)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun _ ↦ norm_eq_zero, projectiveExteriorArray_injective K S k,
    projectiveExteriorArray_norm_le K S k, inferInstance,
    completedExteriorWedge_norm_le K S k, completedExteriorArray_norm_le K S k,
    completedExteriorArray_wedge K S k⟩
  · intro ω
    rw [ProjectiveExterior.norm_eq]
    exact projectiveExteriorSeminorm_eq_iInf_wedgeCost α ω
  · intro x
    rw [ProjectiveExterior.norm_eq]
    exact projectiveExteriorSeminorm_ιMulti_le x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.e_mul_e_mem_D
statement: private theorem e_mul_e_mem_D (i j : Fin p) : e p r i * e p r j ∈ D p r
proof:
:= by
  rw [e_eq_epsilon_pow, e_eq_epsilon_pow, ← pow_add]
  by_cases h : (i : ℕ) + j < p
  · exact (e_eq_epsilon_pow p r ⟨i + j, h⟩) ▸ e_mem_D p r ⟨i + j, h⟩
  · rw [TruncatedPolynomial.epsilon_pow_eq_zero _ _ (Nat.le_of_not_gt h)]
    exact (D p r).zero_mem

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.sourceGen_mul_mem_D
statement:
private theorem sourceGen_mul_mem_D (i j : Fin p ⊕ Unit) :
    sourceGen p r i * sourceGen p r j ∈ D p r
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with i | u <;> rcases j with j | v
  · exact e_mul_e_mem_D p r i j
  · exact gen_mem_D p r (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))
  · simpa [sourceGen, gen, mul_comm] using gen_mem_D p r (Sum.inr (Sum.inl j))
  · exact gen_mem_D p r (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl ())))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.mul_mem_D
statement: theorem mul_mem_D (x y : E p r) : (x : A p r) * (y : A p r) ∈ D p r
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (x : A p r) ∈ Submodule.span (K p r) (Set.range (sourceGen p r)) := by
    rw [← E_eq_span_sourceGen]; exact x.property
  have hy : (y : A p r) ∈ Submodule.span (K p r) (Set.range (sourceGen p r)) := by
    rw [← E_eq_span_sourceGen]; exact y.property
  generalize (x : A p r) = xv at hx ⊢
  generalize (y : A p r) = yv at hy ⊢
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hz
      induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem z hz =>
          obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hz
          exact sourceGen_mul_mem_D p r i j
      | zero => simp
      | add z w hz hw iz iw => simpa [mul_add] using (D p r).add_mem iz iw
      | smul s z hz iz => simpa [mul_smul_comm] using (D p r).smul_mem s iz
  | zero => simp
  | add z w hz hw iz iw => simpa [add_mul] using (D p r).add_mem iz iw
  | smul s z hz iz => simpa [smul_mul_assoc] using (D p r).smul_mem s iz

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.multiplicationAt_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem multiplicationAt_apply (x y : E p r) :
    (multiplicationAt p r x y : A p r) = (x : A p r) * (y : A p r)
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.norm_multiplicationAt_le
statement: theorem norm_multiplicationAt_le (x : E p r) : ‖multiplicationAt p r x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg x)
  intro y
  exact TruncatedPolynomial.norm_mul_le (L p r) p x y

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.multiplication_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem multiplication_apply (x y : E p r) :
    (multiplication p r x y : A p r) = (x : A p r) * (y : A p r)
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.norm_multiplication_apply_le
statement: theorem norm_multiplication_apply_le (x : E p r) : ‖multiplication p r x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:=
  norm_multiplicationAt_le p r x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.completedMultiplication_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem completedMultiplication_apply (x y : A p r) :
    completedMultiplication p r x y = x * y
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.completedMultiplication_apply_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem completedMultiplication_apply_source (x y : E p r) :
    completedMultiplication p r (x : A p r) (y : A p r) =
      (multiplication p r x y : A p r)
proof: := rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.multiplicationMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem multiplicationMatrix_apply (x : A p r) (i j : Fin p) :
    multiplicationMatrix p r x i j =
      ∑ k : Fin p, if (k : ℕ) + j = (i : ℕ)
        then TruncatedPolynomial.coeff (L p r) p x k else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold multiplicationMatrix
  simp only [completedMultiplication_apply]
  rw [TruncatedPolynomial.coeff_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  simp only [e, TruncatedPolynomial.coeff_basis]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [Ne.symm hb]
  · simp

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.multiplicationMatrix_isLowerTriangular
statement:
theorem multiplicationMatrix_isLowerTriangular (x : A p r) :
    (multiplicationMatrix p r x).IsLowerTriangular
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  rw [multiplicationMatrix_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro k _
  have h : ¬ (k : ℕ) + j = (i : ℕ) := by
    have hij' : i < j := hij
    omega
  simp [h]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.multiplicationMatrix_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem multiplicationMatrix_diag (x : A p r) (i : Fin p) :
    multiplicationMatrix p r x i i = TruncatedPolynomial.coeff (L p r) p x 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [multiplicationMatrix_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [hb]
  · simp

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.det_multiplicationMatrix
statement:
theorem det_multiplicationMatrix (x : A p r) :
    (multiplicationMatrix p r x).det =
      TruncatedPolynomial.coeff (L p r) p x 0 ^ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular _ (multiplicationMatrix_isLowerTriangular p r x)]
  simp

name: AlternatingAnalytic.DeterminantPair.delta_mul_e
statement:
theorem delta_mul_e (x : A p r) :
    delta p r (fun i => x * e p r i) = TruncatedPolynomial.coeff (L p r) p x 0 ^ p
proof:
:=
  det_multiplicationMatrix p r x

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exists_scalar_retraction_of_linearIsometry
statement:
theorem exists_scalar_retraction_of_linearIsometry (i : K →ₗᵢ[K] X) :
    ∃ π : X →L[K] K, ‖π‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ c : K, π (i c) = c
proof:
:= by
  let D : Submodule K X := LinearMap.range i.toLinearMap
  let e : K ≃ₗᵢ[K] D := i.equivRange
  let T₀ : D →ₗ[K] K := e.symm.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap
  have hT₀ : ∀ d : D, ‖T₀ d‖ ≤ ‖(d : X)‖ := fun d => (e.symm.norm_map d).le
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hbound⟩ := exists_extension_of_sphericallyComplete
    ({((0 : X →L[K] K), (1 : ℝ))} : Set ((X →L[K] K) × ℝ))
    (Set.singleton_nonempty _)
    (by
      rintro p hp q hq
      rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hp with rfl
      rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hq with rfl
      norm_num)
    D T₀ (by
      rintro p hp d
      rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hp with rfl
      simpa using hT₀ d)
  refine ⟨π, π.opNorm_le_bound (by norm_num) ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    simpa using hbound (0, 1) (Set.mem_singleton _) x
  · intro c
    calc
      π (i c) = π ((e c : D) : X) := rfl
      _ = T₀ (e c) := hπ (e c)
      _ = c := e.symm_apply_apply c

name: AlternatingAnalytic.exists_scalar_projection
statement:
theorem exists_scalar_projection (K L : Type*) [NontriviallyNormedField K]
    [NormedField L] [NormedAlgebra K L] [IsUltrametricDist K] [IsUltrametricDist L]
    [SphericallyCompleteSpace K] :
    ∃ π : L →L[K] K, ‖π‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ c : K, π (algebraMap K L c) = c

name: AlternatingAnalytic.mem_sortedFiniteSubsets
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_sortedFiniteSubsets (n : ℕ) (A : Finset I) (s : Set.powersetCard I n) :
    s ∈ sortedFiniteSubsets n A ↔ s.val ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  simp [sortedFiniteSubsets, Finset.mem_powersetCard]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.tendsto_sortedFiniteSubsets
statement:
theorem tendsto_sortedFiniteSubsets (n : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (sortedFiniteSubsets (I := I) n) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  apply Monotone.tendsto_atTop_finset
  · intro A B hAB s hs
    exact (mem_sortedFiniteSubsets n B s).mpr
      (((mem_sortedFiniteSubsets n A s).mp hs).trans hAB)
  · intro s
    exact ⟨s.val, (mem_sortedFiniteSubsets n s.val s).mpr Finset.Subset.rfl⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.schauder_coord_proj
statement:
theorem schauder_coord_proj (b : UnconditionalSchauderBasis I K E) (A : Finset I)
    (i : I) (x : E) : b.coord i (b.proj A x) = if i ∈ A then b.coord i x else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [b.proj_apply, b.ortho, Pi.single_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.sorted_coefficient_proj
statement:
theorem sorted_coefficient_proj (b : UnconditionalSchauderBasis I K E) (n : ℕ)
    (A : Finset I) (x : Fin n → E) (s : Set.powersetCard I n) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j => b.coord (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s i)
      (b.proj A (x j))).det =
    if s.val ⊆ A then
      (Matrix.of fun i j => b.coord (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s i) (x j)).det
    else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs : s.val ⊆ A
  · rw [ite_eq_left hs]
    apply congrArg Matrix.det
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
    rw [schauder_coord_proj, ite_eq_left]
    apply hs
    exact (Set.powersetCard.mem_range_ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_iff_mem s _).mp ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · rw [ite_eq_right hs]
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hiA⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hs
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (Set.powersetCard.mem_range_ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_iff_mem s i).mpr hi
    apply Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero j
    intro l
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, hj, schauder_coord_proj, ite_eq_right hiA]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.sum_sortedBasisTerm_eq_projection
statement:
theorem sum_sortedBasisTerm_eq_projection [IsUltrametricDist F]
    (b : UnconditionalSchauderBasis I K E) (n : ℕ)
    (a : E [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F) (x : Fin n → E) (A : Finset I) :
    (∑ s ∈ sortedFiniteSubsets n A, sortedBasisTerm b n a.toContinuousMultilinearMap x s) =
      a (fun j => b.proj A (x j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := Submodule.span K (Set.range b)
  let bD := Basis.span b.linearIndependent
  let aD := a.compContinuousLinearMap D.subtypeL
  let v : Fin n → D := fun j => schauderProjectionSpan b A (x j)
  let c := (bD.exteriorPower n).repr (exteriorPower.ιMulti K n v)
  have hc (s : Set.powersetCard I n) : c s =
      (Matrix.of fun i j => b.coord (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s i)
        (b.proj A (x j))).det := by
    dsimp only [c, bD]
    rw [exteriorPower.basis_repr_apply, exteriorPower.ιMultiDual_apply_ιMulti]
    simp_rw [schauderSpanBasis_coord]
    exact Matrix.det_transpose _
  have hsupp : c.support ⊆ sortedFiniteSubsets n A := by
    intro s hs
    rw [mem_sortedFiniteSubsets]
    by_contra hsa
    have hz : c s = 0 := by rw [hc, sorted_coefficient_proj, ite_eq_right hsa]
    exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hs hz
  have heval : sortedAlternatingMap bD n aD.toContinuousMultilinearMap v =
      a (fun j => b.proj A (x j)) :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun (sortedAlternatingMap_retract bD n aD) v
  rw [sortedAlternatingMap_apply] at heval
  have hsum : c.sum (fun s z => z • a (b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s)) =
      a (fun j => b.proj A (x j)) := by
    change c.sum (fun s z => z • a (fun i =>
      (bD (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s i) : E))) = _ at heval
    simpa only [bD, Basis.coe_span_apply, Function.comp_def] using heval
  rw [Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset c hsupp
    (fun s z => z • a (b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s))
    (fun _ _ => zero_smul K _)] at hsum
  rw [← hsum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  rw [hc, sorted_coefficient_proj, ite_eq_left ((mem_sortedFiniteSubsets n A s).mp hs)]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.hasSum_sortedBasisTerm
statement:
theorem hasSum_sortedBasisTerm [IsUltrametricDist F] [CompleteSpace F]
    (b : UnconditionalSchauderBasis I K E) (n : ℕ)
    (a : E [⋀^Fin n]→L[K] F) (x : Fin n → E) :
    HasSum (sortedBasisTerm b n a.toContinuousMultilinearMap x) (a x)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := summable_sortedBasisTerm b n a.toContinuousMultilinearMap x
  have hpartial := hs.hasSum.comp (tendsto_sortedFiniteSubsets (I := I) n)
  have hlimit : Tendsto (fun A : Finset I => a (fun j => b.proj A (x j)))
      atTop (𝓝 (a x)) :=
    a.cont.tendsto x |>.comp (tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr fun j => b.tendsto_proj (x j))
  have hpartial' : Tendsto (fun A : Finset I => a (fun j => b.proj A (x j))) atTop
      (𝓝 (∑' s, sortedBasisTerm b n a.toContinuousMultilinearMap x s)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, sum_sortedBasisTerm_eq_projection] using hpartial
  have heq := tendsto_nhds_unique hpartial' hlimit
  rw [← heq]
  exact hs.hasSum

name: AlternatingAnalytic.norm_det_le_factorial_mul_prod
statement:
theorem norm_det_le_factorial_mul_prod {K : Type*} [NormedField K] {k : ℕ}
    (a : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) K) (r c : Fin k → ℝ)
    (_hr : ∀ i, 0 ≤ r i) (_hc : ∀ j, 0 ≤ c j)
    (hbound : ∀ i j, ‖a i j‖ ≤ r i * c j) :
    ‖a.det‖ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * (∏ i, r i) * ∏ j, c j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Matrix.det_apply]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), ‖Equiv.Perm.sign σ • ∏ j, a (σ j) j‖ :=
      norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), (∏ i, r i) * ∏ j, c j := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro σ _
      rw [norm_units_zsmul, norm_prod]
      calc
        _ ≤ ∏ j, r (σ j) * c j :=
          Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun j _ => hbound _ _)
        _ = (∏ i, r i) * ∏ j, c j := by
          rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Equiv.prod_comp σ]
    _ = _ := by simp [Fintype.card_perm, mul_assoc]

name: L1Coordinates.ext_single
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  have hs (s : Finset J) :
      C (fun r => ∑ j ∈ s, lp.single 1 j (x r j)) =
        D (fun r => ∑ j ∈ s, lp.single 1 j (x r j)) := by
    simp only [map_sum_single, h]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_map_sum_single C x)

name: L1Coordinates.linearOfBounded_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearOfBounded_single (c : J → W) (M : ℝ) (hc : ∀ j, ‖c j‖ ≤ M) (j : J) :
    linearOfBounded (K := K) c M hc (lp.single 1 j (1 : K)) = c j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : Fin.snoc 0 (lp.single (E := fun _ : J => K) 1 j (1 : K)) =
      fun _ : Fin 1 => lp.single 1 j (1 : K) := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    rfl
  simp only [linearOfBounded, continuousMultilinearCurryFin1_apply, hs]
  exact continuousMultilinearOfBounded_single _ _ _ (fun _ => j)

name: L1Coordinates.norm_linearOfBounded_le
statement:
theorem norm_linearOfBounded_le (c : J → W) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hc : ∀ j, ‖c j‖ ≤ M) : ‖linearOfBounded (K := K) c M hc‖ ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearOfBounded, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
  exact continuousMultilinearOfBounded_norm_le _ M hM _

name: L1Coordinates.norm_wordCoefficient_le
statement:
theorem norm_wordCoefficient_le
    (p : FormalMultilinearSeries K (lp (fun _ : I => K) 1) H) (s : K) (M : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ n, ‖p n‖ * ‖s‖ ^ n ≤ M) (j : Σ n : ℕ, Fin n → I) :
    ‖wordCoefficient p s j‖ ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordCoefficient, norm_smul, norm_pow, UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe]
  have hbound : ‖p j.1 (fun i => lp.single 1 (j.2 i) (1 : K))‖ ≤ ‖p j.1‖ := by
    simpa using (p j.1).le_opNorm (fun i => lp.single 1 (j.2 i) (1 : K))
  calc
    ‖s‖ ^ j.1 * ‖p j.1 (fun i => lp.single 1 (j.2 i) (1 : K))‖
        ≤ ‖s‖ ^ j.1 * ‖p j.1‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (by positivity)
    _ ≤ M := by simpa only [mul_comm] using hp j.1

name: L1Coordinates.wordSynthesis_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordSynthesis_single
    (p : FormalMultilinearSeries K (lp (fun _ : I => K) 1) H)
    (s : K) (M : ℝ) (hp : ∀ n, ‖p n‖ * ‖s‖ ^ n ≤ M) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → I) :
    wordSynthesis p s M hp (lp.single 1 ⟨n, a⟩ (1 : K)) =
      s ^ n • ((p n (fun i => lp.single 1 (a i) (1 : K)) : H) :
        UniformSpace.Completion H)
proof:
:= by
  exact linearOfBounded_single _ _ _ _

name: L1Coordinates.norm_wordSynthesis_le
statement:
theorem norm_wordSynthesis_le
    (p : FormalMultilinearSeries K (lp (fun _ : I => K) 1) H)
    (s : K) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hp : ∀ n, ‖p n‖ * ‖s‖ ^ n ≤ M) :
    ‖wordSynthesis p s M hp‖ ≤ M
proof:
:=
  norm_linearOfBounded_le _ M hM _

name: L1Coordinates.wordSynthesis_wordBlock
statement:
theorem wordSynthesis_wordBlock
    (p : FormalMultilinearSeries K (L1 K I) H) (s : K) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (M : ℝ) (hp : ∀ n, ‖p n‖ * ‖s‖ ^ n ≤ M)
    (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → L1 K I) :
    wordSynthesis p s M hp (wordBlock s n x) =
      (p n x : UniformSpace.Completion H)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (wordSynthesis p s M hp).compContinuousMultilinearMap (wordBlock s n) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap
        (UniformSpace.Completion.toComplL : H →L[K] UniformSpace.Completion H) (p n) := by
    apply ext_single
    intro a
    change wordSynthesis p s M hp (wordBlock s n (fun i => lp.single 1 (a i) (1 : K))) = _
    rw [wordBlock_single, map_smul, wordSynthesis_single, smul_smul]
    simp [hs]
  exact congrArg (fun C => C x) heq

name: L1Coordinates.word_mk_injective
statement:
private theorem word_mk_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun a : Fin n → I => (⟨n, a⟩ : Words I))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  simpa using h

name: L1Coordinates.wordCoordinateMap_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordCoordinateMap_same (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → I)
    (x : Fin n → L1 K I) :
    wordCoordinateMap (K := K) n ⟨n, a⟩ x = ∏ i, x i (a i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordCoordinateMap, (word_mk_injective n).extend_apply]
  simp

name: L1Coordinates.wordCoordinateMap_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem wordCoordinateMap_of_not_mem (n : ℕ) (w : Words I)
    (h : w ∉ Set.range (Sigma.mk n)) :
    wordCoordinateMap (K := K) n w = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ h

name: L1Coordinates.wordCoordinateMap_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordCoordinateMap_ne (n : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → I)
    (h : m ≠ n) (x : Fin n → L1 K I) :
    wordCoordinateMap (K := K) n ⟨m, a⟩ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordCoordinateMap_of_not_mem]
  · rfl
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    exact h (congrArg Sigma.fst hb).symm

name: L1Coordinates.hasSum_norm_wordCoordinateMap
statement:
theorem hasSum_norm_wordCoordinateMap (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → L1 K I) :
    HasSum (fun w : Words I => ‖wordCoordinateMap (K := K) n w x‖) (∏ i, ‖x i‖)
proof:
:= by
  apply ((word_mk_injective n).hasSum_iff ?_).mp
  · simpa [Function.comp_def, norm_prod] using hasSum_prod_norm n x
  · intro w hw
    rw [wordCoordinateMap_of_not_mem n w hw]
    simp

name: L1Coordinates.norm_wordBlockMultilinear
statement:
theorem norm_wordBlockMultilinear (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → L1 K I) :
    ‖wordBlockMultilinear (K := K) n x‖ = ∏ i, ‖x i‖
proof:
:= by
  exact (hasSum_norm (wordBlockMultilinear (K := K) n x)).unique
    (hasSum_norm_wordCoordinateMap (K := K) n x)

name: L1Coordinates.wordBlock_apply_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordBlock_apply_same (s : K) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → L1 K I)
    (a : Fin n → I) :
    wordBlock s n x ⟨n, a⟩ = (s⁻¹)^n * ∏ i, x i (a i)
proof:
:= by
  change (s⁻¹)^n * wordCoordinateMap (K := K) n ⟨n, a⟩ x = _
  rw [wordCoordinateMap_same]

name: L1Coordinates.wordBlock_apply_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordBlock_apply_ne (s : K) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → L1 K I)
    {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → I) (h : m ≠ n) :
    wordBlock s n x ⟨m, a⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (s⁻¹)^n * wordCoordinateMap (K := K) n ⟨m, a⟩ x = _
  rw [wordCoordinateMap_ne n a h, mul_zero]

name: L1Coordinates.norm_wordBlock_le
statement:
theorem norm_wordBlock_le (s : K) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖wordBlock (I := I) s n‖ ≤ ‖s⁻¹‖^n
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordBlock, norm_smul, norm_pow]
  simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    ((wordBlockMultilinear (K := K) (I := I) n).mkContinuous_norm_le
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (fun x => by simp [norm_wordBlockMultilinear]))
    (norm_nonneg ((s⁻¹)^n))

name: L1Coordinates.wordBlock_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordBlock_single (s : K) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → I) :
    wordBlock s n (fun i => lp.single 1 (a i) (1 : K)) =
      (s⁻¹)^n • lp.single 1 ⟨n, a⟩ (1 : K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply lp.ext
  funext w
  obtain ⟨m, b⟩ := w
  by_cases hm : m = n
  · subst m
    rw [wordBlock_apply_same]
    by_cases hb : b = a
    · subst b
      simp
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hb
      have hs : (⟨n, b⟩ : Words I) ≠ ⟨n, a⟩ := by simpa using hb
      change (s⁻¹)^n * (∏ r, (lp.single 1 (a r) (1 : K) : L1 K I) (b r)) =
        (s⁻¹)^n * ((lp.single 1 ⟨n, a⟩ (1 : K) : L1 K (Words I)) ⟨n, b⟩)
      rw [lp.single_apply_ne _ _ _ hs, mul_zero]
      rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (lp.single_apply_ne 1 (a i) 1 hi)]
      simp
  · rw [wordBlock_apply_ne s n _ b hm]
    have hs : (⟨m, b⟩ : Words I) ≠ ⟨n, a⟩ := fun h => hm (congrArg Sigma.fst h)
    change 0 = (s⁻¹)^n * ((lp.single 1 ⟨n, a⟩ (1 : K) : L1 K (Words I)) ⟨m, b⟩)
    rw [lp.single_apply_ne _ _ _ hs, mul_zero]

name: DependentCZero.ext
statement:

theorem ext {x y : DependentCZero K E} (h : ∀ i, x i = y i) : x = y

@[simp] theorem add_apply (x y : DependentCZero K E) (i : I) :

@[simp] theorem sub_apply (x y : DependentCZero K E) (i : I) :

statement:
@[simp] theorem smul_apply (a : K) (x : DependentCZero K E) (i : I) :

name: DependentCZero.norm_le

theorem norm_le {x : DependentCZero K E} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)

name: DependentCZero.single_mem
statement:
theorem single_mem (i : I) (v : E i) :
    letI := Classical.decEq I
    lp.single ∞ i v ∈ dependentCZeroSubmodule K E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (dependentCZeroSpan K E).le_topologicalClosure
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, v, rfl⟩)

name: DependentCZero.single_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem single_apply (i : I) (v : E i) (j : I) :
    letI := Classical.decEq I
    single (K := K) (E := E) i v j = Pi.single i v j
proof: := rfl

name: DependentCZero.single_apply_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem single_apply_self (i : I) (v : E i) :
    single (K := K) (E := E) i v i = v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact lp.single_apply_self ∞ i v

name: DependentCZero.single_apply_ne
statement:
theorem single_apply_ne (i : I) (v : E i) {j : I} (h : j ≠ i) :
    single (K := K) (E := E) i v j = 0
proof:
