      (ContinuousAlternatingMap.toContinuousMultilinearMapLI (𝕜 := K) (E := P) (F := F)
        (ι := Fin k))
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.isClosed_range_toContinuousMultilinearMap (h x hx)⟩

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticOnNhd_fderiv_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_fderiv_of_contDiffOn {U : Set P} {ψ : P → P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hψ : ContDiffOn K ω ψ U) : AnalyticOnNhd K (fderiv K ψ) U
proof:
:=
  hU.analyticOn_iff_analyticOnNhd.mp (hψ.fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_top).analyticOn

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticOnNhd_compContinuousLinearMapCLM_fderiv_of_retraction
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_compContinuousLinearMapCLM_fderiv_of_retraction
    (R : ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin k => P) F →L[K] (P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F))
    (hR : ∀ a : P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F, R a.toContinuousMultilinearMap = a)
    {U : Set P} {ψ : P → P} (hU : IsOpen U) (hψ : ContDiffOn K ω ψ U) :
    AnalyticOnNhd K
      (fun y => (ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM (fderiv K ψ y) :
        (P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) →L[K] (P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F))) U
proof:
:= fun y hy =>
  (((contDiff_compContinuousLinearMapCLM_of_retraction' (E' := P) (n := ω) R hR).analyticOnNhd
    (s := univ)) _ trivial).comp (analyticOnNhd_fderiv_of_contDiffOn hU hψ y hy)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.analyticOnNhd_compContinuousLinearMapCLM_fderiv_of_finiteCoordinates
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_compContinuousLinearMapCLM_fderiv_of_finiteCoordinates {d : ℕ}
    (c : P ≃L[K] (Fin d → K)) {U : Set P} {ψ : P → P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hψ : ContDiffOn K ω ψ U) :
    AnalyticOnNhd K
      (fun y => (ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM (fderiv K ψ y) :
        (P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) →L[K] (P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F))) U
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have h := analyticAt_alternatingMapAction_comp_of_finite_coordinates (E := P) (F := F)
    (F' := F) c k (γ := fun y => (fderiv K ψ y, ContinuousLinearMap.id K F))
    ((analyticOnNhd_fderiv_of_contDiffOn hU hψ y hy).prod analyticAt_const)
  have heq : (alternatingMapAction k ∘ fun y => (fderiv K ψ y, ContinuousLinearMap.id K F)) =
      fun y => (ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM (fderiv K ψ y) :
        (P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) →L[K] (P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F)) :=
    funext fun y => alternatingMapAction_id_right k (fderiv K ψ y)
  rwa [heq] at h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.contDiff_alternatingMapAction_of_retraction
statement:
theorem contDiff_alternatingMapAction_of_retraction {k : ℕ} {n : WithTop ℕ∞}
    (R : ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin k => F₁) F₂ →L[K] (F₁ [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F₂))
    (hR : ∀ a : F₁ [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F₂, R a.toContinuousMultilinearMap = a) :
    ContDiff K n (alternatingMapAction (K := K) (E := F₁) (E' := F₁) (F := F₂) (F' := F₂) k)
proof:
:= by
  have hQ := contDiff_compContinuousLinearMapCLM_of_retraction' (E' := F₁) (n := ω) R hR
  refine AnalyticOnNhd.contDiff fun z _ => ?_
  exact analyticAt_alternatingMapAction_of_precomposition k z
    (hQ.analyticOnNhd (s := univ) _ trivial)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.contMDiffVectorBundle_alternating_of_retraction
statement:
theorem contMDiffVectorBundle_alternating_of_retraction (k : ℕ)
    (R : ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin k => F₁) F₂ →L[K] (F₁ [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F₂))
    (hR : ∀ a : F₁ [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F₂, R a.toContinuousMultilinearMap = a) :
    ContMDiffVectorBundle n (F₁ [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F₂)
      (fun x ↦ E₁ x [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] E₂ x) I
proof:
:=
  contMDiffVectorBundle_alternating_of_family k fun {_} _ {_} hγ =>
    fun x hx => (contDiff_alternatingMapAction_of_retraction (n := n) R hR).comp_contMDiffWithinAt
      (hγ x hx)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.wedgeMult_apply
statement:
theorem wedgeMult_apply (f : ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin k => P) K)
    (g : ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin l => P) K) (v : Fin (k + l) → P) :
    wedgeMult K P k l f g v = ∑ q : Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin k) (Fin l),
      (Perm.sign (Quotient.out q) : ℤ) •
        (f (fun i => v (finSumFinEquiv (Quotient.out q (Sum.inl i)))) *
          g (fun j => v (finSumFinEquiv (Quotient.out q (Sum.inr j)))))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wedgeMult, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply, sum_apply, smul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.summand_eq_out
statement:
theorem summand_eq_out {μ : P [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[K] K} {ν : P [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[K] K}
    (q : Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin k) (Fin l)) :
    AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand μ ν q =
      Perm.sign (Quotient.out q) • MultilinearMap.domDomCongr (Quotient.out q)
        ((μ : MultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin k => P) K).domCoprod
          (ν : MultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin l => P) K))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Quotient.out_eq q]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.toContinuousMultilinearMap_wedge
statement:
theorem toContinuousMultilinearMap_wedge (μ : P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) (ν : P [⋀^Fin l]→L[K] K) :
    (wedge μ ν).toContinuousMultilinearMap =
      wedgeMult K P k l μ.toContinuousMultilinearMap ν.toContinuousMultilinearMap
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [wedgeMult_apply]
  change shuffle μ.toAlternatingMap ν.toAlternatingMap v = _
  simp only [shuffle, AlternatingMap.domDomCongr_apply, LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply,
    AlternatingMap.domCoprod_apply, sum_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  rw [summand_eq_out]
  have hu : ∀ (u : ℤˣ) (m : MultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin k ⊕ Fin l => P) (TensorProduct K K K))
      (x : Fin k ⊕ Fin l → P), (u • m) x = u • m x := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  rw [hu, map_zsmul_unit]
  simp only [MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply,
    LinearMap.mul'_apply, Function.comp_apply, Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.IsAmbientAnalyticOn.wedge
statement:
theorem IsAmbientAnalyticOn.wedge {U : Set P} {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K}
    {ζ : P → P [⋀^Fin l]→L[K] K} (hη : IsAmbientAnalyticOn η U)
    (hζ : IsAmbientAnalyticOn ζ U) :
    IsAmbientAnalyticOn (fun y => Forms.wedge (η y) (ζ y)) U
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have h := AnalyticAt.comp
    (f := fun x => ((η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap, (ζ x).toContinuousMultilinearMap)) (x := y)
    (ContinuousLinearMap.analyticAt_bilinear (wedgeMult K P k l) _) ((hη y hy).prod (hζ y hy))
  refine h.congr (Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
  exact (toContinuousMultilinearMap_wedge (η x) (ζ x)).symm

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.fderiv_wedge_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_wedge_apply {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K} {ζ : P → P [⋀^Fin l]→L[K] K} {y : P}
    (hη : AnalyticAt K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) y)
    (hζ : AnalyticAt K (fun x => (ζ x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) y) (w : P) :
    fderiv K (fun x => Forms.wedge (η x) (ζ x)) y w =
      Forms.wedge (fderiv K η y w) (ζ y) + Forms.wedge (η y) (fderiv K ζ y w)
proof:
:= by
  have hB := (wedgeMult K P k l).hasFDerivAt_of_bilinear hη.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
    hζ.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  have hfun : (fun x => wedgeMult K P k l (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap
      (ζ x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) =
      fun x => (Forms.wedge (η x) (ζ x)).toContinuousMultilinearMap :=
    funext fun x => (toContinuousMultilinearMap_wedge (η x) (ζ x)).symm
  rw [hfun] at hB
  have hA : AnalyticAt K (fun x => (Forms.wedge (η x) (ζ x)).toContinuousMultilinearMap) y := by
    have h := AnalyticAt.comp
      (f := fun x => ((η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap, (ζ x).toContinuousMultilinearMap))
      (x := y) (ContinuousLinearMap.analyticAt_bilinear (wedgeMult K P k l) _) (hη.prod hζ)
    refine h.congr (Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    exact (toContinuousMultilinearMap_wedge (η x) (ζ x)).symm
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hJ⟩ := exists_hasFDerivAt_of_analyticAt hA
  rw [hM.fderiv]
  apply (inclLI K P K (k + l)).injective
  have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun hJ w
  rw [hB.fderiv] at h1
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap] at h1
  rw [h1]
  simp only [add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.precompR_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.precompL_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [← toContinuousMultilinearMap_fderiv_apply hη, ← toContinuousMultilinearMap_fderiv_apply hζ]
  simp only [map_add, ContinuousAlternatingMap.toContinuousMultilinearMapLI_apply,
    toContinuousMultilinearMap_wedge]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.one_wedge
statement:
theorem one_wedge (μ : P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) (v : Fin (0 + k) → P) :
    wedge (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty K P (Fin 0) (1 : K)) μ v =
      μ (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.zero_add k).symm)
proof:
:=
  shuffle_constOfIsEmpty_left μ.toAlternatingMap v

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.wedge_one
statement:
theorem wedge_one (μ : P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) (v : Fin (k + 0) → P) :
    wedge μ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty K P (Fin 0) (1 : K)) v =
      μ (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.add_zero k).symm)
proof:
:=
  shuffle_constOfIsEmpty_right μ.toAlternatingMap v

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.wedge_assoc
statement:
theorem wedge_assoc (μ : P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) (ν : P [⋀^Fin l]→L[K] K)
    (θ : P [⋀^Fin m]→L[K] K) (v : Fin (k + l + m) → P) :
    wedge (wedge μ ν) θ v = wedge μ (wedge ν θ) (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.add_assoc k l m).symm)
proof:
:=
  shuffle_assoc μ.toAlternatingMap ν.toAlternatingMap θ.toAlternatingMap v

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.wedge_comm
statement:
theorem wedge_comm (μ : P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) (ν : P [⋀^Fin l]→L[K] K)
    (v : Fin (k + l) → P) :
    wedge μ ν v = (-1 : K) ^ (k * l) * wedge ν μ (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.add_comm l k))
proof:
:=
  shuffle_comm μ.toAlternatingMap ν.toAlternatingMap v

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.toAlternatingMap_extDeriv
statement:
theorem toAlternatingMap_extDeriv (η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) (y : P) :
    (extDeriv η y).toAlternatingMap = AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin
      (ContinuousAlternatingMap.toAlternatingMapLinear ∘ₗ (fderiv K η y : P →ₗ[K] _))
proof:
:=
  ContinuousAlternatingMap.toAlternatingMap_alternatizeUncurryFin _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.leibniz
statement:
theorem leibniz {U : Set P} {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K} {ζ : P → P [⋀^Fin l]→L[K] K}
    (hη : IsAmbientAnalyticOn η U) (hζ : IsAmbientAnalyticOn ζ U) :
    ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ v : Fin (k + l + 1) → P, extDeriv (fun x => wedge (η x) (ζ x)) y v =
      wedge (extDeriv η y) (ζ y) (v ∘ finCongr (by omega : k + 1 + l = k + l + 1)) +
        (-1 : K) ^ k *
          wedge (η y) (extDeriv ζ y) (v ∘ finCongr (by omega : k + (l + 1) = k + l + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy v
  have h1 := sum_shuffle_left_removeNth
    (ContinuousAlternatingMap.toAlternatingMapLinear ∘ₗ (fderiv K η y : P →ₗ[K] _))
    (ζ y).toAlternatingMap v
  have h2 := sum_shuffle_right_removeNth (η y).toAlternatingMap
    (ContinuousAlternatingMap.toAlternatingMapLinear ∘ₗ (fderiv K ζ y : P →ₗ[K] _)) v
  rw [wedge_apply, wedge_apply, toAlternatingMap_extDeriv, toAlternatingMap_extDeriv, ← h1,
    ← smul_eq_mul, ← h2, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  change ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin _ v = _
  rw [ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [fderiv_wedge_apply (hη y hy) (hζ y hy), ContinuousAlternatingMap.add_apply, smul_add]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.IsAmbientAnalyticOn.extDeriv
statement:
theorem IsAmbientAnalyticOn.extDeriv {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U) {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K}
    (hη : IsAmbientAnalyticOn η U) : IsAmbientAnalyticOn (Forms.extDeriv η) U
proof:
:=
  isAmbientAnalyticOn_extDeriv hU hη

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.extDeriv_extDeriv
statement:
theorem extDeriv_extDeriv {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U) {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K}
    (hη : IsAmbientAnalyticOn η U) : ∀ y ∈ U, Forms.extDeriv (Forms.extDeriv η) y = 0
proof:
:=
  fun _ hy => extDeriv_extDeriv_apply hU hη hy

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.mulProd_apply
statement:
theorem mulProd_apply (a : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k => M) R)
    (b : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin l => M) R) (v : Fin (k + l) → M) :
    mulProd a b v = a (fun i => v (Fin.castAdd l i)) * b (fun j => v (Fin.natAdd k j))
proof:
:= by
  simp [mulProd, MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.alternatization_domDomCongr
statement:
theorem alternatization_domDomCongr {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    {ι ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (e : ι ≃ ι')
    (a : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => M) N) :
    MultilinearMap.alternatization (a.domDomCongr e) =
      (MultilinearMap.alternatization a).domDomCongr e
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [MultilinearMap.alternatization_apply, AlternatingMap.domDomCongr_apply,
    MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv (e.symm.permCongr) _ _ fun σ => ?_
  simp [Perm.sign_permCongr]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_alternatization
statement:
theorem shuffle_alternatization (a : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k => M) R)
    (b : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin l => M) R) :
    shuffle (MultilinearMap.alternatization a) (MultilinearMap.alternatization b) =
      MultilinearMap.alternatization (mulProd a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulProd, alternatization_domDomCongr, LinearMap.compMultilinearMap_alternatization,
    MultilinearMap.domCoprod_alternization]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.mulProd_assoc
statement:
theorem mulProd_assoc (a : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k => M) R)
    (b : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin l => M) R) (c : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin m => M) R) :
    mulProd (mulProd a b) c =
      (mulProd a (mulProd b c)).domDomCongr (finCongr (Nat.add_assoc k l m).symm)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [mulProd_apply, MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, mul_assoc]
  congr 2
  congr 1
  funext i
  congr 1
  ext
  simp only [finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast, Fin.val_natAdd]
  omega

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.mulProd_comm
statement:
theorem mulProd_comm (a : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k => M) R)
    (b : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin l => M) R) :
    mulProd b a = (mulProd a b).domDomCongr finAddFlip
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, mulProd_apply, mulProd_apply, mul_comm]
  congr 2
  · funext i
    exact congrArg v (finAddFlip_apply_castAdd i l).symm
  · funext j
    exact congrArg v (finAddFlip_apply_natAdd j k).symm

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.constOfIsEmpty_mulProd
statement:
theorem constOfIsEmpty_mulProd (a : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k => M) R) :
    mulProd (MultilinearMap.constOfIsEmpty R (fun _ : Fin 0 => M) (1 : R)) a =
      a.domDomCongr (finCongr (Nat.zero_add k).symm)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [mulProd_apply, MultilinearMap.constOfIsEmpty_apply, Function.const_apply, one_mul,
    MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply]
  congr 1
  funext j
  congr 1
  ext
  simp

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.mulProd_constOfIsEmpty
statement:
theorem mulProd_constOfIsEmpty (a : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k => M) R) :
    mulProd a (MultilinearMap.constOfIsEmpty R (fun _ : Fin 0 => M) (1 : R)) =
      a.domDomCongr (finCongr (Nat.add_zero k).symm)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [mulProd_apply, MultilinearMap.constOfIsEmpty_apply, Function.const_apply, mul_one,
    MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.alternatization_constOfIsEmpty
statement:
theorem alternatization_constOfIsEmpty :
    MultilinearMap.alternatization (MultilinearMap.constOfIsEmpty R (fun _ : Fin 0 => M) (1 : R)) =
      AlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty R M (Fin 0) (1 : R)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [MultilinearMap.alternatization_apply]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_add_left
statement:
theorem shuffle_add_left (μ₁ μ₂ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) :
    shuffle (μ₁ + μ₂) ν = shuffle μ₁ ν + shuffle μ₂ ν
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [shuffle, ← AlternatingMap.domCoprod'_apply, TensorProduct.add_tmul]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_add_right
statement:
theorem shuffle_add_right (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (ν₁ ν₂ : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) :
    shuffle μ (ν₁ + ν₂) = shuffle μ ν₁ + shuffle μ ν₂
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [shuffle, ← AlternatingMap.domCoprod'_apply, TensorProduct.tmul_add]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_smul_left
statement:
theorem shuffle_smul_left (c : R) (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) :
    shuffle (c • μ) ν = c • shuffle μ ν
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [shuffle, ← AlternatingMap.domCoprod'_apply, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_smul_right
statement:
theorem shuffle_smul_right (c : R) (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) :
    shuffle μ (c • ν) = c • shuffle μ ν
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [shuffle, ← AlternatingMap.domCoprod'_apply, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_sum_left
statement:
theorem shuffle_sum_left {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (μ : ι → M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R)
    (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) : shuffle (∑ i ∈ s, μ i) ν = ∑ i ∈ s, shuffle (μ i) ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => ext v; simp [shuffle, ← AlternatingMap.domCoprod'_apply]
  | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, shuffle_add_left, ih, Finset.sum_insert hi]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_sum_right
statement:
theorem shuffle_sum_right {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R)
    (ν : ι → M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) : shuffle μ (∑ i ∈ s, ν i) = ∑ i ∈ s, shuffle μ (ν i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => ext v; simp [shuffle, ← AlternatingMap.domCoprod'_apply]
  | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, shuffle_add_right, ih, Finset.sum_insert hi]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.domCoprod_compLinearMap
statement:
theorem domCoprod_compLinearMap {ιa ιb : Type*} [Fintype ιa] [Fintype ιb] [DecidableEq ιa]
    [DecidableEq ιb] (μ : M [⋀^ιa]→ₗ[R] R) (ν : M [⋀^ιb]→ₗ[R] R) (g : M' →ₗ[R] M) :
    (μ.compLinearMap g).domCoprod (ν.compLinearMap g) = (μ.domCoprod ν).compLinearMap g
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [AlternatingMap.domCoprod_apply, AlternatingMap.compLinearMap_apply, sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
  induction σ using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | h σ => simp [AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand_mk'', MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_compLinearMap
statement:
theorem shuffle_compLinearMap (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R)
    (g : M' →ₗ[R] M) :
    shuffle (μ.compLinearMap g) (ν.compLinearMap g) = (shuffle μ ν).compLinearMap g
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [shuffle, domCoprod_compLinearMap]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_domDomCongr_finCongr_left
statement:
theorem shuffle_domDomCongr_finCongr_left {k k' : ℕ} (h : k = k') (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R)
    (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) (v : Fin (k' + l) → M) :
    shuffle (μ.domDomCongr (finCongr h)) ν v = shuffle μ ν (v ∘ finCongr (by omega))
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  congr 1

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_domDomCongr_finCongr_right
statement:
theorem shuffle_domDomCongr_finCongr_right {l l' : ℕ} (h : l = l') (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R)
    (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) (v : Fin (k + l') → M) :
    shuffle μ (ν.domDomCongr (finCongr h)) v = shuffle μ ν (v ∘ finCongr (by omega))
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  congr 1

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.isClosed_range_inclLI
statement: theorem isClosed_range_inclLI : IsClosed (range (inclLI K P F k))
proof:
:=
  ContinuousAlternatingMap.isClosed_range_toContinuousMultilinearMap

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.multAlternatizeUncurryFin_apply
statement:
theorem multAlternatizeUncurryFin_apply
    (B : P →L[K] ContinuousMultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin k => P) F) (v : Fin (k + 1) → P) :
    multAlternatizeUncurryFin K P F k B v =
      ∑ i : Fin (k + 1), (-1 : K) ^ (i : ℕ) • B (v i) (Fin.removeNth i v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [multAlternatizeUncurryFin, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    sum_apply, smul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  congr 1
  change ((continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv K (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm B)
    (fun j => v ((Fin.cycleRange i).symm j)) = _
  rw [continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv_symm_apply, Fin.cycleRange_symm_zero]
  congr 1
  funext j
  simp [Fin.tail, Fin.removeNth, Fin.cycleRange_symm_succ]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.multAlternatizeUncurryFin_comp
statement:
theorem multAlternatizeUncurryFin_comp (A : P →L[K] P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F) :
    multAlternatizeUncurryFin K P F k ((inclLI K P F k).toContinuousLinearMap.comp A) =
      inclLI K P F (k + 1) (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin A)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [multAlternatizeUncurryFin_apply]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap,
    ContinuousAlternatingMap.toContinuousMultilinearMapLI_apply,
    ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toContinuousMultilinearMap,
    ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.exists_hasFDerivAt_of_analyticAt
statement:
theorem exists_hasFDerivAt_of_analyticAt {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F} {y : P}
    (h : AnalyticAt K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) y) :
    ∃ M : P →L[K] P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F, HasFDerivAt η M y ∧
      (inclLI K P F k).toContinuousLinearMap.comp M =
        fderiv K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) y
proof:
:=
  (inclLI K P F k).exists_hasFDerivAt_of_comp isClosed_range_inclLI h.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.differentiableAt_of_analyticAt
proof:
:=
  (exists_hasFDerivAt_of_analyticAt h).choose_spec.1.differentiableAt

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.inclLI_comp_fderiv
statement:
theorem inclLI_comp_fderiv {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F} {y : P}
    (h : AnalyticAt K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) y) :
    (inclLI K P F k).toContinuousLinearMap.comp (fderiv K η y) =
      fderiv K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hJ⟩ := exists_hasFDerivAt_of_analyticAt h
  rw [hM.fderiv, hJ]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.toContinuousMultilinearMap_fderiv_apply
statement:
theorem toContinuousMultilinearMap_fderiv_apply {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F} {y : P}
    (h : AnalyticAt K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) y) (w : P) :
    (fderiv K η y w).toContinuousMultilinearMap =
      fderiv K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) y w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inclLI_comp_fderiv h]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.exists_hasFDerivAt_fderiv
statement:
theorem exists_hasFDerivAt_fderiv {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F} {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hη : AnalyticOnNhd K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) U) {y : P} (hy : y ∈ U) :
    ∃ M : P →L[K] P →L[K] P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F, HasFDerivAt (fderiv K η) M y ∧
      (LinearIsometry.postcomp (E := P) (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id K)
        (inclLI K P F k)).toContinuousLinearMap.comp M =
        fderiv K (fderiv K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap)) y
proof:
:= by
  set Φ := LinearIsometry.postcomp (E := P) (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id K) (inclLI K P F k)
  have hd : HasFDerivAt (fderiv K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap))
      (fderiv K (fderiv K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap)) y) y :=
    ((hη.fderiv y hy).differentiableAt).hasFDerivAt
  have heq : (fun x => Φ (fderiv K η x)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
      fderiv K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) := by
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hy] with x hx
    exact inclLI_comp_fderiv (hη x hx)
  have hcl : IsClosed (range Φ) :=
    (inclLI K P F k).isClosed_range_postcomp isClosed_range_inclLI
  exact Φ.exists_hasFDerivAt_of_comp hcl (hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.isSymmSndFDerivAt_of_isAmbientAnalyticOn
proof:
:= by
  intro v w
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hJ⟩ := exists_hasFDerivAt_fderiv hU hη hy
  have hsymm := ((hη y hy).contDiffAt (n := ω)).isSymmSndFDerivAt_of_omega v w
  rw [hM.fderiv]
  apply (inclLI K P F k).injective
  have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L v w) hJ
  have h2 := congrArg (fun L => L w v) hJ
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, LinearIsometry.postcomp_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact hsymm

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.extDeriv_extDeriv_apply
statement:
theorem extDeriv_extDeriv_apply {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F} {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hη : AnalyticOnNhd K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) U) {y : P} (hy : y ∈ U) :
    _root_.extDeriv (_root_.extDeriv η) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM, -⟩ := exists_hasFDerivAt_fderiv hU hη hy
  have hcomp :=
    (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM K P F (n := k)).hasFDerivAt.comp y hM
  have hfun : _root_.extDeriv η =
      ⇑(ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM K P F (n := k)) ∘
      fderiv K η := rfl
  have hsymm : ∀ v w, M v w = M w v := fun v w => by
    have := isSymmSndFDerivAt_of_isAmbientAnalyticOn hU hη hy v w
    rwa [hM.fderiv] at this
  change ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (fderiv K (_root_.extDeriv η) y) = 0
  rw [hfun, hcomp.fderiv]
  exact ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_alternatizeUncurryFinCLM_comp_of_symmetric
    hsymm

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.isAmbientAnalyticOn_extDeriv
statement:
theorem isAmbientAnalyticOn_extDeriv {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] F} {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hη : AnalyticOnNhd K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) U) :
    AnalyticOnNhd K (fun x => (_root_.extDeriv η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) U
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have h1 := ((multAlternatizeUncurryFin K P F k).analyticAt _).comp (hη.fderiv y hy)
  refine h1.congr ?_
  filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hy] with x hx
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [← inclLI_comp_fderiv (hη x hx), multAlternatizeUncurryFin_comp]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.compLinearMapₗ_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compLinearMapₗ_apply {M' N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M'] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R N] {ι : Type*} (g : M' →ₗ[R] M) (f : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N) :
    compLinearMapₗ g f = f.compLinearMap g
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.alternatizeUncurryFin_compLinearMap
statement:
theorem alternatizeUncurryFin_compLinearMap {M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M']
    (A : M →ₗ[R] M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (g : M' →ₗ[R] M) :
    (AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin A).compLinearMap g =
      AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (compLinearMapₗ g ∘ₗ A ∘ₗ g)
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  simp only [AlternatingMap.compLinearMap_apply, AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, compLinearMapₗ_apply]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.alternatingMap_sum_apply
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert j s hj ih => simp [Finset.sum_insert hj, AlternatingMap.add_apply, ih]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.alternatizeUncurryFin_sum
statement:
theorem alternatizeUncurryFin_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → M →ₗ[R] M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) :
    AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (∑ j ∈ s, f j) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (f j)
proof:
:=
  map_sum AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinLM f s

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.linearMap_eq_sum_smulRight
statement:
theorem linearMap_eq_sum_smulRight {N : ℕ} {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X]
    (A : (Fin N → R) →ₗ[R] X) :
    A = ∑ j, (LinearMap.proj j : (Fin N → R) →ₗ[R] R).smulRight (A (Pi.single j 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (Pi.basisFun R (Fin N)).ext fun i => ?_
  simp [Pi.single_apply]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight_eq
statement:
theorem alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight_eq (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) :
    AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (φ.smulRight μ) =
      (shuffle (AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M R (0 : Fin 1) φ) μ).domDomCongr
        (finCongr (Nat.add_comm 1 k))
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  rw [alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight, AlternatingMap.domDomCongr_apply]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.sum_shuffle_left_removeNth_smulRight
statement:
theorem sum_shuffle_left_removeNth_smulRight (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R)
    (ζ : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) (v : Fin (k + l + 1) → M) :
    ∑ i : Fin (k + l + 1),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • shuffle (φ.smulRight μ (v i)) ζ (Fin.removeNth i v) =
      shuffle (AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (φ.smulRight μ)) ζ
        (v ∘ finCongr (by omega : k + 1 + l = k + l + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∑ i : Fin (k + l + 1),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • shuffle (φ.smulRight μ (v i)) ζ (Fin.removeNth i v) =
      AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (φ.smulRight (shuffle μ ζ)) v := by
    simp [AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply, shuffle_smul_left]
  rw [hL, alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight, alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight_eq,
    shuffle_domDomCongr_finCongr_left, shuffle_assoc]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.sum_shuffle_right_removeNth_smulRight
statement:
theorem sum_shuffle_right_removeNth_smulRight (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R)
    (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) (v : Fin (k + l + 1) → M) :
    ∑ i : Fin (k + l + 1),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • shuffle μ (φ.smulRight ν (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) =
      (-1 : R) ^ k • shuffle μ (AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (φ.smulRight ν))
        (v ∘ finCongr (by omega : k + (l + 1) = k + l + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∑ i : Fin (k + l + 1),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • shuffle μ (φ.smulRight ν (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) =
      AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (φ.smulRight (shuffle μ ν)) v := by
    simp [AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply, shuffle_smul_right]
  set φ₁ := AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M R (0 : Fin 1) φ
  have h1 : shuffle φ₁ (shuffle μ ν) (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.add_comm 1 (k + l))) =
      shuffle (shuffle φ₁ μ) ν (v ∘ finCongr (by omega : 1 + k + l = k + l + 1)) :=
    (shuffle_assoc φ₁ μ ν (v ∘ finCongr (by omega : 1 + k + l = k + l + 1))).symm
  rw [hL, alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight, h1, shuffle_comm' φ₁ μ, shuffle_smul_left,
    AlternatingMap.smul_apply, shuffle_domDomCongr_finCongr_left, shuffle_assoc,
    alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight_eq, shuffle_domDomCongr_finCongr_right, one_mul]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.sum_shuffle_left_removeNth
statement:
theorem sum_shuffle_left_removeNth (A : M →ₗ[R] M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (ζ : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R)
    (v : Fin (k + l + 1) → M) :
    ∑ i : Fin (k + l + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • shuffle (A (v i)) ζ (Fin.removeNth i v) =
      shuffle (AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin A) ζ
        (v ∘ finCongr (by omega : k + 1 + l = k + l + 1))
proof:
:= by
  set L := tupleMap (R := R) v
  set A' := compLinearMapₗ L ∘ₗ A ∘ₗ L
  have hL : ∑ i : Fin (k + l + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • shuffle (A (v i)) ζ (Fin.removeNth i v) =
      ∑ i : Fin (k + l + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • shuffle (A' (Pi.single i 1)) (ζ.compLinearMap L)
        (Fin.removeNth i
          (fun j : Fin (k + l + 1) => (Pi.single j (1 : R) : Fin (k + l + 1) → R))) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp only [A', LinearMap.comp_apply, compLinearMapₗ_apply,
      shuffle_compLinearMap, AlternatingMap.compLinearMap_apply, Fin.removeNth_apply, L,
      tupleMap_single]
    rfl
  rw [hL, ← compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply (R := R), ← shuffle_compLinearMap,
    alternatizeUncurryFin_compLinearMap]
  change _ = shuffle (AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin A') _ _
  rw [linearMap_eq_sum_smulRight A']
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, shuffle_sum_left, alternatingMap_sum_apply,
    Finset.smul_sum,
    alternatizeUncurryFin_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  exact sum_shuffle_left_removeNth_smulRight _ _ _ _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.sum_shuffle_right_removeNth
statement:
theorem sum_shuffle_right_removeNth (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (B : M →ₗ[R] M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R)
    (v : Fin (k + l + 1) → M) :
    ∑ i : Fin (k + l + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • shuffle μ (B (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) =
      (-1 : R) ^ k • shuffle μ (AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin B)
        (v ∘ finCongr (by omega : k + (l + 1) = k + l + 1))
proof:
:= by
  set L := tupleMap (R := R) v
  set B' := compLinearMapₗ L ∘ₗ B ∘ₗ L
  have hL : ∑ i : Fin (k + l + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • shuffle μ (B (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) =
      ∑ i : Fin (k + l + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • shuffle (μ.compLinearMap L) (B' (Pi.single i 1))
        (Fin.removeNth i
          (fun j : Fin (k + l + 1) => (Pi.single j (1 : R) : Fin (k + l + 1) → R))) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp only [B', LinearMap.comp_apply, compLinearMapₗ_apply,
      shuffle_compLinearMap, AlternatingMap.compLinearMap_apply, Fin.removeNth_apply, L,
      tupleMap_single]
    rfl
  rw [hL, ← compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply (R := R), ← shuffle_compLinearMap,
    alternatizeUncurryFin_compLinearMap]
  change _ = (-1 : R) ^ k • shuffle _ (AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin B') _
  rw [linearMap_eq_sum_smulRight B']
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, shuffle_sum_right,
    alternatingMap_sum_apply, Finset.smul_sum,
    alternatizeUncurryFin_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  exact sum_shuffle_right_removeNth_smulRight _ _ _ _

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.analyticAt_clm_apply
statement:
theorem analyticAt_clm_apply {X E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace K X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace K E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace K F]
    {L : X → E →L[K] F} {u : X → E} {x : X} (hL : AnalyticAt K L x) (hu : AnalyticAt K u x) :
    AnalyticAt K (fun z => L z (u z)) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := AnalyticAt.comp (f := fun z => (L z, u z)) (x := x)
    (ContinuousLinearMap.analyticAt_bilinear (ContinuousLinearMap.id K (E →L[K] F)) (L x, u x))
    (hL.prod hu)
  exact h

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.isAmbientAnalyticOn_iff_local
statement:
theorem isAmbientAnalyticOn_iff_local [CompleteSpace K] (η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K)
    (U : Set P) :
    IsAmbientAnalyticOn η U ↔
      ∀ y ∈ U, ∃ V : Set P, IsOpen V ∧ y ∈ V ∧ IsAmbientAnalyticOn η V
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h y hy => ⟨{x | AnalyticAt K (fun x => (η x).toContinuousMultilinearMap) x},
    isOpen_analyticAt _ _, h y hy, fun x hx => hx⟩, fun h y hy => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨V, -, hyV, hV⟩ := h y hy
  exact hV y hyV

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.exists_glue
statement:
theorem exists_glue {ι : Type*} (V : ι → Set P) (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i))
    (η : ι → P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) (hη : ∀ i, IsAmbientAnalyticOn (η i) (V i))
    (hagree : ∀ i j, EqOn (η i) (η j) (V i ∩ V j)) :
    ∃ θ : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K,
      IsAmbientAnalyticOn θ (⋃ i, V i) ∧ ∀ i, EqOn θ (η i) (V i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let θ : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K := fun x =>
    if h : ∃ i, x ∈ V i then η h.choose x else 0
  have hθ : ∀ i, EqOn θ (η i) (V i) := by
    intro i x hx
    have h : ∃ i, x ∈ V i := ⟨i, hx⟩
    simp only [θ, h, ↓reduceDIte]
    exact hagree _ _ ⟨h.choose_spec, hx⟩
  refine ⟨θ, fun x hx => ?_, hθ⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
  refine (hη i x hi).congr ?_
  filter_upwards [(hV i).mem_nhds hi] with z hz
  rw [hθ i hz]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.isAmbientAnalyticOn_zero
statement:
theorem isAmbientAnalyticOn_zero (U : Set P) :
    IsAmbientAnalyticOn (fun _ : P => (0 : P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K)) U
proof:
:= fun _ _ => by
  simpa [IsAmbientAnalyticOn] using analyticAt_const

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.IsAmbientAnalyticOn.add
proof:
:= fun y hy =>
  ((hη y hy).add (hζ y hy)).congr (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.IsAmbientAnalyticOn.const_smul
proof:
:= fun y hy =>
  ((hη y hy).const_smul (c := c)).congr (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.pullback_id
statement: theorem pullback_id (η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) : pullback (fun y : P => y) η = η
proof:
:= by
  funext y
  ext v
  simp [pullback, fderiv_fun_id]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.pullback_comp
statement:
theorem pullback_comp {V : Set P''} {W : Set P'} (hV : IsOpen V) (hW : IsOpen W)
    {h₁ : P'' → P'} {h₂ : P' → P} (hh₁ : ContDiffOn K ω h₁ V) (hh₂ : ContDiffOn K ω h₂ W)
    (hmaps : MapsTo h₁ V W) (η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) :
    EqOn (pullback (h₂ ∘ h₁) η) (pullback h₁ (pullback h₂ η)) V
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hd₁ : DifferentiableAt K h₁ y :=
    (hh₁.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hd₂ : DifferentiableAt K h₂ (h₁ y) :=
    (hh₂.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds (hmaps hy))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  ext v
  simp only [pullback, fderiv_comp y hd₂ hd₁,
    ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    Function.comp_apply]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.pullback_wedge
statement:
theorem pullback_wedge (h : P' → P) (η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K)
    (ζ : P → P [⋀^Fin l]→L[K] K) :
    pullback h (fun y => wedge (η y) (ζ y)) =
      fun y => wedge (pullback h η y) (pullback h ζ y)
proof:
:= by
  funext y
  ext v
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (shuffle_compLinearMap (η (h y)).toAlternatingMap
    (ζ (h y)).toAlternatingMap (fderiv K h y : P' →ₗ[K] P)) v).symm

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.IsAmbientAnalyticOn.pullback
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hhy : AnalyticAt K h y := (hV.analyticOn_iff_analyticOnNhd.mp hh.analyticOn) y hy
  have hDh : AnalyticAt K (fderiv K h) y :=
    (hV.analyticOn_iff_analyticOnNhd.mp (hh.fderiv_of_isOpen hV le_top).analyticOn) y hy
  have h1 : AnalyticAt K (fun x => (η (h x)).toContinuousMultilinearMap) y :=
    (hη (h y) (hmaps hy)).comp hhy
  have h2 : AnalyticAt K (fun x =>
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapContinuousMultilinear
      K (fun _ : Fin k => P') (fun _ : Fin k => P) K (fun _ => fderiv K h x)) y :=
    (ContinuousMultilinearMap.analyticAt _).comp (AnalyticAt.pi fun _ => hDh)
  refine (analyticAt_clm_apply h2 h1).congr (Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
  ext v
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.pullback_extDeriv
statement:
theorem pullback_extDeriv {U : Set P} {V : Set P'} (hV : IsOpen V)
    {h : P' → P} (hh : ContDiffOn K ω h V) (hmaps : MapsTo h V U)
    {η : P → P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K} (hη : IsAmbientAnalyticOn η U) :
    EqOn (extDeriv (Forms.pullback h η)) (Forms.pullback h (extDeriv η)) V
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  exact extDeriv_pullback (differentiableAt_of_analyticAt (hη (h y) (hmaps hy)))
    (hh.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hy)) le_top

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.continuous_wedgeAlg
statement:
theorem continuous_wedgeAlg {k l : ℕ} (μ : P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) (ν : P [⋀^Fin l]→L[K] K) :
    Continuous (wedgeAlg μ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⇑(wedgeAlg μ ν) = fun v => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin k) (Fin l),
      LinearMap.mul' K K (AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand μ.toAlternatingMap ν.toAlternatingMap σ
        (v ∘ finSumFinEquiv)) := by
    funext v
    simp [wedgeAlg, AlternatingMap.domCoprod_apply, map_sum, Function.comp_def]
  rw [h]
  refine continuous_finsetSum _ fun σ _ => ?_
  induction σ using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | h σ =>
    simp only [AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand_mk'', smul_apply,
      MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply, map_zsmul_unit,
      LinearMap.mul'_apply, Function.comp_apply]
    simp only [Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
    exact continuous_const.mul
      ((μ.cont.comp (continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply _)).mul
        (ν.cont.comp (continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply _)))

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.toAlternatingMap_wedge
statement:
theorem toAlternatingMap_wedge {k l : ℕ} (μ : P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) (ν : P [⋀^Fin l]→L[K] K) :
    (wedge μ ν).toAlternatingMap = shuffle μ.toAlternatingMap ν.toAlternatingMap
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.wedge_apply
statement:
theorem wedge_apply {k l : ℕ} (μ : P [⋀^Fin k]→L[K] K) (ν : P [⋀^Fin l]→L[K] K)
    (v : Fin (k + l) → P) : wedge μ ν v = shuffle μ.toAlternatingMap ν.toAlternatingMap v
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.exists_alternatization_eq
statement:
theorem exists_alternatization_eq {N k : ℕ} (μ : (Fin N → R) [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) :
    ∃ a : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k => Fin N → R) R,
      MultilinearMap.alternatization a = μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := Pi.basisFun R (Fin N)
  let S : Finset (Fin k → Fin N) := Finset.univ.filter fun f => StrictMono f
  refine ⟨∑ f ∈ S, μ (fun t => e (f t)) •
      (MultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra R (Fin k) R).compLinearMap (fun t => LinearMap.proj (f t)), ?_⟩
  refine e.ext_alternating fun g hg => ?_
  have key : ∀ σ : Perm (Fin k),
      (∑ f ∈ S, μ (fun t => e (f t)) •
        (MultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra R (Fin k) R).compLinearMap
          (fun t => LinearMap.proj (f t))) (fun i => e (g (σ i))) =
        if StrictMono (g ∘ σ) then (Perm.sign σ : ℤ) • μ (fun i => e (g i)) else 0 := by
    intro σ
    simp only [sum_apply, smul_apply, MultilinearMap.compLinearMap_apply,
      MultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, e, Pi.basisFun_apply,
      Pi.single_apply, Finset.prod_boole, Finset.mem_univ, true_implies, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite,
      mul_one, mul_zero]
    have hfun : ∀ f : Fin k → Fin N, (∀ t, f t = g (σ t)) ↔ f = g ∘ σ :=
      fun f => ⟨fun h => funext h, fun h t => congrFun h t⟩
    simp only [hfun, Finset.sum_ite_eq', S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    split_ifs with h
    · have := μ.map_perm (fun i => Pi.single (g i) (1 : R)) σ
      simp only [Function.comp_def] at this ⊢
      rw [this, Units.smul_def]
    · rfl
  rw [MultilinearMap.alternatization_apply]
  simp only [MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, key, smul_ite, smul_zero]
  have hsort : StrictMono (g ∘ Tuple.sort g) :=
    (Tuple.monotone_sort g).strictMono_of_injective (hg.comp (Tuple.sort g).injective)
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Tuple.sort g)]
  · rw [ite_eq_left_of_eq_true _ _ (eq_true hsort), ← Units.smul_def, ← mul_smul,
      Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
  · intro σ _ hσ
    refine ite_eq_right_of_eq_false _ _ (eq_false fun h => ?_)
    apply hσ
    have := Tuple.unique_monotone h.monotone hsort.monotone
    ext i
    exact congrArg Fin.val (hg (congrFun this i))
  · simp

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.tupleMap_single
statement:
theorem tupleMap_single {N : ℕ} (v : Fin N → M) (i : Fin N) :
    tupleMap (R := R) v (Pi.single i 1) = v i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [tupleMap, Fintype.linearCombination_apply_single]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply
proof:
:= by
  simp only [AlternatingMap.compLinearMap_apply, tupleMap_single]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply_self
proof:
:=
  compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply F v id

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.constOfIsEmpty_compLinearMap
statement:
theorem constOfIsEmpty_compLinearMap {M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M']
    (g : M' →ₗ[R] M) :
    (AlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty R M (Fin 0) (1 : R)).compLinearMap g =
      AlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty R M' (Fin 0) (1 : R)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.ofSubsingleton_compLinearMap
statement:
theorem ofSubsingleton_compLinearMap {M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M']
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (g : M' →ₗ[R] M) :
    (AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M R (0 : Fin 1) φ).compLinearMap g =
      AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M' R (0 : Fin 1) (φ ∘ₗ g)

:= by

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.alternatization_ofSubsingleton
statement:
theorem alternatization_ofSubsingleton (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    MultilinearMap.alternatization (MultilinearMap.ofSubsingleton R M R (0 : Fin 1) φ) =
      AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M R (0 : Fin 1) φ
proof:
:= by
  ext v

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_constOfIsEmpty_left
statement:
theorem shuffle_constOfIsEmpty_left (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (v : Fin (0 + k) → M) :
    shuffle (AlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty R M (Fin 0) (1 : R)) μ v =
      μ (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.zero_add k).symm)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_alternatization_eq (μ.compLinearMap (tupleMap (R := R) v))
  rw [← compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply_self (R := R), ← compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply (R := R),
    ← shuffle_compLinearMap, constOfIsEmpty_compLinearMap, ← ha,
    ← alternatization_constOfIsEmpty, shuffle_alternatization, constOfIsEmpty_mulProd,
    alternatization_domDomCongr]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_constOfIsEmpty_right
statement:
theorem shuffle_constOfIsEmpty_right (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (v : Fin (k + 0) → M) :
    shuffle μ (AlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty R M (Fin 0) (1 : R)) v =
      μ (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.add_zero k).symm)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_alternatization_eq (μ.compLinearMap (tupleMap (R := R) v))
  rw [← compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply_self (R := R), ← compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply (R := R),
    ← shuffle_compLinearMap, constOfIsEmpty_compLinearMap, ← ha,
    ← alternatization_constOfIsEmpty, shuffle_alternatization, mulProd_constOfIsEmpty,
    alternatization_domDomCongr]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_assoc
statement:
theorem shuffle_assoc (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R)
    (θ : M [⋀^Fin m]→ₗ[R] R) (v : Fin (k + l + m) → M) :
    shuffle (shuffle μ ν) θ v =
      shuffle μ (shuffle ν θ) (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.add_assoc k l m).symm)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_alternatization_eq (μ.compLinearMap (tupleMap (R := R) v))
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_alternatization_eq (ν.compLinearMap (tupleMap (R := R) v))
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_alternatization_eq (θ.compLinearMap (tupleMap (R := R) v))
  rw [← compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply_self (R := R), ← compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply (R := R),
    ← shuffle_compLinearMap, ← shuffle_compLinearMap, ← shuffle_compLinearMap,
    ← shuffle_compLinearMap, ← ha, ← hb, ← hc, shuffle_alternatization, shuffle_alternatization,
    shuffle_alternatization, shuffle_alternatization, mulProd_assoc, alternatization_domDomCongr]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_swap
statement:
theorem shuffle_swap (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) :
    shuffle ν μ = (shuffle μ ν).domDomCongr finAddFlip
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_alternatization_eq (μ.compLinearMap (tupleMap (R := R) v))
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_alternatization_eq (ν.compLinearMap (tupleMap (R := R) v))
  rw [AlternatingMap.domDomCongr_apply, ← compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply_self (R := R),
    ← compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply (R := R), ← shuffle_compLinearMap, ← shuffle_compLinearMap,
    ← ha, ← hb, shuffle_alternatization, shuffle_alternatization, mulProd_comm,
    alternatization_domDomCongr]
  rfl

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.val_finRotate_pow
statement: theorem val_finRotate_pow (n m : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : (((finRotate n) ^ m) i : ℕ) = (i + m) % n
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt i.isLt]
  | succ m ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => exact i.elim0
    | succ n =>
      rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, finRotate_apply, Fin.val_add, ih, Fin.val_one',
        ← Nat.add_mod, Nat.add_assoc]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.sign_finAddFlip_trans_finCongr
statement:
theorem sign_finAddFlip_trans_finCongr (k l : ℕ) :
    Perm.sign (finAddFlip.trans (finCongr (Nat.add_comm l k)) : Perm (Fin (k + l))) =
      (-1) ^ (k * l)
proof:
:= by
  have hπ : (finAddFlip.trans (finCongr (Nat.add_comm l k)) : Perm (Fin (k + l))) =
      finRotate (k + l) ^ l := by
    ext i
    rw [val_finRotate_pow]
    refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, finAddFlip_apply_castAdd, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast,
        Fin.val_natAdd, Fin.val_castAdd]
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
      omega
    · simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, finAddFlip_apply_natAdd, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast,
        Fin.val_natAdd, Fin.val_castAdd]
      rw [show k + j + l = j + (k + l) by omega, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Nat.even_mul_pred_self l
  have hexp : (k + l - 1) * l = k * l + (t + t) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos l with rfl | hl
    · simp at ht ⊢
      omega
    · rw [show k + l - 1 = k + (l - 1) by omega, add_mul, ← ht, mul_comm (l - 1) l]
  rw [hπ, map_pow, sign_finRotate, ← pow_mul, hexp, pow_add, Even.neg_one_pow ⟨t, rfl⟩, mul_one]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_comm
statement:
theorem shuffle_comm (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) (v : Fin (k + l) → M) :
    shuffle μ ν v = (-1 : R) ^ (k * l) * shuffle ν μ (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.add_comm l k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [shuffle_swap μ ν, AlternatingMap.domDomCongr_apply]
  have : (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.add_comm l k)) ∘ finAddFlip =
      v ∘ (finAddFlip.trans (finCongr (Nat.add_comm l k)) : Perm (Fin (k + l))) := rfl
  rw [this, AlternatingMap.map_perm, sign_finAddFlip_trans_finCongr, Units.smul_def,
    zsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc]
  push_cast
  rw [← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow, one_mul]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.shuffle_comm'
statement:
theorem shuffle_comm' (μ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R) (ν : M [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[R] R) :
    shuffle μ ν = (-1 : R) ^ (k * l) • (shuffle ν μ).domDomCongr (finCongr (Nat.add_comm l k))
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [shuffle_comm, AlternatingMap.smul_apply, AlternatingMap.domDomCongr_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight_alternatization
statement:
theorem alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight_alternatization (φ : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k => M) R) (v : Fin (k + 1) → M) :
    AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (φ.smulRight (MultilinearMap.alternatization f)) v =
      MultilinearMap.alternatization (mulProd (MultilinearMap.ofSubsingleton R M R (0 : Fin 1) φ) f)
        (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.add_comm 1 k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AlternatingMap.domDomCongr_apply, ← alternatization_domDomCongr,
    MultilinearMap.alternatization_apply, AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply]
  have hH : ∀ w : Fin (k + 1) → M,
      ((mulProd (MultilinearMap.ofSubsingleton R M R (0 : Fin 1) φ) f).domDomCongr
        (finCongr (Nat.add_comm 1 k))) w = φ (w 0) * f (fun j => w j.succ) := by
    intro w
    simp only [MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, mulProd_apply,
      MultilinearMap.ofSubsingleton_apply_apply]
    congr 2
    ext
    simp
  simp only [MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, hH, LinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    AlternatingMap.smul_apply, MultilinearMap.alternatization_apply, Fin.removeNth_apply]
  cases k with
  | zero =>
    have h1 : ∀ x : Fin (0 + 1), x = 0 := fun x => Fin.ext (by have := x.isLt; omega)
    have h2 : ∀ σ : Perm (Fin (0 + 1)), σ = 1 := fun σ => Equiv.ext fun x => by
      rw [h1 (σ x), h1 x]; rfl
    rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single (0 : Fin (0 + 1)) (fun x hx => absurd (h1 x) hx),
      Fintype.sum_eq_single (1 : Perm (Fin (0 + 1))) (fun σ hσ => absurd (h2 σ) hσ)]
    simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul, Perm.sign_one, Perm.coe_one, id_eq,
      Fintype.sum_unique, Perm.default_eq, smul_eq_mul, Fin.succAbove_zero]
  | succ n =>
    rw [Fintype.sum_equiv Perm.decomposeFin' _ (fun p => Perm.sign (Perm.decomposeFin'.symm p) •
      (φ (v (Perm.decomposeFin'.symm p 0)) *
        f (fun j => v (Perm.decomposeFin'.symm p j.succ)))) (fun τ => by simp),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp only [Perm.decomposeFin'_symm, Perm.decomposeFin'Symm_zero, Perm.decomposeFin'Symm_succ,
      Perm.sign_decomposeFin'Symm, Finset.mul_sum, smul_eq_mul, Units.smul_def, Units.val_mul,
      Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_neg, Units.val_one, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_pow,
      Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, zsmul_eq_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
    ring

name: AlternatingAnalytic.Forms.alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight
statement:
theorem alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (θ : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] R)
    (v : Fin (k + 1) → M) :
    AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (φ.smulRight θ) v =
      shuffle (AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M R (0 : Fin 1) φ) θ
        (v ∘ finCongr (Nat.add_comm 1 k))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_alternatization_eq (θ.compLinearMap (tupleMap (R := R) v))
  have hL : AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (φ.smulRight θ) v =
      AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin
        ((φ ∘ₗ tupleMap (R := R) v).smulRight (θ.compLinearMap (tupleMap (R := R) v)))
        (fun i => Pi.single i (1 : R)) := by
    simp only [AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply, LinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, tupleMap_single, AlternatingMap.smul_apply,
      AlternatingMap.compLinearMap_apply, Fin.removeNth_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hL, ← compLinearMap_tupleMap_apply (R := R), ← shuffle_compLinearMap,
    ofSubsingleton_compLinearMap, ← hf, ← alternatization_ofSubsingleton, shuffle_alternatization,
    alternatizeUncurryFin_smulRight_alternatization]
  rfl
